—8rdo: zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bsdus pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so:gtsasdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye shaganagargo dad mos gdung shugs drag po yis: gu ru yid la dran byas nas: dus drug gsol 'debs 'di nyid bskyal: bar chad zhi nges gtan tshig yin: sa ma yā: e ma ho: sku gsum ston pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi: thugs sprul 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung: khyad 'phags rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba smin grol byas: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar: gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la gsol ba 'des: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nyon mongs gdung ba tsha zer drag po yis: mnar ba'i dmus long 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur bcom ldan gu ru drug la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang

gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: spre'u tsha rgyud gnag blo rmong gtum pa rnams: thugs rjes thabs kyis sems can lam la bkod:mkhan slob chos gsum sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengs mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar byas: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis zlobs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la bzhag gu ru thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal ba dang: sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i: lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la gsol ba 'debs phyi ngan gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab

—bye/da: pa'i tshe: rang snang dag pa dpal ri pad+ma'i zhing: ston 'khor rnam par dag pa rab mched nas: 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog: oṃ 4snyibadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi hūṃ: de ltar gsol ba btab pa yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel: nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel: dbang dang dngos grub 〈pe par 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: the tshom med do sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya: brda thim: snyi: ces pa 'di 'angabatsun chung kai rti'i skye rtags can gyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab te yi ge pa ni pad+ma smon sems kyis bgyis pa'o/

btsasdo: ba gsang rdo rje snying po las:sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—6rdo: them medasnyiḥn mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥgispa1stso( 7 dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yisaXthal sbyar snyan pari dbyangs kyisa'adi skad doḥ.e ma hoḥgadod nas ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang :lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gang chen mtshoḥthugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan rdo rje semasaḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥchos kyi 'byung gnas dga' rab rdo rje dang ཿrdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng ༷ mkhas shing grub pa mañdzu mi tra laḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ'aja' lus rdo rje'isku brnyes pad ma 'byungaḥbi ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtsho'iḥzag phung 'od skur grol ba mtsho rgyal laḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥblo gros dbang phyug khye'u ye zhes dbyingasaḥdon gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lngaḥbartul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje laḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥdon gyi rig 'dzin

dpa' bo rol pa rtsalaḥ chos nyid 1nga rdol rdo rje khro bo lodaḥ snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos kyang ༷ thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yisaX rjes bzung dbang bskur blo sna chos la bsgyuraḥ phyi nang rkyen zhi sa lam mthar phyin nasaḥ kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par regagaḥ de ltar gsol btab phyi nang bdud las rgyalaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phelaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur ༷ the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka'aX shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i tshas sde rnams ༷grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzodaḥ ma 'ongasasnyegs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 0 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spelaḥ byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthong bka' gsang thub par srung shig rngas nus maX skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen rdzogs soX gter rgyaX gtad rgya ༷ sbas rgya zab rgya

sna 〉(rnya ga/sang rgyaḥ gu rgyaḥ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza'i bkod pa 'oḥ brda thimaḥ snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i skyes mchog pad+ma nor bus rja sa sna chags dang bcas nes yang yang bskul ba dang ཿ chos bdag chosa'aphel rgya mtshodang ཿ slob bu ye shes rat+na pa ra rnams kyis nan du bskul ngoraḥ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjesa'abros phug ḍāka'i'adu gling nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnas nas pad+ma'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarbam le:

—8rdo: chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod lasaḥ sku phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs gnad 'bebs bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ra leḥ e ma hoḥ skye med chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzangaḥ ma 'gagasarang grol longs sku snang mtha' yasaḥ thugs rje rmad byung rnal 'byor nus ldan paraḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ thub pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa sha ra'i buḥ bya/ rgyan yul byon chos rgyal trig na paḥ nor bu go leb yang dag mngon gyur dpalaḥgasol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ bod khams mun sel pad+ma'i spyan snga rtsa 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung ye shes bloḥ bstan pa'i phyi mo nor bu don grub laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ dgongs pa mngon gyur rnal 'byor mkhar nag paḥ sbyor sgol thabs mkhas mgon po rdo rje dngaḥ chos kyi mdzod 'dzin he pa chos 'byung la ༷gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ zab gter mnga' bdag bdud 'dul rdo rje dang: grub brnyes dbang phyug dpa' bo rol pa rtsalaḥ chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro lod

laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ mkha' spyod gnas nyul ye shes rdo rje dngaḥ zab gsang sgo 'byed rdo rje drag po rtsalaḥ brtul zhugs mthu stobs nus ldan rdo rje laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs bstan pa'i nyi ma kun skyong glingaḥ gcod spyon drag bzhad rol ba'i rdo rje dngaḥ o rgyan bde chen gling pa ye shes mdzodaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud sprin grol mdzodaḥ gdug pa tshar gcod rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsalaḥ 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor o rgyan zhig po baḥ thabs mkhas spyod pa bskyangs ba'i mkha' khyab rjeḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon o rgyan las 'phro glingaḥ byams pa'i spyan sngar byang sems ral gri 'dzinaḥm 'ongs sangs rgyas mos pa mtha' yas gragasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud sprin dza la mdzodaḥ de ltar sku yi phreng ba bsam mtha' yasaḥ yid la dran zhing rtse gcig gsol btab mthusaḥ khreg chod chos sku'i dgongs klong mngon gyur nasaḥ gang shar sku dang ye shes rol bar mthongaḥ thod sgal snang bzhi'i nyams len mthar 'khyol teX zad pa gsum

brten: rdzogs gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubasaḥ'aja' lus 'pho ba chen por sangs rgyas re gaḥde ltar mos gus gsol btab byin rlabs 'jug ༷phyi nang gegs zhi bsam pa lhun gyis grubaḥs ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces pa'ang chos kyi bdag poḥpad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dngaḥlas ldan las rab zhes byas dar dang shog gu bcas yangayang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaXsabo maṅga lam

—1) snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me lasaḥ sngon gtor 'bul ba phrinalas lhun grub bzhugs soḥ——14 na mo gu ru weḥ gshāgs sgrub pa gegs med mthar phyin phyir sngon gtor bsangs sbyangs zad med spel rkyeḥ sngon nas tha tshig gnyer blang ba'iḥ bka' sdod dregs pa rgya mtsho dngaḥ yul lha zo dor dkar phyogs skyongaḥ ma lus sngon gyi tha tshig bzhinaḥ 'dir gshegs dkar dmar skyems phud bzhesaḥ sgrub pa zab mo'i grogs byos laḥ gang bcol zhi rgyas dbang drag donaḥ gegs med yid bzhin 'byung ba dngaḥ dngos grub dpal yon rgya mtsho skyolaḥ don gnyis grub mdzod dam tshig canaḥ a lo ka pā la e dam bā ling ta khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin las bcolaX thog med yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyuraX sa mayāḥ rgyargya rgyaḥ gu r+sha brda zem snyiX zhes pa 'di lungazen zub gi bskur ngoraḥ kho bo nus ldan pas mkha' 'gro'i brda las phab pas yi ge pa ni k+ṣetra'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarbamaṅga lamaX /bgegs la chang glud bsngo ba ni0 rang nyid gtsug ma'i dbang chen skuḥ dmar ser gar dgu'i nyams ldan gsalaḥ thugs ga'i 'od kyis gtor

ma'i mgronaḥ 'byung po 'gugs pa'i nus ldan gyuraḥspyoḥ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyuraḥ se bhar sa sngags kyis spel a garo yisazad med spros na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthusaX sgrub pa la 'tshe zhing tshe srog gi dngos po la dbang za bar rngams pa'i 'byungapo thams cad glud gtor 'di yi mgron du 'dus shigaḥ sarbastu ta.a gar sha yadzaḥ lan gsum dzaḥ (bo ho bka' bsgo gtongaḥdzaX nas lan chags ma sod cingaḥ 'phral du glud la reba'i mgronaḥ de ring bdag gis mchod sbyin bgyi tshim par gyis la rang gnas dengasaḥsarba biganan ga: 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lags duḥdad ldanazheng rgyam gyis bskur ngoraXnus ldan rdo rjes spel bdage sabomaṅgayam
bskyong snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgon me lasaḥ don dam bla ma'i sgrub pa mi shigs don gyi snying po bzhugs soḥ

r+shar+sha) na mo gu ru laḥ gci/4)khyod don dam mi shig bla ma'i zhalaḥ rig stong zung 'jug 'od gsal klongaX gdod nas 'du 'bral bral ba laḥ rang ngo rig pas phyag bgyi'o skal ldan sgrub la snying rus can rteX dus mchog thob brtson 'grus che bka' bzhin spyod rdo'i dam tshog can dben pa'i gnas su dam rgya yis bla sgrub 'di la brtson par byaX sam yāḥ sgrub rten gtor ma srog 'khor sogs phun sum tshogs par bkod byas nas sgrub pa'i gzhung la 'jug pa ni spyi don rnam pa gsum gyi bstanaX dngapo sbyor ba'i las la bdunaḥ skyabs sems ni na mo rang rig don gyi bla ma laḥ blo bral rjen pas skyabs su mchiḥ gzung 'dzin sems kyi gzhi rtsa kunaḥ chos skur grol phyir sems bskyed doḥ tshogs bsags pa ni na moḥ gdod nas dag mnyam bla ma laḥ lta ba mjal ba'i phyag bgyi'oḥ gang shar rang grol mchod pa 'bulaḥ mu bzhi sems kyi 'dzin stangs bshagasaḥ ye grol 1nga la rje yi rangaḥ zang thal don gyi chos 'khor bskoraḥ dbyings rig klong las g.yo med bzhugasaḥ dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ mnyam nyid ye shes don rtogs shogaḥ bgegs bskrad ni trīḥ gdod nas dri bral dbyings nyid laḥ ma rtog glo bur ngar 'dzin gdonaḥ 'phral snang 'byung po'i

——rjo tshogs rnams kunaḥ bdag med de bzhin nyidadu bskradaḥ zung gur niḥ hrīḥ rig pa ye shes byang chub semasaḥ don dam mtha' dbus bral ba'i sangaḥ gnod byed bgegs kyi spros pa dgaḥ don dam ye mnyam rwa gur dkrigasaḥ byin 'bebs niḥ hrīḥ mi gnas chos sku'i dgongs klong nasaḥ brgyud gsum chig rdzogs rdo rje 'changaḥ rang rig bla ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengasaḥ 'dir byon byin phob rtog pa sporaḥ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hrīḥ chos can chos nyid dag pa'i 'phrulaḥ ye shes rgyan gyi bye brag kunaḥ tshogs drug lha mo rol gar bcasaḥ bla ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir spelaḥ bshags pa ni hoḥ 'jin stangs sems kyi dri ma kunaḥ gdod nas dbyings la med mod kyangaḥ 1 bur rdul gsum dri ma kunaḥ rig pa ye shes ngang du nga nagasaḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgyaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa ni rnam grangs bco lnga'i sgo nas bstanaX lha bskyed niḥ hrīḥ rnam thar gsum ldan rdo nga pa nyidaḥ ye shes snying rjes khyab brdal gzigasaḥ zung 'jug rtsal las rig pa āḥ rten 'byung rgyu yi sa bon sharaḥ hrīḥ stong chen yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings su: lhun grub rang rtsal zhing bkod niḥ brda' don rtags

rdzogs 'od snang klongaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul gzhal med khangaḥ tshad dang mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbusaḥ srid las 'phags pa rat+na'i khriraḥ bde stong kha sbyor nyi zla'i steng rig pa rang grol bla ma niḥ thang stong rgyalapo tshe yi sku sku mdog spug nag zhi ma khro zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum sgegs bzhadaḥ phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje 'dzinaḥ g.yon pas snang stong tshe bum bstenaḥ dar dpyangs e rag sgom thag mdzesaḥ rus pa'i rgyan drug rnam par 'changaḥ ye shes spyan gyis nam mkhar gzigasaḥrtog bral shangs nas hūṃ glu lenaḥ mnyam nyid zhal bzang bu la ngomaḥ dbu skra thor cog dar snas bcingaḥ dkar mdzes zal bus sku rgyab khebasaḥ gdos bral dwangs ma 'od kyi sku: 'ja' 'od thig le lnga ldan klongaḥ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugasaḥ rig bdag dga' rab rdo rje niḥ longs sku'i chas rdzogs rdor dril 'changaḥ de steng chos sku kun tu bzangaḥ mthing gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugasaḥbargyud gsum bla ma'i dgyes bskang dpalaḥ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar: lto ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser: nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmaraḥ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljangaḥ

——3 kun kyang gri thod rus rgyan canaḥ sbyan drangs gnyis su med par bsreḥsbyan 'dren ni hrīḥsku gsum dag mnyams 'od lnga'i klongaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul mdzad pa canaḥ rang rig bla ma ston 'khor bcasaḥ 'dir byon dbang bskur rtog pa sporaḥ sa ma yā dza: bzhugs gsol niX hrī: thugs rje'i lcags kyus drangs ba'i lhaḥ byams pa'i zhags pas rten dang bsre dga' ba'i sgog gis gnyis med bcings: btang snyoms dril bus brtan bzhugs gsolaḥ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ phyag 'tshal ni na mo gzhi dbyings ka dag chos sku'i 1nga: lhun grub 'od gsal rdzogs pa che: sku dang ye shes dkyil 'khor laḥ lhag mthong lta ba'i phyag bgyi'oḥ mchod 'bul ni0 hrīḥ gzung dang 'jen pas ma gos paraḥ 'od gsal rig pa'i rgyan mchod sprinaḥ gang shar lha mo'i glu gar bcasaḥ dbyings las bton te dbyings su 'bulaḥ ye shes thugs kyis dgyes bzhes nasaḥ 1 bral rtog pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ badz+ra pu dza sa ma ya hoḥ bstod pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje'i sku ni rdul dang bralaḥ 'gag med gsung gsang phyogs mtha' yasaḥ ye shes thugs ni kun la khyabaḥ bla ma'i gsang ba gsum la bstodaḥ chos sku matram̐ng

gsal nam mkha'i mdogaḥ longs sku dkar gsal zla ba'i zhalaḥ sprul sku 'od 'bar nyi ma'i dalaḥ bla ma sku gsum 1nga la bstodaḥ don dam dbyings las ma g.yos garaḥ ye shes thugs rje kun la snyomasaḥ gnyis med ro mnyam bka' drin canaḥ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ 'dzab ni trīḥ rang rig bla ma tshe yi bdagaḥ ye shes gsal ba'i nyi ma canaḥ drang bab dgongs pa'i 'dzab kyis skyongasaḥ gang snang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor duḥ mngon gyur ye bab rig pa'i ngangaḥ a ma hāgu ruyi man dwa rā dza sarba sidhi (ཿ dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer gdab nasaX bsnyen sngags bye ba gcig bzlas naḥ nyams rtog 'phel zhing tshe bsod rgyasaḥdon gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur0 sgrub 'dzab niḥ trīḥ rang rig bla ma thang ༷ nga rgyalaḥ ye shes rang rtsal brgyud gsum la ༷gnyis med mnyam nyid dgongs pa'i skyongasaḥ 'khor 'das rang grol rdzogs pa cheḥ blo bral chos sku khyab brdal ngangaḥ sam hāgu rubaṃdudha ra sarba sirnyi pha la (ཿ gabor 'das rig pas dang blangs nas sgrub sngags bye ba gsum bzlas na ye shes bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mjalaḥ spros bral rdo rje btsan sa zinaḥ las sbyor niḥtrīḥ rig pa ye shes gzi byin gyiḥ rlung sems zhi zhing ye shes rgyasaḥ 'od

—14 gsal dbang 'dus gnyis snang bcomaḥ 'khor 'das rdzogs pa chen por grolaḥ a ma hā gu ru bo ha ri ni sa a yu pukhye dz+nyā na sirnyi pha la hūm̐ āḥ spro bsdu ye shes gzi byin gyis las sngags bye ba gcig bzlas na tshe bsod ye shes yon tan rgyasaḥ rig 'dzin sa la nges par sprod0 sa ma yā tshe 'gugs niḥ mda' dar sna lnga g.yab la bdag nyid bla ma tshe dpag med gnyis su med par gsal ba'i sku yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phrosaḥ snangasrid 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dwangs bcud thams cad 'bru gsum ye shes kyi rnam par bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla ma dang bsgrub mchog rnal 'byor yongs kyi sku tshe'i gsos su gyur bar dmigs laḥ ྅ hrīḥ stong gsal 'od lnga'i klong yangs nasaḥrang rig bla ma tshe yi lhaḥ thang stong grub rgyal thugs rje canaḥ mos ldan bu yis bskul lags naḥ mi mjed zhing gi skyes chen rnamasaḥ 'gyur med sku tshe brtan pa'i phyiraḥ skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang skuraḥ 'gyur ba med pa'i byin chen phobaḥ rnal 'byer lus la gzi mdangs bskyedaḥ ngag la nus mthu phun tshogs mdzodaḥ sems la bde stong ting 'dzin sboraḥ gzhan

phan phrin las mtha' yas pasaḥ 'gro khams sprin cing grol nus shogaḥ hrīḥ ye shes dwangs ma thig le'i 1ngaḥ bde chen rdo rje'i dpal 'bar ba'iḥ chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro masaḥ 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor rig can laḥ skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang skuraḥ 'gyur ba med pa'i byin chen phobaḥ rnal 'byor lus la gzi mdangs bskyedaḥ ngag la nus mthu phun tshogs mdzodaḥ sems la bde stong ting 'dzin sboraḥ gzhan phan phrin las mtha' yas pasaḥ 'gro khams smin cing grol nus regagaḥ hrīḥ mnyam nyid dpal 'bar 1nga yangs nasaḥ dgos 'dod yid bzhin dpal ster ba'iḥ rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro masaḥ 'dir 'tshogs grub pa'i dbang phyug laḥ skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang skuraḥ 'gyur ba med pa'i byin chen phobaḥ rnal 'byor lus la gzi mdangs bskyedaḥ ngag la nus mthu phun tshogs mdzodaḥ sems la bde stong ting 'dzin sboraḥ gzhan phan phrin las mtha' yas pasaḥ 'gro khams smin cing grol nus re gaḥ hrīḥ chags bral bde chen klong yangs lasaḥ lhan skyes dga' chen dpal ster ba'iḥ pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro masaḥ 'dir

badz+nyāX gnas dang yul gyi bskang ba niḥ ( hrīḥ rnam dag 'od gsal bde chen 1ngaḥ mkha' spyod sa spyod gnas yul laḥ brten pa'i rdo rje'i spyod pa canaḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro maḥ 'du ba chen pe'i tshogs la byon: gru gar rol mo'i sgra la dgongs ༷ mos ldan sgrub pa'i dal du bzhugasaḥ phud gsum bzhes lhag dga' ston rol ༷ phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa sgrubasaḥ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la sbyoraḥ 'ja' lus chos skur skyel ma mdzodaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yaḥ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra la khā 38 gnam phud gnas yul srung ma yiX dgyes bskang 'dar brtson nyams rtogs 'phel sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu khyaḥ brda thimaX zhes lung zin zung gi dad spros bskur ngor nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa'i ye ge pa ni btsun pa k+ṣe dra'i ming gis bgyis pa dge/ sa rba maṅga 95skyob/

—10 snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me lasaḥ don dam bla ma'i sgrub pa sgrin byed dbang gi chu bo bzhugs soḥ/(1) na mo gu ra pheḥ krushā&/tsang4/sa rig stong ka dag don dam dbyings: lhun grub bla ma'i dkyil 'bar laḥ mthon mthing ral bas gus b.lo deḥsnyingadabus rmi shig thig ler mchod ༷ las can rigasabazang smin grol phyiraX mtshan nyid tshang ba slob dpon gyisaḥ bdag mdun bum bzlas rig me doraḥ 'jug pa'i chas rnams tshang ba'i rjesaḥslab bus gsol ba gdab pa niḥ rkye thesto rgyal kun 'dosas zhal bla ma dgongs bdag cag dam ldan slob bu laḥ rdo rje bla ma sgrub pa'i phyir: smin byed dbang bskur gnang bar zhu: lan gsu4 bla ma'i bka' gnang ni e ཿ 'dir 'tshogs bsod nams skal ba can yang dag snying po spyod 'dod naḥ sor byang sngags sdom kun zungs dngaḥ bdag gis smin byed sbyin bgyi'o: sdom bzung niḥ kye 〉 bla ma mchog gi spyan snga rtsa so thar sdom bzung gzhan gnod spangaḥ byang sems sdom bzung gzhan phan sgrubaḥ gsang sngags sdom bzung dag mnyam khyeraḥ snang srid bla ma'i bskyed rim bsgomaḥ rang rig mtha' bral gsal stong skyongasaḥ de

lta bu la smin byed stsolaḥ lan gsum e maḥ bde gshegs snying por sangs rgyas phyiraḥ 'di na snod min gang yang medaḥ don dam rtogs byed thabs kyis dbangaḥ spros dang spros med yang dag paX dam tshig khyed la bdag gis sbyinaḥ skyed badz+ra sa ma yā/sna dha na sa da na ra gnaḥ slob ma lha gsal ye shes dbab de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol de nas sku bum pa'i dbang niḥ ( rdosabum ni brdal khyab chos kyi dbyingasaḥ pa ni rig pa'i ye shes zhalaḥ zung 'jug bla ma'i dkyil 'khor steḥ skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ lus dang rtsa yi sgrib dag nasaḥ snang stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar ka yaya bhiṣiñtsa oṃ de nas bhasto gsung gi dbang bskur ba niX hūṃ nyi bhan+ta stong gsum khyon mnyam dngosaX bla ma yab yum spyor ba'i rgyunaX byang chub sems bcud dkar dmar 'khyilaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ ngag dang rlung gi sgrib dag nas/ /gsal stong rtogs pa mngom gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngaṭa mthar wak+kas bhi3: aḥ de nas rig mas sher dbang bskur ba niḥ shā hrīḥ bde ba sbyin pa'i yid 'ong maḥ bha ga phyag rgya chen po'i lamaḥ nyon mongs mtshan ma thad gar gcodaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas ༷

—11 yid dang thig le sgrib dag nas ༷ bde stong rtogs pa mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar 0tsit+ta a bhi ṣinyu ྅ཿ de nas sher dkar gyi brdas tshig dbang bskur bani dz+nyā hrī ma bcos rig pa thad shar zhogaḥ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rjen pa 'diḥ dpe yis mi mtshon tshig dang bralaḥ don la ston bya'i chos dben kyangaḥ rten 'brel tsam gyi brda thabs 'di'iḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum cha mnyam sgrib dag nasaḥ rig stong rtogs pa mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaX sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ de nas dgongs pa gto de rtsal dbang niḥ.āḥ gnyug ma'i ye shes stong gsal klongaḥ ma rtsal don dam bum sku'i zhalaḥ gdos mtshan phyi nang spros pa dgaḥ ye nas gnyis med rdzogs pa cheḥ don dam dgongs pa nyag gcig 'diḥ skal ldan bu la gtad rgyas sbyinaX rtogs grol dus mnyam dbang thob shogaḥ a a phaṭaḥ ga ṇas bhi ṣinyu shrīḥ de nas mtha' brten gtor ma'i dbang niX dz+nyā hrī brdal khyab dbyings kyi gzhong pa ru lhun grub 'od lnga'i gtor chen bshamasaḥ rang gsal ye shes rgyan gyis sprasaḥ rtsa ba gsum gyi 'du 'phro 'khrigasaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgrub dang dkyil 'khor yongs

rdzogs nasaḥ gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam re gaḥ rtsa sngagasamatharaX maṇ+ḍal bha ling tapas bhi/do/cas āḥshāhrīḥ mtha' brten gtad cing shis pa brjod dbang yon snang srid blos blangs 'bul dam tshig spyi dang khyad par lhagaḥ ma lus yongs su 'dzin khas blangasaḥ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdabaḥ gnad 'dir brten pas dngos grub thobaX nyams rtog yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phelaX tshe chos mdzad phrin rab rgyas 'gyuraX sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgya gu khyaḥ brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin shi la'i mtshan can dngaX smon lam 'phro 'dzom zhing rgyam zung gis bskur ngoraX kho bo nam mkha'i rnam 'byoranusaldan rdo rjes chos nyid nam mkha'i mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni btsun pa zhing rgyam gyis bgyis pa dge —sarba maṅga lamaX

——— snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me lasaḥ tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥr+shar+sha) na mo gu ru leḥ gīskolcosasnyephyog slob dpon mtshan nyid tshang ba yis bla bsgrub bskang tshogs bum bzlas gtongaX slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyangasaḥ tho 'tshams bgegs bsal srung gur phubaḥ bden dar+sha r+shad la mam 'bulaX de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/rkye gsang chen don ston bla ma dgongasaḥ bdag cag skal ldan slob bu rnamasaḥ dus min 'chi bas rkyen bzlog phyiraḥ rdo rje tshe yi dbang bskur rtsolaḥ lan gnang ni: e maḥ bu khyod sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod naḥ 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba bskyedaḥ yang dag don gyi nyams len laḥ brtson na rdo rje'i tshe dbang sbyin zhu ba ni ༷ e maX rdo rje slob dpon brtse bas dgongasaḥ bdag ni 'di nas byang chub b.raḥ bla ma dkon mchog mi spang ngoḥ sor byang sngags sdom 'dzin bgyi'oḥ lan gnang ni e maḥ tshur shog rdo rje'i rigs can rnamasaḥ khas blangs dam tshig legs srung naḥ dngos grub skal ba dbang mchog sbyinaḥ snying po spyod bzhin dam chu 'thungaḥ sa ma yā na ra gnaḥ slob ma lha gsal ye shes dbab pa de

nyid brten par bzhugs su gsolaḥrdo rje'i tshe 'gugs gzhung ltar bya sku la tshe dbang sbyin pa ni hūṃ trī: stong gsal zung 'jug bum pa nas ye shes tshe yi bcud chen bskyilaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ rdo rje tshe yi sku thob shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar ༷ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maḥ rdo rje'i tshe srungs shigaḥ ngag la tshe dbang sbyin pa ni shā hrī: bde stong dum gcig kā pa laraḥ yab yum sbyor ba'i tshe bcud bskyilaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje tshe yi gsung thob shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ rdo rje'i tshe srungs shigaḥ yid la tshe dbang sbyin pa ni hūṃ rdi stong chen dbyings kyi phyag rgya moḥ bde chen ye shes tshe sbyin dpalaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ rdo rje'i tshe yi thugs thob shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉ཿ rdo rje'i tshe srungs shig cha mnyam gyi dbyings la don gyi tshe dbang sbyin pa niX hūṃ hrī: 'pho 'gyur med pa'i gnyug ma 'diḥ tshe dang ye shes brten pa'i dbyingasaḥ thig le'i brda dbang la brten nasaḥ 'chi med ye shes don rtog shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar garmā a bhi ṇiñtsa trīḥ rdo rje'i tshe srungs shigaḥ sba bstim bya zhing tshe rgyas gdab brdeg byed gtor ma'i dbang bskur niX hūṃ hrī: brdal khyab dbyings kyi bhan+ta dzas ye shes 'od

—14 snang gtor chen bshamasaḥ sku gsum lhun grub 'do phung 'baraḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ lus ngag yid kyi zag zad nasaḥ rdo rje'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaX bā ling ta a snyi ṣiñtsa ma.ā hūm̐ hrīḥ mtha' rten gawa pa ni hūṃ 〉 rgyal ba'i mtshan pe'i sku thob phyiraḥ bkra shis rtags brgyad dbang bskur roḥ bdud 'dul chos 'khor bskor ba'i tsheḥ byin rlabs rdzas brgyad dbang yang bskuraḥ 'phags pa'i nor bdun 'byor ba'i phyiraḥ rgyal srid sna bdun dbang bskur roḥ khams gsum 'khe ra ba las bsgral nasaḥ sku gsum lhun grub spyod par regagaḥ rat+na maṅga lam a dzhai ༷༷sa ༷ཿ shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thoraḥ dbang thob yon du ci 'byor 'bul sgog tu rtsab yan yag srungaḥ dge ba mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo gnad des 'chi med tshe dbang thob don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub 'gyur roḥs marmāḥrgya rgyagyoḥgu phya brda zem snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan la'i mtshan can gyis bskur ba dngaX skal ldanak+ṣe tra dh+wa dzas lha reg bcas te bskur ngor kho bo bdud 'jom nus ldan rdo rje'i zab mdzod kyi rgya las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni btsun pa zhing rgyam gyis bgyis pa dge sarba maṅga lamaX

——14 bla sgrub rgyun khyer bsdus pa niḥ āḥ rang rig don gyi bla ma laḥ 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchiḥ gzung 'dzin ka nas dag pa'i phyiraḥ bla ma'i sgrub pa bsgom par byaḥ āḥ snang ba 'od gsal zhing khams dbusaḥ srid pa ye shes bla ma'i dalaḥ nyag gcig zang thal 'od kyi skuraḥ dri med rig pa'i 'dzab mchod 'bulaḥ 'khor 'das ro mnyam dgongs pa'i ngang: sku gsum bla ma chig rdzogs sgrubasaḥ ces ma hā gu ru bi ma na da ra dza sirnyi pha la hūm̐ aḥ tshogs drug snang ba zang thaloskyongs ༷ rig stong 'od gsal 'gags pamedaḥdon dam bla ma'i sgrubapa 'disaḥ sku gsum gsang ba bsam yas mthongaX sa ma yāḥ sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa niḥ hūṃ hrī: sgrib bral thugs ni mkha' ltar dgaḥ ye shes gzigs pa kun la che masaḥ 'od gsal gdos bral sku gsum zhalaḥ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la bstodaḥ 'di bzung gdod ma'i chos sku'i b.raḥ sku gsum bla ma'i gsang lam laḥ brten te sa lam mthar phyin nasaḥ 'ja' lus 'od sku mngon shākyar regagaḥ sgrub pa kun gyi ya gyal teḥthun mong mchog gi dngos grub thobaḥnyams rtog sa lam rtsalajogs nasaḥrig 'dzin sa langes par 'byoraḥs mayāḥrgya gyorgyaḥ gu h+ya brda thim 3)zhes skal bzang thob pa k+ṣe tra dh+wa dzasabaskul
ba don dang ldan phyir kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pas yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid kyis so sarba maṅga lam:
badz+ra: snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgon me lasaḥ lo rgyus bsdus pa don gsal snying po bzhugs soḥ

'o/ na mo gu ru leḥ dzasaspyonatswakho bdag gnyis kyi spros pa ka dag gi dbyings su cham gcig brdalaḥ 'od gsal de yi ngang las rgya tshad bral ba'i dbyings 'ja' zer rten /na gyis gur khang chen po 'khrigs pa'i dbusaḥ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzod par dka' ba'i dal steng du tshe dbang rig 'dzin ye shes rgyu ma'i sku can brgyud gsum chig rdzogs kyi zhal bzang canaḥ dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po smug nag zhi ma khro 'dzum stong gsal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du shar ba'i zhal mjal ba'i tshe 'di skad gsungasaX e ma hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i 1ngaḥ sangs rgyas sems can ming yang medaḥ tha snyad ming tshig kun rdzob stongaḥ stong pa 'di zhes dmigs gtad bralaḥ dbyings ye 'di 'bral med pa niḥ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzangaḥ don la thog mtha'i spros pa dgaḥ ye grol thugs ni khyab brdal klongaḥ ye shes sku ni mnyam pa nyidaḥ bde chen gsung ni brdzod las 'dasaḥ yon tan rgya mtsho blo las 'dasaḥ phrin las phun tshogs brjod pa bralaḥ gnas lugs 'di don rtogs gyur naḥ thang stong rgyal po nga dang mja'aḥ kun tu bzang po'i sras

——1 gcig yinaḥ a ka raḥ zhes pa dal gcig gi tshe 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang gisaḥ e maḥ dgongs pa bu dang 'bral ba medaḥ dgongs pa'i brgyud pa long na brelaḥ brda thabs 'od gsal sgyu ma 'diḥ brda brgyud bya ba logs na medaḥ snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i zeg ma 'diḥ snyan brgyud bya ba logs na medaḥ dgongs pa mi zad gter mdzod deḥ gter brgyud bya ba logs na medaḥ 'gyur med rig pa'i ring bsrel badzaḥ gtad brgyud bya ba logs na medaḥ ye nas 'bral med sangs rgyas dngosaḥ las 'phro'i brgyud pa logs na medaḥdrug ldan ris su ma chad paraḥ bla ma'i rgyal tshabs bu la 'byeraḥ rat+na nā da pha laḥ zhes gsungs dal gcig gi tsheḥ lta stangs dang rnam 'gyur du ma'i sgo nas 'di skad doḥ e ma hoḥthang ni kun rdzob bden pa laḥ stong pa don dam bden pa steḥ zung 'jug don la rgyal po gragasaḥ thang ni drang don sa gzhi laḥ stong pa nges don sa bon thebasaḥ 'bras bu smin pa rgyal po'oḥ thang ni snang ba'i dkyil 'khor laḥ stong pa dbyings kyi rgyas thebs paḥ snang stong zung 'jug rgyal po bzhugasaḥ thang ni sgra tshig grags pa'i chosaḥ stong pa spros bral de don

dbyingasaḥ grags stong zung 'jug rgyal por brjodaḥ thang ni sems kyi dkyil 'khor laḥ stong pa ka nas dag pa'i dbyingasaḥ gsal stong zung 'jug rgya por gnasaḥ stong pa 'od gsal ka dag klongaḥ rig stong zung 'jug rgyal por rolaḥ thang ni gzugs sku rnam gnyis laḥ stong pa chos sku khyab brdal klongaḥ sku gsum zung 'jug rgyal por bzhugasaḥye sangs rgyas pa'i he ru gaḥ bdag gi mtshan don de ltar roḥ e a uḥ zhes gsungs la spyan dbyings la hrig ger gzigs sdig 'dzub mkha' la gtad de 'di skad gsungasaḥ e ma hoḥ zag pa zad pa'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥ ye grol gnas lugs rtogs gyur naḥ lta ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' cheḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog tu 'gyuraḥ spros pa bral ba'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥ so so rang rig ye shes 'diḥ sgom pa'i rgyal po 'od gsal cheḥ rig 'dzin kun gyi dam par 'gyuraḥ bzo bcos bral ba'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥ gang shar rang grol rjen pa 'diḥ byed pa'i rgya po zang thal cheḥ gzhan phan phrin las dbang phyug 'gyuraḥ smon pa bral ba'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥ ye rdzogs gnas lugs mjal ba niḥ 'bras bu

—tshung rgyal po sku gsum cheḥ 'di don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor niḥ bdag ni thugs kyi sras po yinaḥ sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su medaḥ gnyis med don 'di spyod par gyisaḥ dha ṭaṃ dṛ sum̐ phaṭaḥ ces gsungs: gzhan yang snyan brgyud du: kye rdo rigs kyi bu khyed la dgongs brgyud zang thal don gyi ye shes la'oḥ brda brgyud 'od gsal ma 'dres pa'i ye shes la'oḥ snyan brgyud so so rang rig pa'i ye shes la'oḥ zab mo rten 'brel gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbyings la'oḥ shog ser rig stong zhal sbyor gnyug ma'i ye shes la'oḥ smon lam rnam par dag pa'i ris med kyi ye shes la'oḥ ṭa ka phaṭaḥ ces gsungasaḥ khyad par gyi dmar khrid dang ཿ rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag bka' lung dbang khrid dang bcas pa'i sgo nas snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me'i gsal bar mdzad doḥ rjes su 'jug pa'i smon lam las 'phro can rnams kyang rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i spron 'jug dngaḥsnang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol par dag rdzogs smin par bya ba'i dza la lam dngaḥ rtsa rlung thig le phyed bcing gis thabs bde ba chen po dang shes rab stong pa

nyid zung 'brel du la bzla ba'i thabs lam dang ཿ gdod nas sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi dgongs pa sku gsum rang chas kyi dkyil 'khor blo bral so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi lam du bya ba dmigs med don gyi lam dngaḥ ye nas lhan skyes shes rab rang byung gi rig pa ye shes sgon me'i rnam rol du bzhugs pa la brten nas zhal phyag gdos bral dwangs ma 'od kyi lha sku tshad pheb 'od gsal chen po'i phyag rgyar blta ba'i sa lam thod rgal gyi zab gnad rang rang gi rgyud dang mthun par rtsal nas slob par 'jug cing mi slob pa'i don la bcar phog tu ngo sprod mkhas par gyis shigaḥ ces gsungs nas bde ba chen po'i ngang la dar gcig tu bzhugs shing yang cig brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pasaḥ a ho/ dbyings gdod nas dag pa'i rgyal saraḥ bu lhag mthong rig pa'i gzhon chungaḥ blo spros pa ka nas dag cingaḥ don 'od gsal klong chen yangs paraḥ deng bsam stan nyal chog mkhas naḥ sku gsum gyi rgyal srid phun tshogasaḥ rtsol med du rang dbang 'byor nasaḥ rang rang gi gdul bya rgya mtsho'iḥ zab gsang gi sgron me 'od chenaḥ phyogs med par khyab brdal mdzad cingaX

tshaX rtsal snang gi 'khor ba dong sprugaḥ rang byung gi rig pa'i bab dngaḥ stong chen gyi mkha' 1nga yangs paraḥ drug ldan gyi rgyal sa bzang poraḥ rtsol med kyi yon tan 'khye1 nasaḥ khyab brdal ba'i phrin las dbang 'byor: de don gyi rtog pa ye shesaḥ 'bral med par thugs dkyil 'chang bzhinaḥ rten 'brel tsam 'gro don gyis shigaḥ a phaṭaḥces gsungs nas ston 'khor dgong pa chos nyid kyi ngang la 'byams su klas soḥ de ltar phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi brda thabs la brten nasasnyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me'i tshogs smon las 'phro can gyi dbang skal du shar ba laḥ ngo mtshar chen po'i maṇ+ḍal dang spro tshad med pa'i lha phyag bcas te smin byed kyi dbang 'jug mdzodaḥ ces pas brda sbyar skal ldan smin grol bya grol smin bskyed rdzogs dgongs pa ngo sprod gdabaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu h+yaḥ brda thi4 snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin shī la'i mtshan can gyi bkra shis lha reg rin chen shel bum sman gyis bkang ba'i skyes bcas bskur ba dang chos bdag k+ṣe dra'i mtshan can gyis rab dkar chu 'dzin kha dog bkra ba'i dar bcas bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyibarda sgo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pas ye ge pa ni bskul ba pophyi mas bgyis
pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga laḥ
badz+ra: snyan brgyud rin po cho'i sgron me lasaḥ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bsgod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

rabs na mo gu ru we tha kho| skyabs kun 'dus zhal rdo rje 'changaḥ mi 'bral snying dbus dad mtshor rol skal ldan sa lam mthar phyin phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di la brtson sa ma mā na moḥ snying dbus ge sar 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i kharaḥ skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsalaḥ skal ldan smin cing grol ba'i mdzad pa canaX snying nas dran cing gsol ba 'debs lags naḥ skal ba dman pa'i sa las dbugs dbyungs zhing theg chen 'og min rig 'dzin sa la sbyoraḥ sgo gsum smin grol gsang gsum mngon gyur shogaḥ dal tshur rnyed dka' ni dal 'byor ldan pa'i mi lus rin chen 'diḥ yang yang rnyed dka' yid bzhin nor bu 'draḥ stong log mi byed yang dag chos la spyodaḥrig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bshul lam zin par shogaḥ tshe mi rtag niḥsrid gsum mi rtag chu 'dzin gar dang mtshungasaḥ 'gro ba'i tshe ni ri gzar rbab ltar myuraḥ skad cig rmi lam lta bu'i rang bzhin laḥ mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran par shogaḥ las rgyu 'bras ni 'bras bu btab pa'i sa bon ma 'chol bzhinaḥ dkar nag gang spyod las 'bras bslu ba medaḥ rnam smin bde dang

—13 sdug bsngal nye bar lenaḥ rgya ba'i bka' bzhin blang dor mkhas par shogaḥ 'bor ba sdug bsngal du sbyangs ba ni 'gro drug gar skye rang snang sdug bsngal gzebaḥ khams gsum 'khor ba nyon mongs 'dam rdzab khrodaḥ gnas ngan 'di las bla mas dbyung du gsolaḥ khri mun 'di las myur bar bsgral du gsolaḥ skyabs 'gro niX na moḥ dkon mchog kun dngos bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ skyabs yul kun gsang rang rig byang chub semasaḥ mngon gyur sor bzhag ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtog pa mngon gyur shogaḥ sems bskyed ni hoḥ ma rig 'khrul snang chu zla'i bkod pa tsamaḥ rten 'brel lu gu rgyud du kha 'byol rnamasaḥ rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su ngal gso'i phyiraX stong gsal zung 'jug sems mchog bskyed bgyi'oḥrdor sems bsgom bzlas ni aḥ bdag nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi gtsug tuḥ pad+ma zla steng bla ma rdo rje semasaḥ dkar gsal dung mdog mtshan dpe'i lang tshos 'byudaḥ thabs shes brda mtshon rdo rje dril bu brtenaḥ longs sku'i chas rdzogs snyem ma yum dang sbyoraḥ stong galas 'od sku bde rol sbyor 'tsham nasaḥ bdud rtsi mu tig dkar

po'i rgyun bab steḥ bdag cag spyi bo nas thim lus kun gangaḥ dam tshig chags nyams sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs dmigasaḥ sa badz+ra twa ma yāḥ sogs aḥ yi ge brgya ba brgya rtsa brjod bdud rtsi 'beb sbyangs dmigs pa gzabaḥ slar yang bla ma rdor sems 'od du zhu: bdag la thim nas sgo gsum 'dzin zhen grolaḥ thugs mchog bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yiḥ gsang ba gsum gyis dag smin rdzogs gsum laḥ sa badz+ra sa twa hūṃḥ gsal snang ngang nas ci rigs brjodaX mthar ni smra bsam brjod bral ngang la bzhagaḥ don dam rdor sems bsgrub la 'jug par byaḥ maṇ+ḍal niX oṃ āḥgyi stong gsum mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i dpalaḥ bdag lus phung khams skye mched 'od lnga'i sprinaḥ rang rig stong gsal ye shes 'od phung 'baraḥ bla ma sku gsum dal du 'bul lo bzhesaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs pa dngaḥ don gnyis lhun grub 'bad med 'byung bar shogaḥ bla rnam niḥ aḥ rang snang dag pa 'od gsal mkha' spyod zhingaḥbarda don rtags kyi bkod pa rdzogs pa'i dbusaḥ ma chags pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng duḥ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang mor gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan pad phreng dar dpyang

ge rdo dkrisaḥ bzhengs pa'i stabs can phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzinaḥ spyan gsum mkhar gzigs dad gus tshad med pasaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i klongaḥrtsa ba'i bla ma thang stong rgyal po'i skuḥ dmar smug zhi ma khro 'dzum gzi brjid 'baraḥ phyag g.yas rig stong mtshon pa'i rdo rje dngaḥ g.yon pa snang stong tshe yi bum pa 'dzinaḥ dar dpyang ang rag sgom thag mjes par sprasaḥ dbu sgra thor cog zal bus sku rgyab khebasaḥ dar sna'i cod paṇa rin chen snyan cha bkraḥ phyed rol stabs bzhugs 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i skuḥ ye shes gzigs pa skal ldan bu la phyogasaḥ mkhyen brtse nus gsum phrin las yongs rdzogs pa'iḥrigs brgya'i bdag po dga' rab rdo rje niḥ dkar gsal longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs rdor dril 'dzinaḥ de steng chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen poḥ mthing gsal skyil krung mnyam bzhag phyag rgya canaḥ'aja' 'od lnga ldan thig le'i klong du sharaḥ sku gsum la ni brgyud gsum bla ma'i bskoraḥthugs rje'i 'od zer skal ldan bu la phyogasaḥkhams gsum srid las dbugs dbyung smin grol dmigasaḥ(ཿrang snang 'od gsal bde chen zhing khams nasaḥ skyabs

kun yongs 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ he ru ka dpal thang stong rgyal po'i tshulaḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren brgyud 'dzin byin gyis rlobasaḥ sa ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi sno trīX 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor laḥ lta ba mjal ba'i phyag 'tshal loḥ chos nyid mngon sum mchod pa 'bulaḥ nyams snang 'khrul ba ban bun bshagasaḥ gong 'phel don la rje yi rangaḥ rig pa tshad pheb chos 'khor bskoraḥ chos kun blo bral zad sar bsngoḥ sku gsum 'bras bu'i sa thob shogaḥ lan gsum gsol 'debs ni tsonamahoḥ ka dag spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nasaḥ chos sku'i bla ma kun bzang yab yum laḥ ye grol dgongs pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ 1 bral lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥ 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i pho brang nasaḥ longs sku'i bla ma dga' rab rdo rje la ༷ rang grol dgongs pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ zang thal ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ thugs rje ma 'dres rang gsal pho brang nasaḥ sprul sku'i bla ma thang stong rgyal po laḥ shar grol dgongs pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ rnam rgyal spyod pa 'byung par byin gyis rlobasaḥ rang rig 'od gsal

——14 ye shes lnga klong nasaḥ gnyug ma'i rig stong pad 'byung yab yum laḥ cer grol dgongs pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'degs: lhun grub 'bras bu thob par byin gyis rlobasaḥ gtsug tor ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang nasaḥ bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ gnyis med zung 'jug ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ rtog grol dus mnyam 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ snang zhen 'khrul ba bla ma'i dal du sadaḥ 'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs ye shes rdo rjer sminaḥ nges pa'i don mchog sgyu 'phrul dra bar rdzogasaḥ sku dang ye shes 'khor lo rab grol nasaḥ nang dbyings gting gsal bum skur byang chub shogaḥ ces dang e ma hoḥ gdod ma gzhi yi chos sku kun tu bzangaḥ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'changaḥ nges pa don gyi dbang phyug thang stong rgyalaḥ rang rig don stonabla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debasaḥ snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i bskyed rim dngaḥthugs yid gcig 'dres zab mo'i rdzogs rim gyisaḥ don dam ye shes bla ma'i sa thob shogaḥ ci 'grub brjodaḥ kyi ho dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi: phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'iḥ

bka' drin mtshungs zla las 'dasaḥ rang rig don gyi ston paḥ ye shes sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor: grub dbang thang stong rgyal poḥ snying nas gsol ba 'debs soḥ rtag tu dbyer med thugs rjesaḥ bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig: nam zhig lus sems bral tsheḥ mgon khyod pho nya sde bzhisaḥ 1 gar rol mo'i sgrar bcasaḥ mngon sum bsu ma byung nasaḥ mkha' 'dza'i gral la zhugs nasaḥ 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul zhing dbusaḥ rang rig bla ma'i zhabs drungaX thugs son sras su 'aX ra cingaḥ gang 'dul phrin las par gyuraḥ gdul bya'i zhing khams rgya mtshoraḥ mdzad pa mtha' yas 'gyed bzhin sku gsum dag pa'i zhing 'diraḥ 'god nas byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ mos gus tshad med pas ca nus bskyal dbang bzhi blang ba ni gu ru'i smin 'tshams nas 'od zer chu shel gyis mdog can byung nas rang gi dpral bar thimaḥ lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa sbyangasaḥ bum pa'i dbang thobaḥ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang sku rdo rje'i sa bon rgyud la bzhagaḥ snang stong mi shig pa'i ye shes mnyam su myong bar bsamaḥ yang mgrin pa nas 'od zer pad+ma ra ga'i mdog can byung ste rang gi mgrin par thimaḥ ngag dang rlung

—— ོ gi sgrib pa sbyangasaḥgasang ba'i dbang thobaḥrdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbangaḥgasal stong zung 'jug gi ye shes nyams su myong par bsamaḥyang thugs ka nas 'od zer be+eḍūr+ya'i mdog can byung nas rang gi snying gar thimaḥyid dang thig le'i sgrib pa sbyangasaḥshes rab ye shes kyi dbang thobaḥbade stong tsan+d+ra li bsgom pa la dbangaḥdaga' stong mi shig pa'i ye shes nyams su myong par bsamaḥyang lte ba nas 'od zer gser skud lta bu'i rnam par byung nas rang gi lte bar thimaḥsgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa sbyangasaḥdon dam tshig gi dbang thobaḥka dag khreg chod bsgom pa la dbangaḥrig stong blo bral gyi ye shes nyams su myong bar bsamaḥyang gu ru'i thugs ka nas 'od lnga'i zig le thig phran gyis brgyan par chad de rang gi snying gar thimaḥphra ba'i dri ma sbyangasaḥrig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob:lhun grub thod rgal bsgom pa la dbangaḥdabyings rig zung 'jug bzhi ldan gyi ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam slar rang nyid kyang 'od kyi thig le dmar por gyur nas gu ru rin po che'i thugs gar phaṭaḥgyis bsreḥ dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa' ngang du thugs yid mnyam par bsre la blo

bral rjen par bzhag goX de las ldang tshe dge ba bsngoḥ spon lam dri med yang yang gdabaḥ 'di nyid zab gnad dam pa ste skal ba can gyis dpal du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin shī la'i mtshan can gyis bkra shis lha reg shel bum sman gyis bkang ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang0 skal bzang thob pa k+ṣe dra rwa dzas mdzes ldan reg bya dang dar spos me tog bcas te nan tan gyis bskul ngoraḥ kho bo nus ldan bdud rnajoms rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las zhal bshusate dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni k+ṣe dra'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba maṅga lamaḥ

——— bla ma'i rnal wor ni āḥ rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i sangaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rdo rje dngosaḥ thang stong grub rgyal sgrug nag tshe bum 'dzinaḥ dbu sgra thor cog zar bu sku rgyab khrolaḥ dkar mjes sma ra kha spu zla ltar rgyasaḥ mthing sham gzan dkar 'od gsal sgom thag gsolaḥ 'ja' 'od gur sang gdos bral dwangs ma'i skuḥmakha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sprin dpung 'khrigs bzhin tuḥ mos ldan yongs la brtse bas gzigs par mosaḥ gsol 'debs niḥ bdud daphung 'joms mdzad sgrug nag khro bo'i skuḥ lta ba'i gdengs ldan brtul zhugs spyod pa skyongasaḥ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'gro ba yongs kyi mgonaḥ o rgyan lung bstan skyes mchog sprul pa'i skuḥ thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debasaḥ 'di phyi bar do kun tu thugs rjes zungasaḥ zhes snying khung rus pa'i gting nas: gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab na 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad lhun gyis grub par 'gyur ro ༷ dbang bzhi blang ba niḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dngaḥ rnam dbyer ma mchis thang stong rgyal po yiX gnas bzhir 'bru bzhi las spros 'od zer niḥ dkar dmar mthing ser rnam par thibs kyis byungaḥ

bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas sgrib tshogs dgaḥ bum gsang shel tshig dbang gis smin pa dngaḥ nang gsal bde rig stong pa'i ye shes mjalaḥ lam bzhi'i snod rung sku dang 'dzin gyiX go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba mchog thob dmigasaḥ mthar ni bla ma 'od zhu rang la thimaḥ smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin nyid kyi klongaḥ thugs yid dbyer med ngang la mapar ba'adonaḥ a āḥ de las ldang tshe dge ba bsngo smon lam gdab pa don gnyis 'grub0 sa mayāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thi4 zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin 'gyur med mos gus rgya mcho nas dar dang rin chen sna tshogs pashā bcas nan du bskul ngor nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam

ga rte lha snang lta ba gyad sku ni 0 aḥ blo 'das ye shes zang thal gnyug ma'i gshisaḥ ma bcos ye grol gu ru pad+ma 'byungaḥ nyag gcig sku dang ye shes phrin las rdzogasaḥ 'ub chub bde chen khyab brdal chos sku'i ngangaḥ tho badz+ra ma ha gu ru sarba sid+dhi 〉ཿ ye rdzogs ngo bo rig tsam grolaḥ dgongs pa zang thal don la gtadaḥ bskur thob bral ba'i lha zhal mjalaX rdzogs pa chen por e ma ho:samayā rgya rgya rgya 'gro mgon li lha'i gar bsgyur me dri'i ngor klong yangs sngags kyi ban dhe sur+yas bris ༷sarba maṅgalamaḥ dge'oḥtshogs la rol ba niḥhoḥ bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'dasaḥ rtsa gsum bla ma'i dgyes ston 'diḥ blang dor yid chos bral ba rtsa de bzhin nyid rol bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ ma hā su kha ga ṇa tsakra sidhi pha la a la la hoḥ 'di yang skal bzang zhing rgyam ngor ༷ 'dud 'joms nus ldan rdo rjes soḥ dge'o ༷

(27 snan brgyad rin po che'i sgon me lasaḥ bstan srang ma mgon lcam dral gyis gsol mchod phrin las lhan grub bzhags soḥr+shar+sha) dam ldan/ r+shar+sha la brtson pani hūṃḥ byeng ni'i phrin las myurdo ba'i phyiraḥsha khrag garter mardo chang skyema~Xḥ1bshams la sbyangs bsgyur zad med spelaḥ rarje nyid lha snyu nga rgyal gyis ༷ srung ma gsal bawa mchad bskang ni byed khrag mtsho lcags kyi ra ba canaḥ dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dalaḥ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nasaḥ 'bum phrag rgyud srung e ka dzaḥ mthing nag g.yu yi ral pa canaḥspyan gcig srid gsum sa ler gzigasaḥ tshems gcig zhing bcu'i srog la rngamasaḥ zhabs gnyis 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnonaḥ phyag g.yas rtogs med zhing lpags phyaraḥ g.yon phyag dgra snying lcags spyang 'gyedaḥ ma mo 'bum phrag 'khor gyis bskoraḥ dam la gnas shing bstan la gdungaḥ sgrub pa po yi sring gcig maḥ snying nas 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ dga' ston mchod gtor brngan bzhes laḥ a ti bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyisaḥ ting 'dzin rig pa'i ma ma mdzodaḥ mdun du ye shes mgon po niḥ legs ldan lcam dral bka' 'khor

brgyadaḥ gsang sngags rgyud srung gnyer 'dzin paḥ snying nas 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ sha khrag gtor skyems 'di bzhes laḥ gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur sgogaḥ der 'dzin 'dus sde smin grol mdzodaḥ g.yas su drang sgong ra hu laḥ dud kha dbu dgu bya gdong bcasaḥ king king thog ser bu yug 'tshubasaḥ gdong bzhi gza' brgyad rgyu skar bcasaḥ tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do byonaḥ ra yi sha gsur gtor skyems bzhesaḥ dngos su bsdo ba'i dgra bo rnamasaḥ kha rlang dug gi spu gris sodaḥ mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ g.yon du skyes mchog rdo rje lagasaḥ mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu niḥ bya seng ra skyes zhon pa'i dmagaḥ dam tshig can gyi 'bod lags naḥ rlungalasamagyogs pas da tshur byonaḥ mkhar thab bde sa bu'i mnyes pa bskangaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dngaḥ sems can phan bde spel bar mdzodaḥ rgyabatu dkor srung ngan ne+e maḥ dmar nag mi lpags g.yang gzhi lhubasaḥ g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon me longaḥ khrag gi rba klong 'tshus dbus 'gyengaḥ dur khrod brgyad kyi ngan ne maḥ sprul pa'i ming sring brgyad dang bcasaḥ 'bod do 'dir byon rten

——3 la bzhugasaḥ bka' 'khor sman btsun mched lnga dngaḥ bod skyongs bstan ma bcu gnyis sogasaḥ snyan brgyud bka' yi gnyer 'dzin rnamasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin duḥ bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byonaḥ zab gter bstan pa rin chen srungasaḥ der 'dzin 'dus sde dar rgyas mdzodaḥ bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis ldan gyisaḥ yangs pa'i rgyal khams mdzes pa dngaḥ 'ja' lus 'od sku tshom bu yiḥ chos sku'i gdul zhing smin grol nasaḥ kun bzang rgyal srid dbang 'byor shogaḥ tha tshig ma g.yelas ma.āḥ grangs bsogs dgyes bskang dga' ston 'bul phrin las rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub ༷ sam yā rgyargya 6 gu h+ya brda thi4 snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen zung gi bskur ngor kho bo rig 'dzinanus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pas yi ge pa ninasadralimatshan 'jin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaX sarba maṅga lam

—13 dag snang lasaḥ o rgyan sman gyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhugasaḥ—13 na mo gu ru yaḥ rkagirgadza/ ) khyed shes dad pa drag po yisaḥ gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par byaḥ.e ma hoḥ bde chen pad+ma gsung gi rdo rje niḥ dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma kun 'dus dpalaḥ o rgyan sman bla 'gro ba'i 'dren ston laḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ smon lam mtha' yas mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpalaḥ 'dod 'byung rin chen zla ba pad+ma'i zhalaḥ ma rig mun sel gser bzang dri med laḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs mya ngan med mchog dpalaḥ stong gsum chos kyi dpal sbyin chos rgya mtsho nyon mongs 'dams skems chos kyi blo gros zhabasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig shākya'i togaḥ ngan song dong sprugs

'phags pa skyabs grol mdzodaḥ mkhyen pa'i srid rtsa drung 'byin 'jam dpal dbyangasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang bdag lag na rjeḥ gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis dngaḥ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong thams cad laḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ lha mi sman gyi drang srong rig 'dzin tshogasaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can sman srungs tshogasaḥ pho nya yang g.yog bka' 'khor bcas pa laḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin pa dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol bar byin gyis rlobs: de ltar khyed shes dad pas gsol btab mthus sgo gsum snang zhen mtshan 'dzin rnam par dgaḥ lha sngags chos sku'i rol bar rtsal rdzogs shingaḥ nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur rab smin nasaḥ sprul pas gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren par regagaḥ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i miḥ mi mthun bdud kyi g.yul las rgyalaḥtsho ring nad med ci bsam 'grubaX bstan dang 'gro ba'i rgud sel 'gyuraX sam yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu h+ya brda thimaX3/ཿ zhes pa'ang smar gyi gnas mchog
ge rdo dag snang lasaḥ.o rgyan sman gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor phan bde'idapal ster bzhugasaḥ

r+shar+sha) du/sgrur 'o/ bde gshegs mched brgyad sras bcas kyisaX phrin las gcig bsdus ngo bo nyidaX thugs bskyed med byung o rgyan rjeXrnam 'byor sman gyi bla mar bsgrubaX sam yu skyabs sems niX na mo bde /rtenags mched brgyad r+shas bcas dam pa'i chos0 o rgyan sman gyi bla mar skyabs su mchiḥ 'du ba rnam bzhi gdon gsum rkyen gyis nadaḥ dus kyi rgud tshogs bsal bar sems bskyed doḥ tshogs bsags niḥ na mo tshogs zhing rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor laḥ gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba snying nas 'debasaḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod 'bul sdig lhung bshagasaḥ dge la yi rang mya ngan 'da' med bzhugasaḥ phan bde'i chos 'khor bskor phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bulaḥ rnam dkar dge tshogs 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal kun bral shogaḥ byin 'bebs ni hūṃ nyi shar phyogs gang gā'i 1nga mnyam zhing khams dang: rnga yab dpal ri mkha' 'gro 'du gling nasaḥ bcom ldan sman bla o rgyan rin po che'iḥ gnas 'dir byin phob byin rlabs dbang bskur zhigaḥ sems can las kyi mnar ba'i zug rngu canaḥ 'tsho byed bdud rtsi sman gyis gdung ba zhiḥ 'du ba rnam bzhi

——༷kā gdon gsum g.yul ngo lasaḥ rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs stsalaḥ sa ma hā bhe ṣa bye ra dzā sa ma ya phem phemaḥ mchod rdzas byin rlabs niḥ sa ā hūṃḥ dngos 'byer yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod sprinaḥ 'dodayon lha mo bkra shis rdzas rtags dkoraḥ ngo mtshar zhing bkod lta na sdug pa'i dpalaḥ skye med dbyings las 'gags pa med par spelaḥ 3 badz+ra pū dza spra ra ṇa dzaḥ lha bskyed niX hrīḥ stong dang snying rje'i rang mdangs 'od gsal zhingaḥ brda rtags bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dalaḥ ngo mtshar zhing gi rnam par thar ba niḥ shar phyogs blta na sdug pa sman gyi niḥ gzhal med khang bzang rgyan bkod mdzes bkrams dbusaḥ rin chen khri dang pad+ma zla ba'i kharaḥ o rgyan chen po sangs rgyas sman gyi bla:gser mdog zhi 'dzum langs tshos dpal gyis 'khyudaḥsngags phod chos gos mthing shams za ber klubasaḥ rig pa mi 'gyur gser gyi rdo rje bsdigaḥ bhan+ta 'chi med bdud rtsi a rus bkangaḥ sku las spros pa'i 'od zer brgyad ldan rtseraḥ mtshan legs dung ltar rin zla gser gyi mdogaḥ gser bzang dmar ser mya ngan med mchog dmaraḥ chos bsgrags shel 'od

chos blo rta bdun zhalaḥ sman bla be+eḍūr shāka thub btso bsregs mdangasaḥ'aphags pa skyabs grol smra ba'i dbang phyug rjeḥ mthu stobs rdo rje sde dpon bcu gnyis dngaḥ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyongs bcu la sogasaḥ lha mi sman gyi drang sgong rig 'dzin bcasaḥm 'dres dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar ltaraḥ gzi brjid lta ba'i chog mi shes par gsalaḥ 'ja' 'od dri bzang sbos sprin nam mkhar mnyamasaḥ dar gdugs 'phan yab bla bre lda ldi dngaḥrin chen ljoX bzang lo 'dabs 'bras bus spudaḥ bya dang ri dwags mu med chos la 'dud mtsho rdzing lding ga yan lag brgyad ldan chabaḥ gser phye nor bu'i kram pa g.yu'i rde'u singaḥcang shes glang po rma bya'i zlos gar bsgyuraḥ lha dang lha mo'i bstod bsngags glu dbyangs sgrogasaḥ mthong ba'i yid 'phrog lta na sdug par sharaḥ sgog gis bskul te dag pa'i gnas mchog nasaḥsangs rgyas sman bla sras bcas sbyan drangs bstimasaḥ spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hrīmatshungs med yid 'phrog rdul bral shar phyogs zhingaḥ mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling zangs mdog dpal ri nasaḥ o rgyan sman bla bde gshegs mched brgyad dngaḥ rigs gsum sems

shāshā dpa' gnod sbyin sde dpon tshogasaḥ dad pa'i mos ngor badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ skal ldan lus ngag yid gsum smin grol nasaḥ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod rgud pa zhi bar mdzodaḥbye ma ma hā gu ru bhe ṣa bye rā dzā sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol niḥhrīḥ chags pa'i rdul bral kā ma la yi kharaḥ nyon mongs gdung sel ri bong 'dzin pa'i stengaḥ rgyal ba'i sras mchog o rgyan sman gyi khyaḥ brtse bar dgongs te dad ldan mos ngor bzhugasaḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ phyag 'tshal ni na moḥ gang gi sku mchog be+e ḍūr+ya yi zhalaḥ gsung gsang bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i skom gdung zhi ༷ mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pas 'khor ba'i gnas yul stongaḥ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla mar phyag bgyi'oḥ sa ma ya na ma rdotsho mchod 'bul ni ༷ hūṃ hrīḥ ngo mtshar yid 'ong phyi nang gsang mchod sprinaḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna bdunaḥ 'dod yon lha mo mdzes pa'i gar dang bcasaḥ o rgyan sman bla'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bulaḥ 3 ma hā byu dza sa ma ya hoḥ bstod pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rdul gcig steng na rdul rnyed rgyal ba'i zhingaḥ ma lus 'gro ba'i 'dren ston mkhyen brtse'i gteraḥ byams dang brtse ba'i skal ldan bu bzhin

skyongasaḥ bde gshegs sman gyi bla mar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mtshan legs yongs bsgrags rin chen zla ba'i 'odaḥ gser bzang dri med rgyal ba mya ngan medaḥ chos bsgrags rgya mtsho chos kyi blo gros zhabasaḥ mi mjed zhing mgon shākya'i tog la bstodaḥ mkhyen nus brtse ldan 'phags pa rigs gsum mgonaḥ sde dpon bcu gnyis rgyal chen rnam pa bzhiḥ phyogs skyongs bcu dang lha mi'i drang sgong sogasaḥ sman gyis rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ smon lam ni 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i b.raḥ dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus thob cingaḥ rigs bzang blo gsal snying rje dag snang ldan 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba mang byed re gaḥ 'dzab bsnyen niḥhūṃ hrīḥ bdag mdun bcom ldan sman gyi bla mar gsalaḥ thugs gar hūṃ:la sngags phreng be+eḍūr+ya'iḥ 'od ltar 'tsher bas 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs nasaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi rgud pa zhiḥ lja mthun las kyi mnar ba'i gdung ba sbyangasaḥ mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams grol phyiraḥ bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i gsang gsum bsgrubaḥ na mo ma hā bhe ṣa byeḥ gu ru baiḍūr+yaḥ pra bha rā dzāyāḥ ta thāg ta yaḥ ahete samyakle bud+dha yaḥ

r+shar+sha) tadu shāḥ sa ste ṣa bye bheṣā bye ma hā bhe ṣa bye bheṣe bye ra dzās muṅga teswā hāḥ brgya stong khri 'bum gang skabs bzla ༷ 'du ba rnam bzhis nad sel zhing steng 'og bar gyi gdon rnams thubaX tshe ring nad rteX dru bsam 'grub 'di yi yon tan bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag rte long dang gsal sa masāḥ tshogs rdzas yo byad ci 'byor rigasaḥ dum gcig snod du bsags byas teḥ ro mnyam rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyisaḥ byin gyis brlabs pa 'di lta ste oṃ ā hūṃḥ bza' dang bca' ba btung ba bgoḥ 'dod yon lnga yi dga' ston niḥ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par spro: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes bskyed gyuraḥ37ཿāḥ( ha ho nyi badz+ra spa ra ṇa dzaḥ spyan 'dren 'bul bstabs niḥ hūṃ nyi bdegashegs bdun dang o rgyan sman gyi bla: sras dang bcas pa 'du ba tshogs la byonaḥ mkha' dbyings 'ja' khyims pad+ma zla steng bzhugasaḥ gzung ba dag pa'i phyi mchod tshogs la rolaḥ so thar rtsa lhung nyes byas phra rag bshagasaḥ nyan rang dgra bcom tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'dzin pa grol ba'i nang mchod tshogs la rolaḥ byang sems rtsa ltung dkar nag nyes skyon bshagasaḥ rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskangaḥ dug lnga cer grol gsang mchod

tshogs la rolaḥ gsang sngags rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags bshagasaḥ o rgyan sman bla'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ bdegashegs brgyad kyi thugs rjes ma 'dor skyongasaḥ rgyal chen sde bzhis bdud kyi dpung phams mdzodaḥ dug gsum rang grol phyogs skyongs tshogs la rolaḥ gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis thugs dam bskangaḥ lha misman gyi drang sgong dgyes pa bskyedaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaḥ sman srung pho mo dga' ston lhag la rolaḥ phrin las rnams bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa dngaḥrnam mangs 'gro la bdud rtsis bsil char 'bebs0 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams las grol nasaḥ langs tshos 'byor ldan yon tan lus thob shogaḥ lha tshogs 'phro 'du sems kyi chos nyid ngang gnyug ma 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i klong la bzhagaḥ snying rjes ngang nas sgyu ma lta bu'i skus: gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam byaḥ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas0 der 'dzin 'dus sde bshad sgrub 'khor lo 'phelaḥ rgyal khams bkra shis dge ba bcu la spyod: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i shis pa stsolaḥ de ltar tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul tshe bsod was

——1) rtogs yon ma 'phelaXs mayuXskabs su sman bsrung gsol mchod niḥdakar bgos 'o phud bzang drug sbyaraḥ sngags dang phyas rgyas spel byas te lhar gsal ting 'dzin bstan po yisaXbh+yoḥchos dbyings skye ba med pa'i klongaḥ 'gags bral 'od gsal pho brang nas sgyu 'phrul dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i grongasaḥ bde stong ro la rol ba moḥ sman srung lha mo ghaste maḥ ljang sngon mar gad zhal bzang canaḥ sman phor pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzinaḥ khu sbrang g.yu 'brug 'khyil gling rolaḥ rat+na 'dod rgu'i char ba 'bebasaḥ sangs rgyas bstan la lhag par gdungasaḥ zab gsang gnas kyi srung ma byedaḥ rnam mangs phrin las thog med sgrubaḥ snying nas 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ pad zla'i gdan la rtse bas bzhugasaḥ dam tshig gcig 'dres brda phyag 'tshalaḥ dkar bshams 'o phud sman sna'i mchodaḥ chos mthun 'dod dgu'i bzhed don sgrubasaḥ 'gro la phan bde'i gsos sman thobasaḥ kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub nadaḥ 'du ba bzhi dang gdon gsum gribaḥ ma lus gso ba'i phrin las stsolaḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gdung zin zhing: gzhan don 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ dam la ma 'da' sa ma yuḥde ltar phul bas 'dod don

'grub tshe chos bsod nams dpal nor 'byer sa ma yāḥ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi dbangaḥsnod ldan rnams la sbyin pa la sgo gsum dri ma khrus kyi sbyangasaḥtho mtshams bgegs bsal srung gur phub bden don bshad la maṇ+ḍal phulaḥdang po gsol ba gdab pa ni kyeḥ kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin paḥ dpal ldan bla ma brtse bas dgongasaḥ bdag cag skal ldan pho mo laḥ o rgyan sman bla'i dbang bskur stsolaḥ lan gsum bla mas e maḥ 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo laḥ o rgyan sman bla'i dbang dgos naḥ 'gro ba'i don la brtson nus samaḥ byams dang snying rje bskyed dam :ཿ tshogs bsags sdom bzung ni bye dkon mchog kun dngos bla ma dngaḥ o rgyan sman bla brtse bas dgongasaḥ bdag gis sgo gsum 'bul lo bzhes0 nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyiḥ khyed shes dad pas gus phyag 'tshalaḥ 'gro phan mdzad par rjes yi rang gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskulaḥ dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ thugs rjes nyer bzhes rjes su zungasaḥso thar sdom bzung gzhan gnod spangasaḥ byang sems sdom bzung gzhan phan sgrubasaḥ gsang ba sngags spyod dag mnyam khyeraḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i sdomaḥ ma lus yongs su

/(11 'dzin bgyid na: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsolaḥ lan gsum dam chu sbyin pa niḥkyiḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ 'jug pa'i skal ldan pho mo rnams 'gro ba'i don la legs brtson phyiraḥ dam tshig zung mdzod chu 'di 'thungaḥ sa maya gis nar gaṇaḥ mig dar bkab la me tog byinaX slob ma lha gsal ye shes dbab ༷ de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol/rig me dor zhing 'dong ba bsal/ lha ngo bstan la rnam dag bshadaḥthog mar bum dbang sbyin pa niXs hrī stong gsal bum pa'i gzhal yas suḥ o rgyan sman gyi bla ma bzhugasaḥ bde gshegs mched brgyad gzi byin 'khyugasaḥ zag med ye shes bdud rtsi 'bebasaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ 'du ba rnam bzhis nad sna tshogs: byed mongs gcung nad grol gyur cigaḥ rtsa sngagasamathar kwa yas bhiṣithungasaḥ sman bla'i sku'i dbang bskur ba niḥ hūṃ hrī grangs sted gong nas thugs bskyed ldanaḥ bgrang yas byang chub sems dpa'i bskoraḥ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nad selaba'iḥ o rgyan sman bla'i dbang bskur roḥ lus ngag yid sgrib dag pa dngaḥ mtshan thos 'khor ba dong sprugs shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya.a bhiṣiltasaḥ gsung bdud rtsis dbang niX / hrī

mdzes pa pad+ma'i yol ko dzas zag med yid bzhin bdud rtsis bkangaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad grol gyur cigaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥwak+kas bhiṣinyug gzungs sngags bris pas dbang bskur ba niḥ ( hrīḥ bcom ldan 'tsho mdzad sman gyis rgyalaḥ be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od kyi gzungasaḥ skyobs byed dam pa chos kyi dbangaX skal ldan rnams la yong rjogs thegagaḥ rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a bhi ṣinyur āḥ thugs me long dbang ni hūṃ hrīX dwangs gsal dri ma'i ma gos paX me long 'od gsal 'gags med gzugasaḥ rig dang rang snang dbyeng med pa:don gyi 'od gsal mjal ba'i dbangaḥ skal ldan bu la yong rdzogs shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥcit+ta a bhi ṣi: byeḥ a ru gtad la hūṃ nyi nyon mongs las kyi gcung nad dngaḥ 'du ba rnam bzhis nad rnams lasaḥ grol byed a ru ra yi dbangaḥ skal ldan bu la sbyin par bgyiḥ ldan 'dus nad las grol gyur cigaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥrtsit+ta.a bhiṣithu ༷༷ཿ mtha' rten gtad cing dam khas blangasaḥ yon 'bul gus dbul shis pa brjodaX 'gro ba nyon mongs nad las grolaX tshe ring ci bsam 'dod don 'grubaḥs mayuḥ dus kyi nyigs mar gyur pa na gnam nad tsha ba 'bar dgu sdang sa nad khol ba gzer gas g.yo

byed — chen 'chang dbang la:'dzin rtog spros bral kun snang mchod pa 'bul:ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir phyag 'tshal lo:sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyabs tu gsol:sgron ma rnam bkod zhing la dbang bsgyur shog:mkhyen pa'i srid rtsa drung 'byin ral gri 'dzin:brtse chen 'khor ba dong sprugs pad dkar 'chang:nus pa'i bdud dpung zil gnon rdo rje 'dzin:byang chub thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i gter de la:'dzin rtog spros bral kun snang mchod pa 'bul:ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir phyag 'tshal lo:sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyabs tu gsol:rang snang dag pa'i zhing la dbang bsgyur re ga:legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig gsang srog 'chang:tshangs dbang rgyal chen gnod sbyin sde dpon sogs:phan bde'i 'byung gnas rang grol 'khor rnams la:'dzin rtog spros bral kun snang mchod pa 'bul:ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir phyag 'tshal lo:sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyabs tu gsol:tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro khams dong sprugs re ga:gang 'dul rmad byung sprul pa'i zhing khams na:lha mi sman gyi drang srong rig 'dzin

sogs: nyon mongs gcong 'byin thugs rje'i sman 'gyed la: 'dzin rtog spros bral kun snang mchod pa 'bul: ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir phyag 'tshal lo sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyabs tu gsol: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i zhing la dbang bsgyur shog: bde gshegs sman gyi zhing sbyangs 'di bsgom mthus: sems can las ngan sgrib pa'i rgyun bcad nas: 'khor ba dong sprugasardul bral zhing khams su: dag smin rdzogs par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol: de nas sngags kyi dkyil gaborani: rgo na mo bha ga wa te: gu ru be+eḍār+ya pra bha rā dza ya:ta thā ga ta ya: arnya te samyakle brnya ya: tadu thā: aḥbhe ṣa bye bhe bye ma hā be ṣa bye rā dza sa muṅga te ye swā hā: sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bskul te bde bar gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer spros te 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dang: nad gdon sdug bsngal zug ngu ma lus pa bsal te bde gshegs mched brgyad kyi skyabs 'og tu tshud la thugs rje brtse ba chen pos zin par bsam: rjes chog mchod bstod gshegs bsdu dang shes brjod bya ba 'di lta ste: nyu hrīḥ gzung

byed 'dzin dag pas phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: bde gshegs 'dus zhal sman gyi dal du 'bul: tshogs brgyad rgyu ba dhu tir ro gcig pas: bde gshegs sras 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha tshogs mi dmigs rang rig chos skur bsdu: 'jig rten byed po dam tshig las la gnyer phyi nang 'byung ba'i rtsod bral 'khrug slong zhi: nad gdon sdug bral bde legs bkra shis regag: gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam sogs shis brjod byas la mtha' brgyan no: sa mayu tha tsa rgya: 'di nyid bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad las grol: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs las rgyal: tshe bsod bkrag mdangs 'byung khams rgyas ban bon rmugs 'thibs dri ma zhi: rtsa rlung thig le'i khams dbang bsgyur mi mthun nyer 'che'i phyogs kun 'joms: 'di las byin rlabs che ba med: snying 'dra'i yang zab srog tig 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma.ā: o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po yis: sgrub gnas dpal gyi tsa ri nas: 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsā la: gces nor stsal ba ma 'ongs dus 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir: mdo khams phyogs su dgongs pra btab: maṇ+ḍal gu h+ya rgya sa ma yā rgya rgya gyo brda thim:snyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan chos gsal gyis lha reg dri bral 'gro ba'i srog skyobs kyi rten 'brel che ba'i skyes bcas bskul ngorabadag 'dra dpa' bo
bdud 'dul rdo rjes mdo khams dreg gtso klu btsan dbang mo ches sprad pa'i brda ris las phab pa'i yi ge pa nikun bzang skor bus bgyis pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅgalam/

byedaza zab tig rdo rje'i phreng ba las: bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i rjes gnang 'chi med gter bcud bzhugs:21za na 31 gu 〈co che: zagaston11sgo bdegs gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: phrin las gcig bsdus sman gyi bla sgrub pas nad sel lang tsho dar: bkra shis phun sum tshogs par 'gyur thog mar rjes gnang 'di thob gal: de yang mchod chog rgyas par bya: las bum sgrub la rnam 'joms kyi gzungs khrus phyi ltar rgya cher bya slob ma gral 'khod maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kyaiḥ skyabs ga༄/ma kun 'dus bla ma dgongs: bdag ni 'di nas byang chub bar: dus min 'chi dang nad gdon rkyen: bkra mi shis pa kun zhi zhing: tshe dpal bkrag mdangs 'phel ba dang : chos mthun bsam pa mthar phyin phyir bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma yi: rjes gnang dam pa stsal du gsol: lan gsum rjes su lan gnang ba: kye hoḥ mi shes 'dam las rnam grol zhing: ye shes chen po'i khams rnams kun: smin zhing grol bar 'dod pa rnams: skyabs sems sdom bzung dam tshig srung: de nas lam la 'jug pa ni: na moḥ 'di bzung ji srid byang chub bar dkon mchog

gsum la skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba'i don du sems mchog bskyed: lus ngag yid gus phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri kun bshags bsod nams dge la rjes yi rang: gang 'dul phan bde'i chos 'khor bskul: rgyal kun mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: so thar sdom bzung gnod sbyor spangs: byang chub sems bzung phan bde sgrub: gsang sngags dam srung lhar sgrub brtson: de sogs khas blang rim pa rnams: srog gtar 'dzin no sa ma ā: de nas slob ma lhar bzhengs ni: hūṃ bisne ta krid ta phaṭa: skad cig gi slob ma rnams bder gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs gzi 'od reg pas gdos mtshan gyi dngos po thams cad stong par sbyang ste: dag chen ye shes kyi 'khor masar sad nas bder gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang rnam dbyer med par mos la: ye shes dbab bstim bya: de nas bder gshegs mched brgyad gyi sku gtad la: hūṃ hrī dus gsum kun tu byon pa yi: bder gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: gcig bsdus sman gyi bla ma yi: dbang mchog dam pa bskur bgyi'o: rgyu brgyad sems kyi spros pa

byedatho dag: 'byung ba brgyad 'khrugs nad bsal nas: theg brgyad sa lam mthar phyin te: bder gshegs mched brgyad sku thob regag: gzungs sngags mthar: bhudha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma: sku yi rjes gnang ngo: de nas gsung po ti dang sman sna gtad la 'di skad do: hūṃ hrī: dam chos ma lus 'dus pa'i gsung: nyon mongs nad sel sman gyi rgyud: bde legs 'byung gnas brgyad brgya ba: dngos grub gter gyi dbang bskur ro: 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi: zug rngu nad sel mthu thob shog: : trīḥ dug gsum nad sel 'gro ba'i sman: rnam rgyal 'bras sman a ru ra: tshad pa'i gnyen po ga bur dang: bsil sel dza ti pha la dang: mkhris pa'i rkyen 'joms gi waṃ sman: klu gnyan rkyen 'joms gla nag rtsi rims yam kun 'joms spru nag lnga: glo ba'i nad sel cu gang dang: mchin mtsher gsos byed skyu ru dang: sug smel dri ro nus ldan pa: 'byung khams gsos byed a dṛ ta: myong grol kun 'dus dam rdzas kyi: rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pas: kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub nad ma lus byang zhing dag pa dang: dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa

yi: bla med nus mthu dpal thob re ga: gzung sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: gsung gi rjes gnang ngo: de nas rdo rje dang lhung bzed gtad la: hūṃ hrīḥ 'gyur med bde ba mthar phyin zhing: ye shes yon tan sku thob phyir: 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje che: dngos grub dpal stsol bdud rtsi'i bum: thugs mchog phyag mtshan zung 'jug gi: rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: ma rig gnyis snang dri bral nas: mkhyen brtse nus dpal thob par de ga: gzung sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: thugs kyirjes gnang ngo: de nas rigs gsum mgon po'i sku gto la: hūṃ hrīḥ mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa'i stobs: gcig bsdus byang chub sems dpa'i zhal: kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i mgon po yi: rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa yis: 'gro ba'i phan bde spel nus pa'i byang chub spyod mchog mthar phyin re ga: gzung sngags mthar: gu ṇa a bha ṣiñtsa tre yon ma gyi rjes gnang ngo: de nas rgyal chen dang gnod sbyin gyi sku gtad la: hūṃ hrīḥ tshad med rnam pa bzhi ldan pa'i sbyor dang sgrol ba thabs sna tshogs: phan bde 'byung ba'i mdzad mkhas pas: 'gro ba byang chub sar 'god phyir: phrin las stobs kyi dbang bskur ro:

byedadza thogs med nus pa'i dpal thob thegag:gzung sngags mthar karma a dzhai 〉(21:phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo:de nas smon lam rnam dag gdab:shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor:dga' ston byed la rol mo sgogs:gnad des tshe dpal lang tsho 'phel nad gdon zug rngu kun las rgyal:the tshom med dos maphu:rgya rgyargya:gu phyabarda:ma:snyiḥces pa 'di'ang dad ldanachos gsal gyis bskul ngor:gter ming nus ldan pas smras te yi ge pa nidharma ku mud do:sarba maṅga le/

gab pa'i smon lam ni:na mo dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo:bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams sgrog 'tshal lo:deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i sku yi rjes gnang rtsal ba'i mthus:'byung ba bzhi las gyur ba'i phung po khams dang skye mched bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis mi tshugs par gyur cig:stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs sogs kyi mi tshugs par gyur cig:'byung ba'i khams thams cad dar zhing rgyas par gyur /:tshe ring bar gyur cig:bkrag 'phel bar gyur cig:mdangs rgyas par gyur cig:longs spyod mnga' thang gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: rga 'o:skal gyi bu rnams la bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang bskur ba'i mthus:ngag dang rlung khams nyi khri chig stong drug brgya las su rung bar gyur cig:las kyi/ su 'gro zhing mdangs stobs bkrag gzi 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig:khams rnams smin zhing 'phel bar gyur cig:gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'byed nus par gyur cig

gang 'dul phan bde'i char gyis 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin nus par gyur cig: tsha) 'o: skal ldan gyi sgob ma rnams la bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i thugs kyis rjes gnang sbyin pa'i mthus: sems nyon mongs pa'i rtogs tshogs phra rags thams cad zhi ba dang bde legs su gyur cig: phan pa dang byams sems su gyur cig: gnyis rtog gi mdud pa rang sar grol bar gyur cig: chags sdang gi ri bo bsnyil bar gyur cig: ma rung ba'i gdug rtsub thams cad byang bar gyur cig: stong nyid snying rje chen po dang ldan pas 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin nus par gyur cig: gdul bya smin zhing grol bar mdzad nas rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su mnga' dbang bsgyur nus par gyur cig:sgri 'o:skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i yon tan gyi rjes gnang bskur ba'i mthus: nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: byams pa chen po dang ldan te 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin nus par gyur cig: brtse ba chen po dang ldan pas 'gro khams yongs su zin par gyur cig: nus pa chen po dang ldan te gdul bya'i khams rgya mtsho lta bu dong

byedaza nas sprugs nus par gyur cig: dza'izo 'o: skal ldan skyes bu rnams la bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma'i phrin las kyi rjes gnang gtad pa'i mthus: 'jigs pa'i tshogs thams cad ming gi lhag mar gyur te zhi zhing stong par gyur cig: legs chogs dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: khams gsum mos pa rnam bzhi dbang du 'dus la dam pa'i chos kyi lam la sbyor nus par gyur cig: ma rig gnyis snang gi dgra bgegs thams cad chos nyid kyi dbyings su sbyor nus par gyur cig: phrin las rgya mtsho lta bu'i dpal la mnga' dbang 'byor nus par gyur cig: sarba puṣ+ṭisidhi pha la nyuhrīḥ ces dang shes brjod rgya chen bya:'de yang nye bar mkho ba'i phyir nus ldan rdo rjes phabapa'o dge'o/ legs sosarba maṅga lam/
badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub pa'i khog phubabe+eḍūr+ya'i bla bre bzhugs soḥ

btsardo namo gu ru pad+ma ra dza yaḥ girnyiñtsāsnyedzaX sgrub gnas g.ya' brag gangs khrod dmaX gong ma'i zhabs bcag byin rlabs saX nyi zla 'char snga nub phyi zhingaX mdun du chu shing na ba rgyas srungs bzhi'i bkod paphun tshogs deraḥ sa bslang dkar phyogs skyong ba brngan nag phyogs lha srin dam 'og bcugaḥ bar chad bgegs bsal srung gur phub ༷ sgrub rdzas yo byad gang 'os bsagasaḥ maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi byaḥ rdul tshon ras bris tshom bu ni/spros pa rang dang 'tshams par byedaX sku rten bum pa gsung bdud rtsi gtor ma sgrub phur sku 'bag sogasaX zhal shes ltar du legs par bkodaḥ phyi nang mchod pa rgya cher bshamasaX rgyu 'grul mtshams bcad dam rgya sdoms de nas dam tshiga'adzin pa ni ma ma hā badz+ra hūṃ: dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha hūṃḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa sa ma ya ho sa ma ya stumaḥ zhes sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'dzin rol mo byin mas niḥhūṃ hrī snang ba thabs dang shes rab stong pa nyidaḥ zung 'jug rtsal mdangs grags stong rol mo'i rigasaḥ kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston mtha' yas paḥ khams gsum chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgras khyab gyuraḥ sa sarba ta thā ga ta shabha spra ra ṇa kheḥ bsang chu byin rlabs niX :: t+t+waṃ las thar ba chen po'i gzhal med khangaḥ tshad dang mtshan nyid bkod pa phun tshogs dbusaḥ / las khro bo bgegs 'thar

btsa(rnya bdud rtsi 'khyilaḥ khro mo rlung 'byin zung 'jug rol pa lasaḥrdo rje'i rdul 'khrugs rnam rtog bdud bgegs rnamasaḥ 'thar zhing gzhom par byed pa'i mthu ldan gyurargyahūm̐ bhiganata krota tshin+dha tshin+ta hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig brjod lha nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol par dmigasaḥ mchod rdzas byin rlabs niḥ hūṃ bhisnanata krita phaṭaḥ dmigs med stong pa chos sku'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub rang gsal 'gags med rol pa'i rgyanaḥ gzung ba dag pa'i phyi mchod nyer spyod bdunaḥ 'dzin pa grol ba'i 'dod yon rnam pa lngaḥ dug gsum gnad stong sman raka gtor chen poḥ mdzes sgegs rdo rje'i rigs ma bcu drug dngaḥ tan gaṇa brtul zhugs glu gar bro yi dpalaḥ rol pa chen po'i dga' ston mtha' yas paḥdabyings las bton te ye shes dbyings su 'bulaḥ bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis dam pa yongs rdzogs gyuraḥ yin sarba ta thā gta sam ri wa rabadz+ra pūdza megha sa mu traspa raṇa sam yasgadza/0 sbos byung ni0 a ཿ chos kyi dbyings las byung ba'i phyag rgya moḥ spos kyi sprin spro dri bzang mkha' khyab spelaḥ rlung sems las nyon bag nyal dri ma kunaḥ mi gnas de bzhin nyid du sang byed cing

mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dgongs pas 'gro don bskulaḥ mdzad pa phrin las mi mjed zhing khyab gyuraḥ bla badz+radhu pepra tits+tsha byudza meg samu traspra raṇa sam ma.āḥ (ཿ skyabs yul gsalagadab ni rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i klongaḥ skyabs kun yongs 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal po'i tshulaḥ ma 'dres yongs rdzogasamatshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar g.yas phyogs skal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stongaḥ rgyab tu lung rtogs dam chos gleg bam tshulaḥ g.yon du nye sras byang sems rgya mtsho'i bskor mdun ngos yi dam sgrub rgyud sprin phung 'khrigasaḥbar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa skal ldan bu la phyogasaḥ byang chub snying po thob parasrung (rdobs dmigasaḥ skyabs sems tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal phul mthar ཿdzags zheng rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyuraḥ rang nyid snying rje'i dbang phyug gsal dkar dmaragator ma 'bul ba ni ༷ bsang sbyangs byas la 'di skad doḥrin chen mjes pa'i snod mchog yangs pa dzas dkar dmar gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur:yin gisahūṃ nam mkha' mdzod sngags a ka ros

—40 zag med ye shes bdud rtsir spel pad+ma rgyal po'i nga rgyal gyisaḥ hūṃ dzaḥ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma saṃ bha wa'iḥ spyan sngar khas blang mna' bor dam mnos pa'iḥ pho mo ma ning 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten khams 'di naḥ sa la nga che gnas la ngas bdag rnamasaḥ tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do gnas 'dir byonaḥ zhi ba byang chub sems dang ldan bzhin pasaḥ bdag gis gnas 'dir byang chub sgrub pa laḥ ko ma nga ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad paraḥ rin chen gter gyi sa 'di gnang bar zhuX dgra jag chom rkun nyer 'tshe med pa dngaḥ nad dang gnod pa 'khrugs rtsod zhi byas phyiraḥ gtsang sbyar gser skyems dkar dmar gtor ma bzhesaḥ gnas mdza na lta bu'i dam tshig la gnas pa'iḥsgrub pa zab mo dbu nas mthar phyin par: srungs mtshams ma g.yel gang 'dod phrin las sgrubasaḥ snyed 'o/ ka pā la e rda bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā rti gtor skyems gtsang sar mchod cing gshegs bgegs la chang glud bsngo ba ni oṃ h+ya sbyo wa hrīḥ zhes brjod pas rang nyid gzhi las bzhengs pa'i dbang chen he ru ga'i skur gyuraḥ hūṃḥlas rin po che'i sgod du oṃ las glud gtor

'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyuraḥ byas āḥhūṃḥ sam bha ra dang a ka rosaX zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor spelaX na moḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bskru ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthusaḥ sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bskul ba'i gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad bu lon 'jal ba'i mgron du 'dus shigaḥ sarba :snan a po ya dzaḥ nga( baṃ ༄6 lan gsum gyis ni 'gugs bstims byaḥslar yang glud gtor bsngo ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bde btagags rin chen mang dang niḥ gzugs mdzes 'jam klas 'jigs kun bralaḥ de bzhin btagags pa'i sbyi stobs dngaḥ chos dbyings rnams par dag pa dngaḥ ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrul: blud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan 'diḥ bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas gyur paḥ bgegs rgyal bī na ya ga dang: gtsug lag khang gi gdon chen bcuḥ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dngaḥ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dngaḥ 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya poX nad rim dal yams bdag po rnamasaḥ lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron du 'dusaḥ rang rang yid mthun glud gtor longasaḥ lus ngag yid gsum mgu bar byosaḥ gnod 'che'i bsam sbyor mi byed paraḥ

gtsar+sha phan dang byams sems la gnas teḥ rgyal sras 'phags pa'i rjes su slobaḥ las ngan rnam smin mi gsogs paraḥ gsar ba srid pa'i pha mthar du: 'gro bar gyis shig gtor mgron rnamasaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir 'tshe ma byedaḥ gal te skabs lta glegs tshol naḥ khre bo khro mos nam mkha' gangaḥ mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshubasaḥ yungs dkar rdo rje'i thun char 'phroḥ 'dre 'jigs dug gi na bun 'thibaḥ khyod kyilus sems bral bar byedaḥ de bas ma 'dug phyir dengs shigaḥ sarba bhisnanagats+tsha hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab srung ba'i gur khang 'gyur med gdab byin bskul bya ba 'di lta ste0 rang (risnying kha'i 'od zer gyisaḥ dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcasaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam las bskul teḥ sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs byas phyiraḥ phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyiḥ rnams par spyan drangs bdag mdun dngaḥ sgrub rdzas yo byad rnams la bstimasaḥ zhing dang lha sngags chos nyid dngaḥ myong grol yeshes bdud rtsi rtsa byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsolaḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya saḥ de nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab niḥ hūṃḥ 'og min dag pa'i gnas mchog nas
