rigs lnga yab yum sras dang bcasaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs teḥ rin chen bum pa bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ kha dog lnga ldan rnam par dbabaḥ sgrub mchog rnams kyi spyi bor sim sku gang nyon shes dri ma dgaḥ 37 sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya mṛ ye hūṃḥ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud deḥ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab nyid gyur phyiraḥ snang ba mtha' yas gtsor gyur pa'iḥ bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyuraḥ e saḥ.āḥhūṃḥnya hūṃḥ māṃḥphe bye rta slar yang spyo mgrin snying kha dzaḥ zla pad nyi ma'i snyid po laḥ rnam snang mtha' yas mi skyod pa'iḥ sku gsung thugs su rgyas gdab poḥ sa āḥhūṃ kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ ( ༷ dam tshig hre ga gi yi ge lasaḥ 'od zer lcags kyu ltar spros teḥ dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pad+ma rgyal po'i rnam pa dzas mtsho la kha char bab pa ltaraḥ gnyis su med par ro gcig bsreḥ sa khya ho: sa ma ya phoḥ dzaḥ/ be hoḥ phreng ba byin rlabs niḥsarba dharmāg ga na āḥ rin po che'i phreng ba ni dpa' bo thabs dpa' mo shes rab ging ling ga rnam bde stong rol pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 'jug mdzad par mos laḥ dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum brjod ma

gas/ ru tsi ra ma pra warta na ye swā hāḥ nyer gcig brjod lame tog 'thoraḥthams cad kyi sku yis gar mdzad cing zhal nas sngags sgra sgrogs la thugs bde ba chen poliye shes su spyod par mos la: bsnyen sgrub las gsum 'dzab dbyangs gyer0 gang 'dod phrin las thob med 'grubaḥs mapāḥ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs pa ni re ye khoḥ ste nga pa'i ngang las rlung me thod byed kyi khar atshipas ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang duḥ gtor rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin laḥ dngos po dgra bgegs sha khrag rus gsum ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud :ཿ rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung poḥ lha klu mi yi dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa chos skyongs rang rang gi yid spyod dang mthun par gyuraḥ sa ā hūṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ ༷skopo lan gsum 0( ā:hūṃ ma hā rak+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ༅ཿ lan gsumaḥ yis aḥm hā bha ling hūṃ trī ba lan gsumaḥ yid āḥñtsam hā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ba༄/ tabasha ro tsa na keng ni ri ti badz+ra pū dza spa ra ṇa khaṃḥ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer glog 'byug pa ltar 'phros teḥ rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams

snyen drangasaḥ skye badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du brdas bskul ba niḥhoḥ dgongs su gsol loḥ bde chen spros pa dang bral ba zla gam pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nasaḥ ston pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyal po pad+ma rā dza thugs ye shes ting nge 'dzin las 'gro ba'i mos ngor brtse ba mchog gis dgongs su gsolaḥ deng 'dir phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi sgrub pa zab mo la thugs nyams rtse gcig tu bzhes pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams kyisaḥ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rdzogs pa'i slad duḥ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bla na med pa gzhung bzhin tu bshams lags na bzhes par ci gnangaḥ rdo rje rgyal pos brda lan niX hoḥ las kyi slob dpon rdo rje rgyal thebs garma mi tra dbyangs kyi 'gyur gdangs ba las byed gdong 'khrigs phyag tshang brda spyor 'tsho ba'i g.yos sbyor ba sogs 'dir 'dus shing 'tshogs pa rnams dad dang gus pas gsan du gsolaḥ deng bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po 'dir 'byor ldan yo byad ni bsagasaḥ sems bskyed phun tshogs kyis drangasaḥ thabs mang sla ba la brtenaḥ ro mnyam dgongs spyod la gnasaḥ dad sogs

btsa/ ting nge 'dzin spro: dngos zhen re dogs kyang bor: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin dang bral bar 'bul lags na bzhes par gnang ngoḥ kun gyisaX a la la hoḥ chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' la: lha klu mi yi dga' ston tshogasaḥ ngo mtshar bkod pa phun sum tshogasaḥ dam tshig nyams chags bskang phyir 'bulaḥ rdo rje slob dpon brtse bas bzhesaḥdakyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ bskang rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni oṃ sarba rnyarma ga ga na āḥ mkha' dbying rnam par dag pa'i klong du phyi nang gsang ba'i tshog ston bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna nye ba'i rin chen mchod bskangs brten sgrub kyi rdzasaḥ lha klu mi yidapal 'byor 'dod dgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyuraḥ nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum dang rten snying brjod la spel bar bya'oḥ tshogs bsgral ni tshogs byedad lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang duḥ tshogs rdzas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal laḥ na moḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang:

khams gsum zil gnon gyi rgyal po gu ru pad+ma ra dza'i sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa chen po'i mthusaḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra sde thar lam la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cigaḥ dza3 baṃ hoḥ lhag gtor byin gyis rlabs pa niX re ye kheḥ bhardze stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du lhag gtor sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por gyuraḥ sa āḥshā ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum ༷ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ ha ho gyilhag mgron rdo rje'i gsang srog 'chang ba'i pho nya rnams 'du ba chen po pham phab kyi dga' ston la gshegs shig byon zhig: e a ra li hring tring phe thoḥ bskul ba niḥ atshipas bhan+ta lcang lo can yang shing rgya che ba'i nang du: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba ngo bo zag med ye shes kyis bdud rtsir gyuraḥ sa ā0stsi lan gsum ༷ chad mdo byin rlabs ni rdo rje sgog ldan bka' sdod pho nya'i dmags tshogs rnams la thugs dang mthun pa'i chad mdo bka'i gtor ma ting 'dzin 'phrul gyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyuraḥ bstan gtor

badz+ra tsu byin rlabs niḥ rin po che'i snod du dkar mngar sman gyi phung po 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i skyems mchod thugs mthun dgyes bskangs kyi bdud rtsir gyuraḥ sa usno lan gsumaḥbro dmigs niX ma ga rtogs dam sri 'gab 'dre thams cad mnan par bsamaḥn mos skyabs gnas mdza ga gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthusaḥ sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i log rtogs dam sri 'gab 'dre thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol du khug cigaḥ lan gsumaX dzahūṃ baṃhoḥ rje buku rutri trihur t+t+waṃdzaḥ log rtogs dam sri 'gab 'dre bse reg dbul sri pho mo thams cad tri a po ya dza dzaḥ sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri 'gab 'dre khugaḥtri'u tri'urwa dzadun tingananaḥbase mo yak+ka rbadaḥ the'u rang 'byung po nanaḥ sakru marta ni3 dza jitri nirtu dza katri nihūṃ dza shatri ni/ dze+e rutri ni3 dza na sha yakhrug shāga3 phaṭatsat+tarak+ṣaswā hāḥ gtor snod btegs pa'i tshe spyoḥ pad+ma'i yol ko stong gsum dang mnyam paraḥ phan bde'i dge mtshan bkra shis pa'i char gyis yongs su gang bar gyur cigaḥ sarba.a yupur+bhepūṣ+ṭiku ruyeswā hā mchod dmigs ni

bdag bskyed lasaspros pa'i 'dod yon gyis lha mo nam mkha' gang bar spros teḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams pad+ma gsung gi dal du 'bul bar dmigasaX lamachodaḥbastod dmigs ni 'dod pon gyilha mo mdzes sdug blta ba chog mi shes pa grangs med pasaḥ sku dam tshig gi phyag rgyaḥ gsung chos kyi phyag rgyaḥ thugs ye shes kyi phyag rgya bca' ba las kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bstod pa rgya chen po phul bar bsamaḥ la bstod0 slar 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams bdag bskyed kyi gnas so sor thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsamaḥ bgagasadamigasani ho bde ba mchog gi 'byungaganas 'khor 'das yongs kyi dbang phyug gu ru pad+ma rgyal po thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsolaX deng gi sgrub pa zab mo'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir ta na ga ṇa gnas su ma stobs pa dngaḥ lus ngag yid kyis nongs pas phyi so thar gyi bcas khrims dang 'gal baḥbar byang sems kyibaslabs bya dang ma ldan paḥ gsang ba sngags kyi lta dgongs zab mo dang 'gal 'das zhig ral chags nyams ci song ba thams cad mi 'chab mi sbed par gnong

ba tshu zhing 'gyed sems dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bshags sbyangs byed lags naḥ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bar tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ skyo āḥhūṃḥbadz+ra sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi āḥ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la lhag chad bskang bar bya'o0 shis brjod kyi dmigs bsdus ni:rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul teḥ lha klu mi yi drang sgong bden par grub pa rnams dngaḥ bkra shis pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam paḥ tshangs dbang mig stong ldan pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i dgematshan brjod cing phyag nas me tog man+ta ra ba'i char chen po bsnyel bar dmigs laḥ rten snying sna drangs lashis brjod rgya cher bya smon lam ni0 na mo gu ru ཿ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan gyur cigaḥ bshad sgyub 'khor los rgyal khams mdzes gyur cigaḥ sde gnyis thugs mthun khrims gtsang 'phel gyur cigaḥ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor gyur cigaḥ dmags 'khrugs dus kyi rgud pa zhi gyur cigaḥ sems can thams cad bde skyid ldan gyur cigaḥ khams gsum 'bor ba'i sa bon stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes thob gyur cigaḥ mdzad pa brin las nub med

'byung gyur cig: don gnyis rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub gyur cigaḥ sa dzaya dzaya sudza yaḥ de ltar spyor dngos rjes sgo ba'i sgrub pa zab mor sus rtson kyang tshe 'dir tshe ring nad gdon med phyi mar rig 'aram̐n gral spyod 'gyur sa maphu e ཿ rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ thugs kyi yang bcud zab pa'i gteraX med byung rdo rje snying po'i bskoraḥ mi 'gyur brda yi rgyar bcug nas mdo khams rtse shod gsham du sbasaḥ snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mched mu gesagazeng lang tshe0 nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa ཿ rgyal mchog sprul pa'i skyes bu dngaḥ 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs bar byed rnga yab dpal gyi ri la 'god 'dod sred can la mi 'cher bar las 'phro can gyi dpal du sprod sbu gri gsum gyis thub par bsrungasaḥ phan bde'i phrin las 'byung gyur cigaḥs mamāḥrgya rgyargya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thimaXsnyi zhes pa 'di'apas khyung rba gsar sku skyes wāsko'i mtshan can gyisagos bzang thabs shes mchen pa'i skyes bcas rgyang ring po nas bskul ba dang ༷ tshogs smon las 'dzomasagos ri dbon po yo rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis lha reg 'tsho byed sman gyis skyesabacas bskul ba dang grogasasogs las ldan du mas bzhed pa dang ldan phyiraḥ kho bosbas pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ye ge pa nilung dz+ran ṭ+wāṃyas bgyisapa dge legs 'phel/ na maṅga lam/

( bsgo/ zab gsang rdo rje spring po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yi gsol 'debs pad+ma'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—49 na mo gu ru pad+ma ra dza yaḥ kesmi1slo/dza/༈ khyed shes dad pa drag po yis gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par byaḥ e ma hoḥ bde stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nasaḥ gsung gi dbang phyug 'od snang mtha' yas laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ byin gyis zlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzod: rngams brjed rnga yab dpal ri pad 'od nasaḥmatsho byung rgyal ba pad+ma thod phreng laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥ dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nasaḥrgyal ba'i dgyes sde ye shes mtsho rgyal laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥ zla gam pad+ma 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nasaḥ dbang gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥ spyi bo bde chen 'khor

lo'i gdan steng nasaḥ bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥ khams gsum dbang sdud nor gter pho brang nasaX srid gsum zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po laḥ gsol ba 'debs so srid zhi'i phya g.yang stsolaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig chos mthun bsam don sgrubasaḥbade chen mchog gsang mkha' spyod gling dbus nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nor lha gter bdag laḥ gsol ba 'debs so zas nor dbang du bsdusaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig chos mthun bsam don sgrubasaḥ lha dbang lha yi dpal la dbang bsgyur ba'iḥ 'dzam lha nyer gcig nor ster lha mo laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phobasaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig phya 'beb g.yang blan mdzodaḥ de ltar khyed shes dad pas gsol btab mthusaḥ lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin rtsol rang sar dgaḥ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur smin: bde stong zung 'jug pad+ma rgyal po'i zhalaḥ tshe 'di nyid la mngon sum mthong bar regagaḥ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i miX tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cingaX phyi ma rig 'jin gral la spyod don gnyis lhun

btsardo grub gdon mi zaḥ sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs pad+ma'i lcags kyu rdzogs so gter rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgya gsang rgyaḥ gu khya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim: 3) zhes pa'ang lung zin o rgyan mtshan can nas dbang gi gos bzang drug sman gyi skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ba dang a khyung rba gsar sprul sku ngag po nas dbang gi gos dang bkra shis lha reg bcas rgyang ring po nas phrin bcug ste bskul ngor kho bo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma dgyes pa rtsal lam nus ldan rol pa'i rdo rjes dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'ibarda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zen me tri'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i zab sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

gas/ji na mo gu ru pad+ma rā dza ya: —blo sdisnyeglaju tshosartu//sda dus ngan snyigs ma lnga yi dus nad mtshon mu ge'i gzeng lang tshe sems can bsod nams dpal kha phriX las nyon zugs rngu drag pos mnar de dus skyobs pa'i man ngag tu pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub zab bstan sa ma yuḥ mi med dben pa'i ri sul duḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bcadaX dkyil 'khor mda' gang bkod legs bya sku gsung thugs kyi rten rdzas bkramaḥ snang grags lha sngags chos skur bltaḥ yengs med ting 'dzin brtan po yisaX mchog thun dngos grub sgrub par byedaX sam wāḥ 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po rnam grangs bdun gyis bstan: mnasha/: skyabs su 'gro ba na: na mo dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla ma dam pa dngaḥ dkyil 'khor kun dngos yi dam lhag pa'i lha bde stong dpal 'bar 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprinaḥ skyabs gnas rgyal ba rgya mtshor bdag skyabs mchi lan gsum sems bskyed ni ho: brgal dka' srid pa'i mun nag stug po dzas sdug bsngal rgya mtshos gzir ba'i pha ma rnams kun mkhyen mgon po'i sa la 'god bya'i phyiraḥ byang chub sems bskyed bslab la gnas par byaḥ lan gsum: tshogs bsags ni hoḥ rgyal kun gsung gsang pad+ma rgyal po laḥ sgo gsum rab gus dad pas phyag bgyi'oḥ phyi

gas/: nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho naḥ med byung kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston 'bulaḥ bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i: sdig lhung phra rag stobs bzhi ldan pas bshagasaḥ chos kun ye mnyam dag pa rab 'byams laḥ ngo mtshar yid ches dang bas rjes yi rangaḥ zab zhispros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byasaḥ bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskulaḥ zhing khams 'di 'am gzhan na bzhugs pa yiḥ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags rnams 'da' med bzhugasaḥ bdag gzhan zag dang zag med dge bsags kunaḥ'akhor gsum yongs su dag par bsngo bgyi'o: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnamasaḥ kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i mgon po'i sa thob shogaḥ maṇ+ḍal ni oṃ āḥsno mimajed bkod mdzes rat+na'i maṇ+ḍal dngaḥ bdag lus rtsa 'khor bde stong dga' bzhi'i dpal: sems nyid stong gsal rig pa 'od gsal sprinaḥ skyabs gnas kun dngos pad+ma rgyal por 'bulaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaḥ ka rat+na maṇ+ḍalabadz+rapu dzite āḥhūṃ bka' bsgo niḥhūṃ hrī rig 'jin bla ma rnams kyis byin rlabs dngaḥ yi dam rgyal ba

rgya mtsho'i ting 'dzin mthu: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten 'brel bslu med pasaḥ sgrub la bar chod byed pa'i 'byung po rnamasaḥ nying 'jin 'phrul gyi gtor mas brngan zin pasaḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba mchog gi gnas 'di dza nye bar ma byed rgya mtsho'i pha mthar dengaḥ gal te mi nyan gnod cing 'tshe byed naḥ ye shes khro tshogs 'bar bas brlag 'gyur roḥ de bas da lta nyid du byer cig phaṭaḥ shā bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab:srung 'bar nihūṃ nyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha sna lnga'i guraḥ ye shes khro chung sdig khyung tshwa tshwa 'phro: dpal chen khro bo bcu yis phyogs skyongs gziraḥ zung dang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grubaḥ 'byung po gdon bgegs nye ba'i skal ba medaḥ 'go min gsang ba mchog gi dal du gyuraḥspyo4)sha maṇ+ḍal dz+nyā na brtu rak+ta rak+ṣa dh+riḥ brda' sgo dbye phyag dam bca' ba niḥ hoḥ 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor cheḥ ma rig rtog pa'i sgrib pa da dbye'oḥ lhag mthong rig pa'i zhal mthong brda' phyag 'tshalaḥ lha mchog migatong sgog gi gta' ru 'dzinaḥ t+t+waṃ maṇ+ḍal tsakyu pra zhe sha ya pāṭaḥ a nyi pu hoḥ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ: byin 'bebs ni hūṃ hrī yul gyi ming ni o rgyan

ba:tshu mkha' 'gro'i yul: gnas kyi mchog gyur mkha' spyod bde chen gnasaḥ zhing gi mchog gyur dpal ri rig 'dzin zhingaḥ 'du ba chen po pad+ma 'od gling nas: bde chen gsang ba gsung gi rdo rje niḥ pad+ma rgyal po dga' bzhi'i 'od 'bar sku: nyams dga' dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ dngas spro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rtse gar bsgyur sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon la byin chen phobaḥ lha sngags chos sku'i rol par dbang bskur zhigaḥ o pad+ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ya phe thoḥ mchod rdzas byin rlabs niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor duḥ phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam mtha' yasaḥ nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrul chen rab g.yos teḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams bskang bar bgyiḥ.oṃ badz+ra pu dza dz+nyā na sa ma ya ho:ra ga ya me ma ha su kha hoḥ pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta bā ling ta bho dhi tsit+ta ga na gu h+ya muḥ bshags pa niḥ hoḥ las kyi rlung gi rba rlabs g.yos pa yisaḥ ma rig kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub laḥ bag rdul 'dres pa 'khor ba'i dri ma kunaḥ mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag par bshags: sa ma ya āḥ de dag sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'oḥ sa ma yā

rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa rnams grangs bco lnga yis bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin 'gyur med gdabaḥ sa ma yā ting 'dzin rnam gsum niḥ 31: rnam par mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje cheḥ rtsal chen snying rje phyogs dang ris med brdalaḥ zung 'jug rig pa stong gsal wa le baḥ thams cad 'byung gnas sgog gis dwangs mar shar ཿ sa badz+ra sa ma dhi (ཿ lha bskyed ni hūṃ: nam mkha'i dbyings phyug dpal mo btsun gyi mkharaḥ gsal dag rnyog bral 'byung ba bzhi rim stengaḥ sbyo las rin chen sna bdun ri rab kharaḥ 'bar ba'i 'od 'khyugs dbang gi gzhal med khangaḥ zla gam sgo gcig 'dod yon lha mos bstodaḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna 'khrigasaḥ phya 'bebs g.yang sdud longs spyod dpal 'dzoms dbusaḥ rin chen khri rkang pad zla nyi ma'i kharaḥ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje cheḥ khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po niḥ dmar gsal rā gar rta bdun 'khyud pa'i zhalaḥ rjes chags 'dzum sgegs spyan khro lhun gnyer chagasaḥdar dkar la thod rat+na'i srog zhwa laḥ ka sar phreng ba mdzes pa'i cod paṇa 'phuraḥ dbang gos dar ber sag lhum rol thabs 'gyengaḥ mthing shams za ber rin chen sna tshogs

zhes/ brgyanaḥ'achar kha'i mdangs 'bar 'od stong phyogs su g.yoḥsnang ba dbang sdud phyag g.yas ḍā ru 'khrolaḥstong par rgyas 'debs 'od gsal me long 'dzin gnas yul dpa' bo dhak+kis 'du 'phro 'gyedaḥmadun du dgyes bskyed lha mo 'od 'dzin maḥdakar dmar mdangs 'khyud 'dzum sgegs lang tsho bkraḥdar chas pad phreng nor bu'i do shal mdzesaḥdabang sdud lcags kyu nor bu'i gzhong pa 'dzinaḥpus btsug gus 'dud dpa' bo'i zhal la bltaḥde rgyab dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis nor sna stobasaḥdapa' re rnams nas glu gar dar 'phan bsgringaḥrdo rje'i ging tshogs bro brdung rgyal rnga sbiraḥ'adod yon char bsnyil bsam pa'i re ba skongs:yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa'i lang tsho 'baraḥsrog gis bskul te rtsa gsum sprin rab 'byamasaḥpad+ma rgyal po'i rnam par spyan drangs bstimasaḥspyan 'dren ni:/ hrībade chen 'bar ba zla gam dbang gi dalaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gros bkur sti phul ba'i gnasaḥrjes chags me yi 'od zer 'khrigs pa'i 1ngaḥphywa g.yang 'dod rgu'i longs spyod gter mdzod nasaḥrigs kun yongs 'dus pad+ma rgyal po rtsalaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro

ging dang lang gar bcasaḥ gdung dbyangs glu dang rol mo'i sgras bskul naḥ ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ byin rlabs dngos grub rgya mtsho char ltar phob oṃ badz+ra pad+ma rā dza sabo sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol niḥ hrīḥ rin chen sna bdun pho brang 'od re gsalaḥ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma mdangs dang ldanaḥ dar 'bol gos phrug yo byad lhun re 'thug bsod nams 'phel ba'i gdan la brtse bar bzhugs: sa ma ya dzaX sa ma ya stoḥ phyag 'tshal niḥ na moḥ bde stong zung 'jug pad+ma rgyal po'i zhalaḥ brtse ba'i zur mig skal ldan mos mtshor phyogasaḥ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing la dbugs dbyung ba'iḥ gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal loḥ sa ma ya na mo nyo : mchod niḥ / hrīḥ 'dod yon ma spangs phyi mchod nyer spyod bdunaḥ rdo rje lha mo sgegs mdzes phyag las spro: ting 'dzin rol ston spro bsdu bsam yas 'gyedaḥ dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes rol pa'i garaḥ bde ba mchog gi rgyal ba mnyes mdzad rnamasaḥ rje btsun chen po pad+ma rgyal por 'bul: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes su gsolaḥ shes ma hā badz+ra pu dza sarba sa ma ya hoḥnang mchod ni hūṃ hrīḥ nyon mongs

gtsasdo tsu ma spangs nang mchod 'dod yon lngaḥ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro brgya ldanaḥ mdzes 'jam reg bya sor rtser spro ba moḥ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga bde ba'i gzugasaḥ 'ja' 'byugs bro gar glu yis bstod sngags bcasaḥ gsung mchog pad+ma rgyal po'i dgyes pa bskyedaḥ rjes chags phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du bskulaḥ 'gro ba'i bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs gyur cigaḥ bla gu h+ya dz+nyān mahwa su kha anu rāg badz+rapu dzas maya ho gsang mchod ni: hūṃ hrī blang dor gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa niḥ kun tu dga' ba 'dzum ldan phyag rgya mosaḥ rab gsal me long grags stong rnga zlum sgraḥ rgyud mangs 'gyur ldan bcu drug gling bu rdzaḥ rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang 'gro ba'i don la bskulaḥ bde ba mchog sbyin chags pa rang sar sgolaḥ mkha' mnyam byang chub sems sprin pu dza yaḥ pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bulaḥ bdag gzhan 'dzad ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig: snyen ma hā garma tra'agre baṃdz+nyā nadhartu sam yaro/ཿ sa mas sa: sman raka gtor mchod niḥ hūṃ sni dngos kun dwangs ma byang chub sems bcud skyemasaḥ chags pa dbyings sgrol

dmar chen su ra dngaḥ 'dod yon ro mchog bā ling lha mor bcasaḥ gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol: sa/ ma hā pañtsa.a dṛ ta rak+ta bā ling ta kha ram khā hi bstod pa niḥhūṃ hrīḥ chags sogs nyon mongs nyes pa'i rdul bral zhingaḥ bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rā ga'i zhalaḥ 'khor ba rjes bzung rgyal po'i cha lugs 'changaḥ skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma rā dzar bstod mkha' 'dza'i sprin 'khrigs bcu drug ltag sprod 'khrolaḥ 'khor 'das dbang sdud snang gsal me long 'dzinaḥ dga' ba mchog stsol dbang gi 'od khyims g.yoḥ pad+ma'i rigs 'chang rgyal ba rgya mtshor bstod: dbang gos klubs pa'i brtan g.yos phywa g.yang sdudaḥ dar ber dkar po gdul bya rjes 'dzin rtagasaḥ rin chen rgyan 'chang skye rgu'i skom gdung zhiḥ bde mchog dbang gi rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod: rjes chags zhal gyis gdul bya'i re ba skongasaḥ spyan zlum ha ris don dam gnad rgya bkrolaḥ dar gyi la thod gsang sngags spyod pa skyongasaḥ phan bde'i 'byung gnas he ru ka la bstodaḥ 'di bzung ji srid byang chub mchog thob paraḥ rgyal ba khyed dang skad cig mi 'bral b.raḥ sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan rab

ba tshu 'phel nasaḥ'og min gnas su mngon sangs rgyas gyur cigaḥ'adzab bskul niḥhūṃ hrīm chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i dal dbus nasaḥbade stong dga' bzhi mchog stsol he ru ga'iḥthugs mchog mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u nasaḥye shes gsang ba'i 'dzab rgyun rtag tu bskulaḥyal sku la btang snyoms le lo mi mdzad paraḥdagongs pa'i rtsal g.yos pad+ma dbang gi lhasaḥmachog tu mi 'gyur bcu drug 'od gsal ba'iḥsgron me sbor la ma rig mun khams sangasaḥmakhyen gnyis ye shes chags thogs bral bar rgyasaḥrlung sems snang rtog thad grol dgongs rgyas thobasaḥs pad+ma rā dza maṇ+ḍal dṛ ha hehūṃḥbasnyen 'dzab niḥhūṃ hrīrang nyid ram̐g 'dus bla ma'i thugs ka rtsadabang gi zer 'bar rdo rje'i lte ba rtsadabyings gsal nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubasaḥrig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥyig dmar gsal laḥrtsa sngags pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'bar 'khoraḥ'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchodaḥthugs rje'i gzi byin bskul te bdag sgrib sbyangasaḥmar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon rtog sgrib bcomaḥthams cad ma brtsal dag pa rab 'byams sgomasaḥ.e badz+ram hāgu rupad+ma rādza snyi

yengs med dgongs pa dbyings thog bzhag snang grags dran rig dag mnyam khyeraḥ bde stong rtsal 'bar dga' bzhi rgyasaḥ nyams dga' dwangs spro dri bzang 'thulaḥ khrus la zhugs dang gos dkar gyon me tog tshal phyin mkha' la 'phur bsnyen pa them pa'i rtags su'oḥ sa ma wā 0 sgrub 'dzab ni hūṃ hrīḥ dpa' bo'i thugs sgog sngags phreng drag tu 'khoraḥ bde ba'i rang bzhin 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltaraḥ gnas lngar brgyud de nyon mongs las sgrib sbyangasaḥ 'bar ba mes bskul kusgo byang sems rgyunaḥ dga' bzhi'i mchod sprin gnas lnga'i 'khor lor khyabaḥ lhan skyes dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho mchod cha med kun 'gro nam mkha'i rdo rje mjal: brtan g.yo dbyings ye sras kyi rol par bltaḥ thams cad rjes chags pad+ma gsung gsang sgrubasaḥ bla āḥhūṃbadz+ra mahwa gu ru pad+marwa dzasarba sid+dhi pha la (ཿ rlung gis bskul nas bde ba'i mesaX kun byang chub sems bcud bzhu rtsa rlung thig le'i zag pa bcomaḥ sgo gsum rab smin gsang ba gsumaḥ thams cad mnyam pa'i rdo rjer sgrubasaḥ me mar rang 'bar bum chu khol brda' glu rol mo'i sgra snyan thosaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon ma 'baraḥ bsgrub pa zem pa'i rtags su'oḥs mayā ༷ las 'dzab niḥ hūṃ nyi brtse chen thugs rje'i dbang phyug he ru ga'iḥ gsang sngags snying po pad+ma'i

ba:tshu phreng ba yisaḥ gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i dpa' bo dngaḥ dpa' mo rdo rje rnal 'byor nye 'du'i tshogs: bde stong dga' ba bzhi yis dgyes bskangs nasaḥ kun kyang glu gar bro yi dgongs par zhugasaḥ phyi nang gzhan gsum rtsa rlung thig le'i khamasaḥ bde mchog dha ka dha k+ki'i rol par sadaḥ rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs nasaḥ kun kyang pad+ma rgyal po'i rol par sadaḥ thams cad mnyam nyid gdod ma'i chos nyid ngangaḥ au badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza a:tre+e:tri:a gar+sha ya dza sid+dha pha la bsdus bsdus bde stong sngags kyis zer phreng spro: 'khor 'das dpal yon bcud du dril: gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma kun kyang dga' ba bzhi la bskul: rgyud lnga 'gro ba'i gnas stong zhing rigs lnga mkha' spyod zhing la sbyor rtags su me mar rang 'bar zhing: gtor ma la ni ljon pa 'khrungs bdud rtsi lud cing nyams rtogs 'bar lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du: rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med 'grub dngos grub nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za las sbyor them pa'i rtags su'o: sa ma yā 'dod gsol niḥ hūṃ hrī: 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pad+ma rgyal po dang: 'khor 'das dpal rdzogs sa rgyan nor lha dgongs: bsnyen sgrub

yan lag rnam bzhis bskul lags na:thugs rje rgyang thags ma ring brtse bas skyongs:rmongs mun gdul dka' nyon mongs dug chus myosaḥzhi bsil bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stsal du gsol:bde bas phongs shing chags pas gdung ba la:dga' bzhi'i 'byor bas bsod nams gter mchog stsolaḥzhe sdang rgyas pa'i kun spyod rtsub mo canaḥm lus byams dang snying rjes sgrol bar mdzodaḥsngon dbang las kyis dbul phongs nyams thags paḥ longs spyod gter char rgya mtsho ltar du bskyilaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum 'gro ba ma lus pa'i: blo sems dbang bsgyur dam pa'i chos la sbyoraḥ bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye rgu kunaḥ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling la 'tshogs par re gaḥ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod mi mthun phyogs rnams kunaX chos nyid stong pa chen por zhi gyur cigaḥ tshe dpal bsod nams srid nor mnga' thang stobasaḥ mi nub 'dzam gling tha grur rgyas gyur cigaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa pho mo yiḥsnang ba dbang bsdus bde stong spyod gyur cig: sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs bdud dam sri'i rigasaḥ tshar bcad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ spron log bdud kyi bskal ba nub

ba:tshu gyur teḥ rgyal bstan 'dzin ma'i khyon la brdal bar mdzodaḥ dge bcu'i khrims kyis sdig gi dpung pham nasaḥ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i dbu 'phang mtho bar mdzodaḥnyin mtshan rtag par 'gro ba'i phan bde sgrubasaḥ du ru ka rnams 'dul ba'i mthu ldan mdzodaḥ phyu g.yang gter gyis rgyal khams kun bkang nasaḥ pad+ma rgyal po'i gdul byar 'gyur bar regagaḥ 'khrul snang rlung sems 'dus rgya grol ba'i tshe: rnga yab dpal rir tshom bur 'tshogs par regagaḥ de dag dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o sa maphuX rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rnam grangs bcu bdun gyis tshogs gnyis pre kha gang bar byedaḥ sa ma yāḥ bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigasaX dum gcig sgod du bsags byas teX mtshan 'dzin rtogs pa'i ma bslad par ye shes rig pas dngas blangs te byin gyis brlab pa 'di lta ste ces āḥshāḥ stong gsum khyon mnyam bhadha yangs pa'i nangaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dga' ston tshogs: zhi lhag rig pa'i rang mdangs me rlung chusaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi dga' ston mkha' khyab spelaḥ ma āḥ〉ཿha ho hrīḥ tshogs zhing sbyan 'dren ni hūm̐ ñdzi rnga yab dpal ri mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas pad+ma rgyal po rje 'bangs lo paṇa dngaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang

laṅga bcasaḥ 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ nyams dga' dang spros glu dbyangs sgra la gson: phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston mchog la rolaḥ rnam 'byer nyams bskangs rtogs pa spar ba dngaḥ don gnyis lhun grub 'dod rgu'i char ba phobaḥ phyu dang g.yang gi gter chen dbab du gsolaḥ lo/ badz+ra ma hāgu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs phud ni hoḥ mdzes pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'iḥ rat+na sna tshogs snod mchog bzhong pa rtsa dga' bzhi'i rol ston phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogasaḥ rnam par spros te pad+ma rgyal por 'bulaḥ 7 ma hā gu h+ya ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi bar bshags niḥhoḥ ma rig rmongs shing las nyon lhun 'thug pasaḥ sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dngaḥ rtsa ba yan lag chags nyams gang song nongasaḥ mi 'chab mi sbed ye shes lha la bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ bye nga bdag mtshan mar blta ba'i rū tra kunaX bdag med yul med mnyam pa chen por bsgralaḥ chos nyid 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su bstimasaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs chos sku mngon gyur mdzodaḥ sarba dū tra mā ra ya pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ bstab

btsanyu pa niḥhūṃ hūṃḥspros pa'i mtha' grol de bzhin nyid kyi klongaḥrnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i mkharaḥm rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum bstabasaḥdug gsum gnas stong mnyam nyid 1nga rtogs mdzodaḥme sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hiḥtshogs la rol ba niḥhoḥrin thang med pa legs 'ong gsang sngags rdzasaḥnyon mongs nyes pa'i sgrib skyon dri kun bralaḥgazung dang 'dzin pa'i ma gos myong grol skyemasaḥde bzhin nyid du rol zhing bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ.a la la ho:lhag ma niḥtho ཿchos nyid dag pa'i gsang sgog rnam par 'changaḥlegs nyes ltang 'dzin sgrub pa'i drod tshad nyulaḥmakha' la rgyu zhing sbas gnas gtsug lag nyulaḥrnal 'dresar sring gcig dbang phyug ging lang gaḥdam tshig mchog gsang tha tshig sgrags nas 'bodaḥm 'gyang bu yi mos ngor da tshur 'dusaḥ'adod lnga'i dga' ston pham phab tshogs ston rolaḥbade stong rtsa rlung byang chub sems mchog bskyedaḥthugs kyi bzhed don rnam mang phrin las bsgrub:bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i 'bras bu chud ma gsan:phyi nang gsang rkyen chos kyi dbyings su sgrolaḥdagra bdud bgegs la mngon spyod drag rtsal

stonaḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral dbus skyel ma mdzodaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzod dam tshig canaḥ ma ma trī uṣ+ṭi ṭa bā ling ta khā hi3 bskul ba ni hūṃ stso bzhengs shig rnga yab dpal gyi ri nas bzhengasaḥ bskyed cig o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling nas bskyodaḥ thugs dam ci bzhin mngon spyod las la bskulaḥ rje btsun chen po pad+ma rgyal po nyidaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang lang gar bcasaḥ gangs dkar rtse nas stobs rtsal bskyed bzhin byonaḥ rgya mtsho'i gling nas phrin las shugs kyis gshegasaḥ dung dung gdung ba'i glu yi sgra la gsonaX khyed shes dad pas 'o dod 'bod do phebaḥ dga' ston ro mnyams mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dus kyi rgud pa solaḥ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyasaḥ de 'dzin 'dus sde dar zhing rab tu spelaḥ bshad sgrub 'khor los rgyal khams yongs khyab brdalaḥ 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i skal bzang stsolaḥ zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥ chad mdo niX bh+yoḥ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la: bcom ldan che mchog pad+ma he ru ga'iḥ rta skad gsum bsgrags rū tra gnad la dbabaḥ dpal

ba:tshu chen khro bo rol ba'i spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ gshed ma'i lus la bde gshegs pho brang btabaḥ ma dang chung ma dbang phyug bran mo'i tshogasaḥ bde ba chen po'i rgyas btab dam 'og bcugaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaḥ gtsug lag 'dus sde bshad sgrub bstan pa srungaḥ rnal 'byor sgyu lus nyams rtogs 'od gsal spelaḥ 'dod lnga rang grol chad kyi gtor ma bzhesaḥ gnyer bcol las rnams ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzodaḥ bh+yoḥ de 'og bar gyi dus tshig gnyis pa laḥ mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs pa rtsadabang gi bka' bab nā gardzu na yisaḥ rā ga'i sgrom bkrol rta mgrin dal zhal phyesaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can gnad la dbabaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaḥgatsug lags 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thobaḥ rnal 'byor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥ chad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhinaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥ bh+yoḥ de 'og bar gyi dus tshig gsum pa laḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po sangs rgyas gnyis pa yiḥ gangs ljongs bod yul ltas po ri rtse 0 lha srin dregs pa dam

can rgya mtsho rnamasaḥ gnad dbab sgog 'phrog shi sa bstan pa'i tsheḥ zab gter bco brgyad bkas gtad rgya sbas tsheḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaḥ gtsug las 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thob rnal 'byor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥ chad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhinaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥ bh+yoḥ de 'og bar gyi dus tshig bzhi pa laḥ o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gisaḥ gsung gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs laḥ nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi chos bstan tsheḥ 'brug 'dabs dmu long khyi spyang gser sring rnamasaḥ dbang bsdus bran bkol dam sgog thob pa'i tsheḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung pa'i gnyer byang gtadaX gtsug lag 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thobaḥ rnal 'byor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥ chad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhinaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥ bh+yoḥ de 'go bar gyi dus tshig lnga pa la: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nasaḥ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma rgyal po yisaḥ dbang gi bka' bab rgyal mchog bzhad

gas( pa laḥzab gsang rdor snying bstan pa gtad pa'i cheḥm gza' dam can rdo rje g.yu sgron rnamasaḥdabang bsdus bran bkol dam sgog thob pa'i tsheḥsangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaḥgatsug lag 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thobaḥrnal 'byor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥchad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhinaḥbacol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥbh+yoḥde'ago bar gyi dus tshig drug pa laḥzab gter mdzod 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje yisaḥmado khams gnas mchogs tsā ri'i lho rdzongs nasaḥrdo rje snying po'i sbas rgya bkrol ba'i tsheḥsbu grimached gsum yak+ka nag po rnamasaḥdabang bsdus bran bkol dam sgog thob pa'i tsheḥsangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaḥgatsug lag 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thob:rnal 'phyor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥchad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhin:bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥbh+yoḥd lta dus tshog bdun pa la bab tsheḥphun tshogs lnga ldan bsgrub pa'i bzhi bzung nas:bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yi gzhung

bsreng tshe: sngon tshe zhal bzhes bka' sdod dregs tshogs dang: bod khams skyong ba'i gzhi bdag pho mo rnams: dbang bsdus bran bkol dam sgog thob pa'i tsheḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtad: gtsug lag 'dus sde spel bar dam mnos thobaḥ rnal 'phyor sgyu lus nyams rtogs spel zhal bzhesaḥ chad kyi gtor ma phrin las gnyer blangs bzhin bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub mdzod cigaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ brtan ma niḥ bh+yoḥ tshogs mchog kun dngos pad+ma rgyal po yi spyan sngar khas blangs mna' bor dam mnos pa'iḥ rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi g.yu bun dngaḥ sman btsun 'ug chos rdo rje dbyar mo bsilaḥ la ro sman dang nag rgyal 'bar ma dngaḥ zu le sman dang ting lo sman dang niḥ kong btsun te mo gtso 'khor g.yog dang bcasaḥ ma thogs bu yis 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ zhing chen gdan khar rak+ta'i thig ler bzhugasaḥ rnam lnga'i longs spyod dam rdzas bshal chab bzhesaḥ gangs ljongs bod khams bde skyid dpal la spyoraḥ bstan gnyis sgron me mi nub dar rgyas mdzod ngur sprig gos dkar sde spel bshad sgrubs kyisaḥ bstan pa

gtsarnyi rin chen yar ngos zla ltar spel char chu dus bab lo phyugs rtag legs nasaḥ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod rgud pa kun zhi zhing bde skyid dza/gas ldan gsar tshes snang ba yisaḥ 'jig rten kun khyab phan bde'i dpal la sbyoraḥ zhal bzhes tha tshig ma g.yel dam ldan rnamasaḥ snyen ma mā la lā tingataing sring 'dza matsas deb lingata kha kha khāhi khāhiḥ rta bro ni hūm̐ hrīḥ e nyid stong pa chos dbyings sgom rgya rtsa rnam rtog gnyis snang bdud dang dam sri brubaḥ dbang chen rol pa chen po'i bro brdung ngo: ma mo mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i gar bsgyur roX rjes su chags pas glu yis dbang du bsgyuraḥ ma ldang sdang med ye shes dgongs rgyar bcugaḥ byang chub bar du ma 'da' s+t+waṃ bha yaḥ bla āḥ/ swā hāwā raya nanananaḥ dngos grub niḥ ( nyimi gnas 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings nyid lasaḥ ye shes thugs rje phyogs dang ris med pasaḥ rtsal chen 'bar g.yos mos ldan pho mo laḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i dngos grub nyi ma shar sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsolaḥ lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dngaḥ tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sa thob mdzod: sirnyipha las la la hoḥ bzod gsol niḥho

sems la lam byas gnyis rtog 'khrul ba'i 'groḥ blo chung rnam par g.yeng ba'i nong dbang gisaḥ sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa sogasaḥ ting 'dzin bying rmug chags nyams nongs pa bshagasaḥ bzod gsol tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ sa ma ya āḥ bsngo smon niX hoḥ dus gsum dge bsags mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngoḥ kun kyang rang byung ye shes mngon gyur nasaḥ brtan g.yo thams cad rnga yab dpal rir sharaḥ 'og min pad+ma drwa bar byang chub regagaḥ lan gsum bsdu ldang ni0 āḥ sgod bcud 'od zhu gzhal yas khang la bsduḥ de yang lha dang 'khor rnams gtso bo laḥ de nyid ye shes sems dpa' thugs sgog laḥ nā da mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang la gnasaḥ a āḥ slar yang sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam gyisaḥ gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren pa'i don bya'oḥ phaṭa phaṭaḥ shis brjod niḥ na moḥ bde ba chen po'i ye shes phyogs lhung bralaḥ kun mkhyen snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis shogaḥ zag med thugs rje zer sprengs 'gro kun 'drenaḥ byams chen nam mkha' rgyal po'i bkra shis shogaḥ dga' bzhi'i 'od kyis gdul bya'i chags gdung bsalaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i bkra shis shogaḥ bde

btsarnyi ba mchog gi khams rnams yongs khyab pa'iḥ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mos bkra re gaḥ phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya yongs smin pasaḥ dam can rgya mtshos tshogs kyis bkra shis shogaḥ ma rig mun sel ye shes sgon me sbaraḥ zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shogaḥ gang 'brel don ldan 'khor ba'i sa bon skemasaḥ 'od gsal cherdogs pa chen 17'i bkra shis regagaḥ shis pa brjod cid me tog 'thoraḥ dge mtshan dpal yon char du bsnyilaḥ rjes kyi rims pa tshangs ba'oḥ sa mayāḥrgya rgyargya ༷ e ཿ rgyal b.lidabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos teḥ nad mtshon mu ge'i rgud pa skyobs pa'i phyiraḥ thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi zhal rlangs drod tshad can gang 'brel don ldan ngan song sgo kheg pa0 brten na 'grub sla phywa g.yang char rgyun 'bebasaḥ dus kyi rgud pa skyobs pa'i man ngag 'diḥng sprul nga dang mi gzhan sprul pa'i skuX nus ldan rdo rje nyid dang 'phrad pa'i 'byer da lta ma spel rin chen brda' la chug mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs pra sdomasaḥ zab pa'i rgya la bstims shig sa ra bye skal med 'dod sred can la mi 'chor b.raX thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa dang 'phrad nasaX gdul bya'i lhag ma skal bzang rnams brkyangs te rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su 'tshogs par smonaḥ sa mayā rgya rgya rgya

zab sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya0 zab rgyaḥ gsang rgya gu r+sha o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oX brda thiyo 3)zhes pa 'di'ang chos 'di la las 'phro 'dzom pa mi rje sprul pa'i sku ngag po nas bkra shis lha regs gos bzang yugs kyi skyes bcas bskul ba dngaX gzhan yang chos bdagatsa sa 4bla ma sa rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis lha regs dga' sgo'i me tog 'tsho byed sman gyi skyes bcas nan tan chen po'i bskul ba dang grogs nas kyang mos blos bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul gyis brda' ris las bsgyur ba'i mthus yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag snga 'gyur bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i slad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam/

ba:: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po la bdud rtsi skyems mchod yid bzhinasprin phung bzhugs soḥbatsardo na mogu runid+ma rā dza ya: / nasprispyosgo 'i dum gcig bhan+ta bdud rtsi skyems: dkyil 'khor lnga la bstab byas te: snyen gisalci skyemed chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa nas: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: rtsa brgyad stong spyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsolaḥ bdechen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:chags pa'i rdul bral snang mtha' yab yum la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol: rnga yab dpal ri mkha' 'gros 'du gling nasaḥ o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod breng la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon pa'i bde ba'i 'byung gnas pad+ma rgyal po la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul che dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsal:rnyu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i 'du gral

nas: mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo mtsho rgyal la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol: bde stong zung 'jug pad+ma 'od klonganas dbang gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol: spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan gcig pu: bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos gyub stsol: tshad med rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo rgya mtsho la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub char ltar phobasnye ma hā sarba pañtsa.a mṛta kha ram khā hi: dza: lce yi dam tshig pad+mar ā dmar po: dam tshig phyag rgya rdo rje'i thal mor sa: bdud rtsi snying po hūṃ gi rnam par drangs: gsang gsum gcig bsres dbang dang dngos grub thob: sgyu lus dngas ma'i lha sku mngon gyur dmigs: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya sid+dhi ma ཿ wāk+ka sidhi ā: cit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ: sarba sirnyi hrī: de ltar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul bsod nams ye shes

btsardo tshogs gnyis rdzogs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa malha: e yo rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'di: nga sprul bu dang 'phrad gyur nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sa thob 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: bdud rtsi skyems mchod yid bzhin sprin phung rdzogs so: gter gye gtadargya: sbas gye zabargya gsang gye gu rgya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: brda thim 3) zhes pa'angaya khyung rba gsar sku skyes wāk+ko mtshan can nas thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg gi skyes bcas bskul ba dang: sngon smon las kyi 'phro 'dzoms〈(sa ri'on po o rgyan mtshan nas bkra shis lha reg 'tsho byed sman gyi skyes bcas bskur ngor: kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa nilung zin sgoyis mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarbamaṅgalam/

( badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dal du nongs bshags phul ba shel dkar me long bzhugs so/ba tshu na mo gu ru pad+ma rde dza ya: zan11 (1/1 gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba yis: dam tshig chags nyams bshags sbyangs bya rdo rje'i bla ma dpang du btsugs: khyed shes dad pas 'di skad do: na mo pad+ma rā dza ya: ye nas rdul bral pad+ma rgyal po'i zhal: chags pas ma gos yan lag drug cu'i gsung: rlung sems g.ya' dag mkhyen gnyis ye shes thugs mos ldan gdul bya'i dpal mtshor brtse bas dgongs: bdag ni blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che: ma rig 'khrul snang khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams: zhe sdang 'bar ba'i mes ni rang rgyud bsregs:dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshan po che yis mnar: 'dod chags rgyal mtsho'i gting rum bag med bying pre ta'i bkres skoms gdung bas a thang chad: gti mug mun pa 'thibs pas shes rab rmongs: bkol spyod gcis la gcig za 'jigs pas gdungs phrag dog dbang gis lha min gnas su spyod: 'thab cing rtsod pa nyams myong gzeng pa lang: mchog 'dzin

nga rgyal khengs pas lha ru skye: don med g.yeng ba dga' bde'i ro yis myos: dge sdig 'dres mar spyod pas mi ru 'phang: skye rga na 'chi 'byor rgud 'du 'bral byung: yid chad 'gyod kyang las 'bras bslu ba med nongs pa gang mchis yi dam lha la bshags: rted dka'i rten la snying po ma blangs rmongs: 'dus byas mi rtag rtag 'dzin blo yis bslus: sdug bsngal gnas la nges 'byung snying rjes dben: dge sdig mi g.yos las la gom pa 'khyol: thar med btson dngo me 'ob tshud pa'i las: gang mchis mi 'chab ye shes lha la bshags:thugs bskyed dag pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po: 'gro la phan dgongs mi yi brdzur phebs pa: 'khrul ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas zhal ma 'tshos: sems rtog nongs pas mi ru 'dzin rtsol byas: mdzad pa phrin las yon tan mi dmigs par: log par rtogs pa'i nyes byas mthol lo bshags: gdam ngag bdud rtsi sman gyi chos char phabs: gang yang ma btung bag med las la g.yeng: zab rgyas rin chen phul dang gya nom pa: mthong yang ma sgrubs lag stong ldog pa bshags: mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba: gdul byamiblo

ba'adi: gros pad mtshor ngoms na yang:ma rig dbang gi ling tog stug pos sgrib:chos nyid 'od gsal ma rtogs mthol lo bshags:lta ba 'phang dmas chos skur la ma zlos:spyod pa 'chol bos rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad:dmigs bcas blo yis khyab brdal don ma rtogs:re dog gzung 'dzin bltas pa mthol lo bshags:khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa yab kyi ngang:srid gsum dbyings su sbyor ba yum gyi 1nga:bdag blo gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pa:ye shes thugs mchog pad+ma rgyal por bshags:mos gus chung bas bla mar bsnyen bkur dbul:'o ga rtogs dbang gis mched la brtse gdung ral:phyogs 'dzin dam pos yi dam spangs blang byas:ser sna'i dbang gis mkha' 'gro mchod bskangs bul:thams cad mi 'chab bzod gsol tshangs par bzhes:snyeng dzachung bas pha mar drin ma gzos:le lo'i dbang gis bsnyen sgrub lo zlar g.yel:phyi bshol che bas tshogs dang gtor ma chag:rlung sems dbang gis 'khrul snang kho nar 'byams:snying nas 'gyod do rje btsun bla mar bshags:sa thar 'dul ba'i bcas khrims nyams pa dang

byang sems bslab bya chos bzhi phyin drug g.yel: log rtogs dbang gis 'gal zla'i rjes su 'brang: thams cad nongs bshags bzod gsol tshangs par bzhes rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang yan lag nyer lnga gsang bcu 'chol ba dang: bho dhi tsit+ta brtul zhugs nyer lnga nyam dgra bzhi bdud lnga spyod lam rgyun gyi gsum: gal med nges pa'i dam tshig la sogs pa'i 'gal 'das chags nyams zhig ral gang song bshags: sgrib med tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: kun byed mkhan po ma byung ma skyes pas 'da' nyams srungs mtshams kun rdzob yul las 'das: gdod nas dag pa ye shes chos kyi skur: sgrib bral rig pa kun tu bzang por ā: 'di yis mi 'dag gang yang med:shel dkar rdul phyes ci bzhin no: sgo gsum nongs pa sems kyis bshags: rig pa sgrib med chen por skyongs: dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa mjal: mtshan ma'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal: 'di la the tshom tsam yang med sa mayu: e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was: ma 'ongs 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse bas: mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis phyur bur bkangs: khyad par zab gsang rdo rjesnying po'i skor: dgyes sde mo yis brda yi ris su btab mdo khams rtse shod gsham du

—41 dgongs pra bsdoms: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga sprul pad+ma'i rigs la rdo rje'i sku sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa dang 'phrad nas: gdul bya'i lhag ma tshogs smon las 'dzoms skyobs 'brel tshad rngayab dpal ri'i gnas su 'khod: bka' gsang gnyer kha spu gri gsum la bcol dam nyams 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du shog sa ma'i rgya rgyargya nongs bshags phul ba shel dkar me long rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya: sbas rgya gsangargya: gukhya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim ldi zhes pa'anga.a khyung rba sar sprupa sku wāk+ko mtshan can nas thabs shesamatshon pa'i lha reg gi skyes bcas bskul ba dang tshogs smon las 'dzomasagos mi'on po o rgyan bstan 'j-in nas bkra shis lha reg 'tsho byed sman gyi skyes bcas nan tan chen po'i bskul ngor kho bo sbas pa'irnal 'byer rgyal mchego bzhad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa nilung zer snyekhrus bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba muṅga lam̐/

gas/: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dal du rdzas bzhi'i mchod 'bul bsod nams tshogs rdzogs bzhugs so:ba tshu na mo gu ru shed+ma ka ra ye: spokhyodabyete// dam tshig dag pa'i gzung ma yis: rdzas bzhi'i mchod pa bstabs byas te: / hrī: bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal: khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum zil gnon rgyal: gsung gi dbang phyug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rje pad+ma rgyal po 'du ba tshogs la gshegs: dam tshig dag pa'i mos ngor brtse bar bzhugs brda yis mtshon nas gar gyis phyag bgyi'o: phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston tshogs mchod bzhes: khyad par dngos kun dngas ma 'dud rtsi sman rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong sbyar ba'i rigs lnga yab yum dam rdzas rmad po che: he ru ka dpal dgyes pa skangs phyir 'bul: chags pa rab bsgral girti gsang ba'i khrag: rtsi bcud dmar po 'byung ba'i dngas ma che: sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta sna tshogs pa: 'khor ba ka nas dag phyir 'bul gyis bzhes snod kyi 'jig rten khyon yangs bhan+ta rtsa srid pa bcud kyi dpal 'byor gtor chen

bshams: 'dod yon lha mo mkha' dbyings mdzes rgyan bcas: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir pad+ma'i dal du 'bul: kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings kyi gong bu rtsa rig paliyeshes 'od gsal mar me bltamasaḥ ma rig mun bsal mdangs lnga ldan pa 'di: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bla ma'i dal du 'bul: sngags kyi dga' ston dza gad a dṛ ta: dum gcig shā yi nor bur gtams byas teḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rol ston 'di: chos nyid mnyam pa'i dgongs don rtogs phyir 'bul: a la la ho bde ba chen por bzhes: snang srid dag mnyam rngortegs pa'i da1rngos dza/ba ༷skor: de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel sa lam ma lus mthar phyin te: rnga yab dpal rir the mi tshom:sa mas:ye yo rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bhawas: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: thugs kyi yang bcud zab mo'i gter: skal ba can gyi dpal du bkod: mdo khams rtse re da gsham la sbal gter bdag sbu gri gsum la bcol snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel bye ma'i grangs kyi 'gro ba 'dren 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar skal bzang pad tshal bshad phyir spel mdzad phrin mtha' ru phyin par shog sa mayā

/shārdo rgya rgya rgya rdzas bzhi'i mtshod 'bul bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rdzogs so gter rgya:gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu h+ya:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka':bdag 'dra mkha' chen gzas bkod pa'o:brda thim 3)zhes pa'ang a khyung sprul pa'i sku wāk+ki mtshan can gyis thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg bcas bskul ba dang:tshogs smon las 'dzomasayon rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis lha regs 'tsho byed sman gyi skyes bcas nan tan chen po'i bskul ngor kho bo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin snye tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sa rba maṅga lam/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dgyes bskyed tshogs bsdus chos dbyings sprin 'khrigs bzhugs:btsa( na mo shed+ma rā dza yā: shā1srun:bye ཿ dum gcig mi yi nor bu phu bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams bsags : sngags dang phyag rgyas spel byas te pad+ma rgyal po'i dal du 'bul sa ma yu:thod rnga snyan pa'i glu dang bcas: hūṃ hrī: bde stong zung 'jug pad+ma 'od gling nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang lang ga'i rje: bsod nams longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i khams gsum srid gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur ba yi: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po sras 'khor bcas: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chags bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs rje brtse bar dgongs phyir phyag mchod 'bul: rmad byung phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston tshogs: ro mnyam 'dod pa'i lha mo bsam mtha' yas: dbyings las sprul te pad+ma rgya por 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs phyir bzhes: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa bshags: ma rig rlung sems bdag rtog rū tra bsgral:

chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i dgongs 1nga bstabs: sngags kyi dga' ston tshim pa drug ldan rol: rjes thob spyod pa chos dang mthun pa yi: lhag skyongs pho mos lhag rol phrin las sgrubs: 'khrul ba rang zhig nang dbyings bum sku'i sbubs: sku dang ye shes mdzad phrin mtha' rgyas thegag: de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs: sgrib dag don gnyis lhun gyis grub bsod nams thabs kyis 'jug ngog 'di skal pa can gyi dpal du shog sa ma mā :rgya rgya rgya dgyes bskyed tshogs bsdus chos dbyings sprin 'khrigs rdzogs so:gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zabargya:gsang rgya gu rgya: o rgyan gyi sgob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o:brda thiyo ljaje zhes pa'angatus khyung sprul sku ngag po dang gos ri bla ma o rgyan nas bskul ngor / kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin rnye tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sa maṅga le//
pa( zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dgyes bskang nor bu'i phreng ba 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs so:

—4rdo na mogu rupad+ma gar ye phe34/spodza/ rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje che pad+ma rā dza dgyes bskyed phyir phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston tshogs: gnyis su med par 'bul lags na: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs nyams pa sna tshogs sor chud 'gyur sam lā snyan pa'i glus bskul rol mo sgrogs: bde stong mnyam sbyor ting 'dzin gyis:bye ༷ ma chags dri bral bde ba chen po'i sku: rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas thugs dam bskangs lta ba'i srol 'dzin klong chen nam mkha' mdzod: rig 'dzin na gardzu na'i thugs dam bskang: mkha' 'gros gling skyel bde stong spyod pa can: gu ru a tsār+ya mchog thugs dam bskangs: gdong dmar srin gling zab gsang chos la bkod: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs: thugs rjes bod skyong phrin las char ltar 'bebs: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs: gsung gi bka' bab rta skad gtsug na spa dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskangs: rdzu'aphrul rmad byungargyal ba'i dgyes sde mo mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskangs: tshe yi rig 'dzin 'ja' skur bskyed pa mo: lha lcam man+ta ra ba'i thugs dam bskangs: gter gyi gzhi 'dzug

btsa( phrin las gdul byar 'gyed:bal mo shākya dī wa'i thugs dam bskangs:'dod chags bzhi sbyor skal ldan bde la 'god:bal 'bang ka la sirnyi'i thugs dam bskangs:dregs pa lha srin dam la 'dogs pa'i srog:mon mo bkra shis khye 'dren thugs dam bskangs:grub pa mngon gyur phan bde'i nyi ma can:rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsalnga'i thugs dam bskangs:thugs bskyed dag pa'i smon lam phrin las can:yer ba'i grub chen brgyad cu'i thugs dam bskangs:dngos dang brgyud nas zab gter sgo 'byed pa:bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:྅ trī:thugs dam bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni:phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun gyi sprin:nang mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lnga gsang ba rigs ma bcu drug dang:zag med bdud rtsi a dṛ ta:sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta khrag:'dod yon dpal rdzogs bā ling ta:zla rgyas zla phrum ma dā na me sa gar bye mar me spos:byang chub sems bcud nyi zla'i dal:bza' bca' btung ba'i dga' ston tshogs:glu gar rol mo snyan pa'i dbyings:ma lus 'dus pa'i dga' ston gyis:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam

bskangs: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:hūṃ gyi bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal: dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs: 'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ba 'bebs mdzad pa'i: o rgyan gter bdag gling ba'i thugs dam bskangs:khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon pa'i: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: phyu 'bebs g.yang 'bebs nor gyi dpal ster ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nor lha'i thugs dam bskangs: phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'dul mngon spyod las mdzad pa'i ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: sa gsum dbang mdzad gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag:'dzam lha rnam sras nor bdag thugs dam bskangs: bde ba mchog gis yab la rgyas 'debs pa'i: 'od 'chang dbang gi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskangs: phrin las dbul ba sel ba'i sbyin stobs ldan: 'phags ma nor ster lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs: dpa' rtags rgyal rngas gdul bya dbang tu byed: ging dang ling ga'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs: : gyi

ba tshu thugs dam bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni:phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun gyi sprin:nang mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lnga:gsang ba rigs ma bcu drug dang:zag med bdud rtsi a mṛ ta:sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta khrag:'dod yon dpal rdzogs bā ling ta:zla rgyas zla phrum ma dā na:mo sa gal bye mar me sbosaḥbyang chub sems bcud nyi zla'i dal:bza' bca' btung ba'i dga' ston tshogs:gru gar rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs:ma lus 'dus pa'i dga' ston gyis:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs:mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:hūṃ stoskyeme da chos dbyings mkha' la dbang mdzad pa'i:bde gshegs rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:mi shig 'gyur ba med pa'i skur snang ba:rdo rjo rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:mnyam nyid ye shes bde ba mchog gi sku:rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'dza'i thugs dam bskangs:ma chags bde sbyin pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal:gsung gsang rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:byabanan tan ye shesango

bo nyid: las rab rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs thabs mang phrin las tshad med mdzad pa can: sna tshogs dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: bstan pa'i dgra la gshe zhing don snying 'byin: sha za mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thugs dam bskangs: legs nyes shan 'byed mkha' la bgrod stobs can: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thugs dam bskangs: chos nyid mkha' las thugs rje shugs kyis 'gro: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs hūṃ hrī: thugs dam bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun gyi sprin: nang mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: gsang ba rigs ma bcu drug dang: zag rmed bdud rtsi a dṛ ta sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta khrag: 'dod yon dpal rdzogs bā ling ta zla rgyas zla phrum ma dā na me sa gal phye mar me spos byang chub sems bcud nyi zla'i dal bza' bca' btung ba'i dga' ston tshogs: glu gar rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs ma lus 'dus pa'i dga' ston gyis: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:

ga66 bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:/ gyiganam lcags ma la ya yi rtse mo nas:rgyud mgon legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskangs:'bum phrag rgyud kyi gsang srog phyag na 'chang:sngags bdag e ka tsa ṭi'i thugs dam bskangs:sgrub gnas gtsug lag zhing kun skyongs mdzad pa'i:bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum thugs dam bskangs:zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byin mdzad pa'i:gza' bdud rā hu la yi thugs dam bskangs:gnam sa byed kyi bdag po rdzu 'phrul can:skyes mchog rdor legs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs:sha za khrag 'thung gsod gcod las la nyul:gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangs:he chen dha na'i zhing skyongs bstan srungs ba dbang drag shan pa dmar nag thugs dam bskangs:'byung lngar dbang za skye 'dza'i sgog dbugs sdud:rgya chen sku lnga sprul 'khor thugs dam bskangs:pad+malibaka' nyan rgyal ba'i bstan srungs ba:gnod sbyin sde dpon sum cu'i thugs dam bskangs:legs nyes ltangs 'dzin dam tshigs las rjes gcod bod skyongs bstan ma bcu gnyis thugs dam

bskangs:tha tshig la gnas dkar phyogs skyongs mdzad pa'i:snang srid dregs pa'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bye hrīthugs dam bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni:phyi mchod nyeraspyod bdun gyi sprin:nang mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lnga:gsang ba rigs ma bcu drug dang:zag med bdud rtsi a dṛ ta:sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta khrag:'dod yon dpal rdzogs bā ling ta:zla rgyas zla phrum ma dā na:mo sa gal phye mar me spos:byang chub sems bcud nyi zla'i dal:bza' bca' btung ba'i dga' ston tshogs glu gar rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs ma lus 'dus pa'i dga' ston gyis:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs:mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:g.yar dam skangs la rkyen dbang bzlog:bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog:stong phrag brgya cu'i bgegs rnams bzlog:nyi khri chig ste nga rkyen rnams bzlog:mo ngan rtsis rdil 'khrugs pa bzlog:g.yas na pho brgya'i mda' brdar bzlog:g.yon na mo brgya'i dug g.yos bzlog:mdun na mi gsum gros byed bzlog:rgyab

ga rte nas rta gsum srab 'cha' bzlog: 'ug pa spang la rgod pa bzlog: dur khrod wa mo nyin brgyal bzlog: spyangamo thadargyugs mdur ngu bzlog srin byas gong khar 'bod pa bzlog: sgod la khyims bya 'tsher ba bzlog: tho rengs sgo khyi ngu ba bzlog: snyinganas pog sir khol ba bzlog: bar nas sde brgyad g.yo ba bzlog: 'og nas klu gnyan 0(spyigs pa bachosag: ngan dgu dug bcu thams cad dgra dang bgegs la bachogag byed: de ltar bskangs bzlog byas pa yis: ci bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang: longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas par 'gyur sa ma yā: yi ma rgyaladabang pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: thugs kyi yang bcud rdor snying chos: pad+ma rgyas po sgrub pa'i skor bsod nams nor gyi gter sbyin pa'i bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po de: bsod nams las 'phro can la gtad: da dung spel ba'i dus min pas: rin chen brda yi sgrom rgyar chug: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du sbas: gter bdag spu gri gsum gyis srungs 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar:dbang chen gsung gi sprul ba yis: bstan 'gro'i gsos su 'byen byas te: 'brel tshad dpal rir 'god gyur cig: samalha rgyargya rgya: dgyes bskangs nor bu'i phreng ba rdzogs so: gartarargyas gtad rgya: sbasacu zab rgya gsangasbyo gu

h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thimaḥ 3/: zhes pa'ang a khyung rba gsar gyi mi rje sprul pa'i sku ngag po nas gos bzang thabs shes mtshon pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang tshogs smon las 'dzoms gos ri 'on po o rgyan nas bkra shis lha reg 'tshong byed sman gyi skyes bcas nan bskul ngor kho bo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog 'ashad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin me tri'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba bzhugs: gsarte na mo gu ru pad+ma rā dza ya: shāsnyo/jes tshogs ston mchod pa rgya cher spro: gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba ni: hūṃ: skye medachos dbyings dag pa nas: sgyu 'phrul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin bde ba chen po'i spyod pa can: zla gam dbang gi mtha' skyongs ba: pad+ma'i rigs mchog gtso dang 'khor: 'du ba tshogs la sbyan 'dren gshegs zhu bde mi 'gyur gdan la bzhugs: dam tshig dag pa'i brda phyag 'tshal: gzung ba dag pa phyi yi tshogs: a la la ho dgyes par rol: 'dzin pa grol ba nang gi tshogs: a nu rā ga pū dza stobs:rlung sems dag pa gsang ba'i tshogs: bho dhi tsit+ta mnyam par rol: bza' ba tshogs pa'i dga' ston la: rnam rtog spros dang bral bar spyod: phyi nang rlung bcu rnam dag cing: rtsa ba yan lag chags nyams byang sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam srungs: sgyu lus lha sku mngon gyur nas: bde mchog mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gral: gnyis med ro gcig dbang bsgyur nas:

gdul bya bde ba mchog la byedar: 17na gnyis lhun sdo/ba phrin las mdzod: de ltar bskangs bas tshogs chen rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za: pad+ma'i thugs bcud zab pa'i chos skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gnas yul srung ma'i bskangs ba rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu shā o rgyan gyis slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim snyi zhes pa'angalung zin o rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis lha reg dang 'tsho byed a dṛ ta'i skyes bcas bskul ngor kho bo pad+ma dbang gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin shrī tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
'a( tsu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i mdun bskyed g.yang gi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so:

gsaX na mo pad+ma rā dza ya: sgro〉khye/3 131 rgyal ba kun dngos gsung gi dbang phyug rje pad+ma rgyal po'i zhabs pad spyi bor len snyigs ma'i dbul phong rgud pa skyobs pa'i phyir: mdun bskyed g.yang gi sgrub pa'adi ru bstan: sa mayā phun tshogs sa gzhi gong mas byin brlabs gnas: nyi ma byang bsgrod rtsi thog rgyas pa'i dus nyi zla shar snga nub phyi chu spang rgyas ljon shing ra ba rgya lam mdun nas 'dud: dbyar gyi ra ba 'byung ba dar ba'i skabs yar tshes bzang por phun tshogs rdzas bsags te: kha tog lnga ldan snod kyi nang du gzhug: gnasachen dag gi sa rdo'i bye ma dang chen po rnams kyi dkor nor 'bru sna dang: g.yang spu stag gzig ris dang rin chen rigs sman sna 'brusna dar zab g.yang phor dang: zung 'jug snying po bzang drug chos sman sbyar: 'bru yis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bkod steng 'jog g.yang ba shas nor bu mda' dar lhun po dang gangs dkar bye ma bkra' yag 'ja' lngas 'byugs ba sbal khyungasogs g.yang lha drug gis bstod bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun: nye ba'i rin chen phyi nang mchod sprin dang: spos dang mar miyon chab tshogs ston sogs bkod pa khyad par 'phags pas mchod cing bstod: bse rag bkar zhing khyims khrus g.yang bsang spro: dar zab ba dan 'phan yab mang po bsgreng rol moliregs byed bkra shis rdzas rnams 'bud rnal 'byor lta ba'i gdeng bskyed brtul zhugs skyongs: nyams dga' dang spro skyo ba med pa ru

btsa(: ting 'dzin gsal ba'i 'di ltar bskyed bzlas bya sgo ma hā shuh+ye ta sogs at+ma ko3nya:gzung 'dzin snang ba ka dag chos skur sbyangs:'od gsal snang ba rgya tshad bral ba'i mdangs:bkod pa phun tshogs a rgyan mkha' spyod gling:brda don rtags kyi bkod pa phun tshogs dbus:rtag par 'ja' khyims dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bstod 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang char ltar 'bebs pa'i klong:bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna bdun:nye ba'i rin chen lha klu'i nor sna spungs:stag sgo gzig sgo dred sgro nai le'i skyal:dgos 'dod longs spyod sprin char 'bebs pa'i dbus:rat+na bdun gyi gzhal med khang chen po:zla gam sgo gru rta bab glo 'bur sogs:ma 'dres bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dzasarin chen khri rkang gdong lnga pad+ma'i khar:bde stong nyi ma zla ba zhal sbyor khrir:trī:las 'od zer spro bsdus yongs gyur pa:mdun bskyed khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal:blta na sdug pa zhi 'dzum chags bde 'bar lwa thod rin chen srog zhu dar 'phan 'phyangs:dri bralaper thung 'dung ma mthing sham dang:dmar ser chos gos za 'og ber chen klubs sāg lhum dang

bcas rgyal po rol stabs 'gyeng: phyag g.yas snang ba dbang bsdud ḍā ru 'khrol g.yon pa 'khor 'das phywa 'bebs me long brten: 'od 'chang lha mos nor sna 'dod yon stobs:dpa' bo pho tshogs rdo rje'i bro la gnas: dpa' mo ma tshogs glu dang gar la rol: ging dang ling gas lha mi'i nor sna bskul: brtse ba'i zur mig skal ldan mos mtshor ngoms: srid zhi'i dpal ster o rgyan nor gyi lha: gser mdog gzugs thung gsos khyims bum ltar ldir: rat+na dar chas zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs: shing tog pu ra ne le'i rkyal ba 'dzin 'od zer du ma 'bar ba'i dbang rgyal sku: mtshan bzang blta bas chog mi shes par gsal: 'phrul gyi lde miganor bu dgra 'dul ni: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nor bu gter bum 'dzin:rnam bzhi'i 'od zer gdul bya'i dpal du spro: lha dbang lha yi bla ma 'dod pa'i rgyal: dbang phyug chen pos srid gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur: g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen be+eḍūr zhal:rin chen 'bru dang rat+na'i char ba 'bebs: 'dzam lha rigs lngas gling bzhi'i dpal 'byor bskul: gter bdag phywa g.yang nor gyi bdag po ni: dpag med khroms tshogs lta bur

btsa( lam mer bskyed: mon dang sog po a tsa ra bal bod tā zig a grags rug yul ma la ya'i: bka' 'khor dam tshigs 'dzin pa thams cad kun: cha lugs sna tshogs rin chen dar zab spro: gu ru'i dgyes bskang bstan 'dza'i so chas sgrubs: sgog gis bskul te lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims: spos dang mar me rol mo spros: mda' dar g.yab bzhin 'ad skad brdzod hūṃ trī: rnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal ri nas: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po spyan 'dren gshegs: o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus nas: 'od 'chang bde ba'i sku can spyan 'dren gshegs: tshad med thugs rje chen po'i klong dkyil nas: rdo rje dpa' bo pho tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phrin las rtsol ba med pa'i klong dkyil nas: pad+ma dpa' mo ma tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: mdzad pa mi nub chags thog bral ba'i sku: ging dang lang ga'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren gshegs: srid zhi'i skyabs mgon o rgyan nor gyi lha:gdungs shugs bu yis 'bod do spyan 'dren gshegs: pad+ma'i phrin las seng chen dgra bla'i rje: snyigs dus gdung ba bsal phyir spyan 'dren gshegs: bkra shis g.yang gi lha mo

dpal chen mo: dbul ba bsal phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: dbang phyug chen po lha yi bla ma rje: srid gsum dbang du bsdud phyir sbyan 'dren gshegs: 'dzam lha rigs lnga gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs: phyu 'bebs g.yang sdud dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams yangs pa dog mor byed bzhin dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs: ma pad+ma rā dza swāpa ri wa rabadz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni: hūṃ hrī: rin chen sna bdun pho brang 'od re gsal: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla mdangs dang ldan dgos 'dod longs spyod nor sna lhun re 'thug: 'di la pad+ma rgyal po gtso 'khor bzhugs: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya ste: phyag 'tshal ni na mo: bsod nams chen po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam:'dod dgu'i longs spyod phywa g.yang char ltar 'bebs: dngos grub rgya mtsho sprin char 'thib bzhin gtibs: dpa' bo khyed la sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal na mo na ma ya ho: phyi mchod ni: hū hrī: reg na bde ba'i mchog ster ut+pal mig: man+ta ra ba'i thod bcing mkha' la spyod: nyer spyod bdun sprin spro ba'i mdza' na mo: rjes chags bskul phyir pad+ma rgyal por

gtsurte 'bul: o ma hā pū dza sa ma ya ho: nang mchod ni hūṃ hrī: dga' ba bcu drug rlung gi rta la bskyon: thig le bcu drug gnas su dag byed cing: mtshan dpe'i dpal sbyin 'dod yon lha mo lngas: bde ba mchog bskul ma hā pu dza spro: a ma hā a nu rāg sa ma ya ho: gsang mchod ni: hūṃ nyi zla gzhon pad dkar phreng bas bskor 'dra'i gzis: nyon mongs tsha gdung skom pa'i dbul ba sel: dpa' bo'i sku la bde bas rgyas 'debs pa'i: rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug gus pas 'bul: snyed ma hā su kha pūdza sa ma yaho: bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni: : hrī: bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas: rin chen gdugs bum gser nya dpal belu rgyang grags pad+ma rgyal mtshan 'khor lo rnams: dbyings las spros te pad+ma rgyal por 'bul: o ma hā mang ga lam sarba pu dza ho: rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hūṃ hrī: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dpal 'byor nor gyi gter nor bu chos 'khor khyims bdag btsun mo dang cang shes glang po dmag dpon rin po che: gus pas 'bul lo tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes sa ma hā maḍi rat+na sarba byudza ho rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni:nyu snyi nyon mongs gdung

zhi dbul ba sel ba'i nor: li khri mtshal chen ghi waṃ yung dkar zho rtsa mchog ku sha bil ba dung 'khor ma : bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas mchog rnam pa brgyad: dbul ba bsal phyir pad+ma rgyal por 'bul: 3 ma hā tsakra sidhi sarba pū dza ho: maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni:6sgo ā hūṃ:stong gsum mi mjed lha klu mi yi dpal: bde stong dga' ston sgyu lus lha mor bcas: chos dbyings rig pa 'od gsal snang bzhis brgyan:srid zhi'i dpal mgon pad+ma rgyal por 'bul:sa/ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la ma hā byu dza ho: bsang mchod 'bul ba ni:( hrī: thabs shes dgong sngon dbyings dang dog mo sa:bdud rtsi chab kyis brlan phab lha shing rigs:tsan dan dkar dmar a gar shugs sngon dang:'om bu dmar po gya rta nya thud dang:mkhan dkar lha mo sman shing sgron shing sogs: bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna mang po yang: 'byung ba mer bsregs rlung gis bskul byas te: mkha' dbyings dog mor byed pa'i bsang sprin ni:kun tu bzang pa'i dga' ston mtha' yas pas: mchod do nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams bsang: lha yi phywa g.yang sbrang char bzhin tu phob: mchod do bar snang gang ba'i gnyam rnams bsang:gnyan gyi

ba rte phywa g.yang sprin dpung 'khrigs ltar bsdus:mchod do klu gnyan sa bdag gtod sde bsang klu yi phywa g.yang rgya mtsho 'khyil ltar bskyil:mgon skyabs sdong grogs byed pa'i dgra bla bsang:mi dang ma 'bral kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod:zas lha g.yang lha grogs lha thams cad bsang:mi rab bcu gsum gang bzhin stong med mdzod nor lha phywa g.yang gter gyi bdag po bsang:btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzoms pa'i phrin las stsol:bde skyid chos bzhin spyod ba'i skal ldan rnams:rnga yab dpal rir 'khod pa'i smon grub mdzod:phye mar 'bul ba ni:hūṃ hrī:gangs dkar shes rir gdong lnga 'jas 'khyud dpe:lha yi mar la klu yi zhun sbyar ba/ 'bru sna bdun gyi phye mar spungs pa 'di pad+ma rgyal po 31 rgyan nor lhar 'bul:tsho rab kun tu thugs rjes ma dor skyongs:srid pa'i ba sbal khyung gsum dpal 'dzoms 'di:'od 'chang bde sbyin dpa' bo mkha' 'gror 'bul:phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub rtag par bskyil:khyu mchog cang shes glang po rin po che:seng chen 'dzam lha ma hā de war 'bul:btsan dang phyug dang 'phan dar ldan par mdzod pad+ma'i

dga' tshal zas sna dar zab bcas:g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo la 'bul:'di bde phyi skyid tshe chos dpal gsum stsol:nam zhig mu ge'i bskal pa dar tsa na bdud rtsi chos dang zas kyi char ba phob:bde skyid chos dang mthun pa'i dpal spyod bzhin:o rgyan mkha' 'gra'i gling dbus 'tshogs par shog:g.yang 'bod ni:hūṃ gyisnang ba mtha' yas pad+ma gsung gi rgyal bde ba'i sku can gu ru rin po che:'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ka ma las 'khrungs rje:pad+ma rgyal po thugs dam gnad nas bskul:dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal bskyod la:ye shes gzigs pas gdul bya'i mos mtshor skyongs:lha lam tshe mda' dar tshon g.yab cing bskul:mchog rab ri ltar brdzid la ston chos mdzod:yar la bsor bas lha srung bu 'phang bstod rtag par mi dang ma bral kha 'dzin 'dzod:stong gsum stong gi phywa g.yang dbang du bsdus g.yas su bskor bas pho rgyud las la bskul:rtag tu phywa 'bebs che brjed phun stogs byed:g.yon du bskor bas mo rgyud gnad nas bskul:mos mthun g.yang 'bebs lhun 'thug 'dzoms par byed:rdzas la dbab pas bsod

ba rte nams nor gyi gter:bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar gsol ba btab pas re ba yongs su skong:ci bsam smin bzhin dngos grub kun 'byung mdzod:g.yang 'bod bsdus pa ni:hūṃ nyirnga yab gling nas o rgyan rje:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas:dad pas bskul lo gnas 'dir byon:btsan po'i btsan g.yang 'dir khug cig phyugs po'i phyugs g.yang 'dir khug cig:'phan po'i 'phan g.yang 'dir khug cig:dar ba'i dar g.yang 'dir khug cig g.yang nga6gas 'o phud mchod pa bzhes:ma byin blang dang ser sna bshags:'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ba phob bsod nams lha dang mnyam par mdzod:brgya stong la sogs ci rigs brjod bzlas pa ni rang pad+ma rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i dbang mdog lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis bskul te:mdun bskyed gco 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas pa'i sku yi cha thams cad nas bsod nams longs spyod dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i char phab:gnas khang bang mdzod tho phyi thams cad phywa g.yang dngos grub kyis mer mer chil chil gang bar bsam:ma mahwa gu ru pad+ma rā dzaya ba sudhe

wa ye: ma hā rā dza ya: ta thā ga ta ya: arta te saṃmyaka saṃ bud+dhā ya: tadu shā: a rat+na rasgo bā su bā su: kha dhe kha dhe pā shaṃ a mā ra ṇa: su mi su 36 su su mi ni mi ni mi: a lasto a dṛ tri: a gar+sha ya bsdus bsdus hūm̐ rat+na sid+dhi pha la khug skyol: brgya stong la sogs ci rigs brjod: de nas g.yang blan ni:hūṃ ༷ ka ma las 'khrungs pad+ma rgyal po yis: kha ba'i ljong gi phywa g.yang nor gyi gter: ga dar gzhan dbang ma regar 'dir bsdus la: nga yi dpal du sgrub pa'i rdzas la blan ca co'i tshig gis bskul ba mang lags kyang: cha lugs 'jig rten chos brgyad kho nas ched ja dar zas nor dpal bskyed tsam min par: nya gang zla bzhin 'di phyi'i dpal du blan: ta tha spyor sgol mdzad phrin mu mtha' yas: tha chad theg dman blo yi yul min yang: da lta sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rjes zhugs pas: na 'chi'i dbul ba bsal phyir g.yang du blan pa pur mi 〈snar smra ba kun tu rgyu'i: pha rol gzhan dbang gdug pas mi bsgyur bar: ba rnga rang lcags chos ltar brab bcos nas: ma ki ngan 'gro'i rba 1nga skem phyir blan tsa ma ra tsa'i kheng ldan bdud sde dang: tsha grang sdug bsngal gzhir gyur kun spyod las:

bsgotshu dza gad snying zhugs ltar min dran shes kyis wā ki shwa ra'i thugs bzhed 'grub phyir blan: zha bo ltar du 'jig rten chos kyis bslus: za zis yeng ba'i 'khor ba'i gnas su brgyud : 'a ya rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rjes bsnyegs nas: ya rab gong ma'i rjes su slob phyir blan: ra ltar 'jig rten sred pa yongs bor nas: la 'ur bsam pa sna gcig chos la gzhol: sha tsha'i gnas gyur 'gro la phan bde sgrub: sa mthon rgyal sras rjes su slob phyir blan: ha ha kun rdzob sgyu ma ltar rtog ste: a ti kun bzang don dam bden pa'i 1nga: e baṃ thabs shes gnyis med phyag rgya yis: e waṃ gzugs skus 'gro khams dong sprugs re ga: brngan bzhugs ni: snyen phan bde 'byung gnas dam pa chos kyi g.yang: mi 'gyur brtan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa dang: bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thang stobs kyi g.yang: mi nub 'dod 'byung dbang rgyal lta bu dang: bkra shaṃs tsho 'phel 'chi ba med pa'i g.yang: don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod bya'i phyir: g.yang rten sgrub pa'i rdzas la brtan par bzhugs: rten snying dang: a su

pra tisgo badz+ra ye swā hā mchod bstod ni:hūṃ nyi kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i: phyi nang gsang gsum rnam dag mchod pa'i sprin 'dod yon lha mo mdzes pa'i gar dang bcas:pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul: 3 ma hā su kha a nu rā ga badz+ra pū dza sa ma ya rdo hūṃ myi mi 'gyur lhun po mchog rab ri ltar brdzid 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gang ga'i rgyun ltar 'bebs mi g.yo lhun po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod bsngo smon ni:je gu ru pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas:bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i bden mthu yis: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid 'byung ba dang rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su grol bar re ga lan gsum:shis brjod ni na mo: phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dar ba dang: bshad sgrub 'khor los 'tsho ba'i bkra shis regag yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid ldan pa dang dge bcu'i khrims la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa dang mdzad phrin mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: zas nor longs spyod phywa g.yang 'phel ba dang: phong rgud dbul ba sel

gtsarnyi ba'i bkra shis shog: nam mkhar mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa: sku gnyis mdzad pas smin grol bkra shis shog: de ltar bsnyen cing sgrubs nas su dgyes bskangs tshogs dang mchod pa spro: slar yang rjes sugayang gtad pa yon bdag bde ba'i stan la 'khod gos dkar bgo zhing rgyan chas gdag bden tshig smon lam brjod pa ni: e: dan/na mdza ga rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal ma :bden tshig smon lam thams cad 'grub gyur cig srid pa phywa rje rgyal po'i phywa g.yang de bsam 'grub khyung chen dkar pos sna drangs te: yon bdag skyes pa pho la stsal du gsol:srid pa gtsug rje rgyal po'i gtsug g.yang de ba dkar g.yu yi rgyan ldan sna drangs te: yon bdag za ma mo la stsol du gsol: srid pa dmu rje rgyal po'i dmu g.yang de: ma hā gser gyi sbal bas sna drangs te: yon bdag byis pa rnams la stsal du gsol: srid pa phywa rje rgyal po'i phywa g.yang de: khyu mchog cang shes glang pos sna drangs te: yon bdag bsod nams mnga' thang dpal du stsol: lag pa'i mthil du zas dang nor gyis gang: byed pu'i steng du mar khu'i mtsho mo 'byil: stag sgo gadz+reg sgro dred sgro nor snas phyur dga' ston bde skyid phun

tshogs dpal du bkod: thams cad chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: g.yang bgos gtad la: hūṃ hrī: g.yang bshos rin chen nyi zla'i 'od 'bar 'di: yon bdag bsod nams dpal 'dzoms khyed la gtad: lha g.yang mi la 'khor phyir g.yang khu ye mi g.yang mnga' thang 'byor phyir g.yang khu ye: klu g.yang bkra shis yid bzhin g.yang khu ye: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dbang thang g.yang khu ye: stong gsum mi mjed dga' ston g.yang khu ye : tshe chos bsod nams nor gyi g.yang khu ye: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog g.yang rgye gto la hūṃ hrī: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu yis: smon lam gang btab yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: rin chen nor gyi bang mdzod gter bum 'di yid bzhin rte'u le yi skyal ba de: dar tshon sna lnga g.yang spu mang pos brgyan: yon bdag bsod nams dpal phyug khyod la gtad: kha g.yang bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig bzhin du: ci bsam gang 'dod yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig: 'chi ba med pa tshe yi g.yang khu ye: nub pa med pa dpal gyi g.yang khu ye rgud pa med pa nor gyi g.yang khu ye: 'bad pa med pa zas kyi g.yang khu
