gas/: ye: rtsol ba med pa phyugs kyi g.yang khu ye: ci bsam don 'grub gang 'dod lag tu 'ong: phywa g.yang 'phel rgyas nub med bkra shis shog: phye mar gto la: khre : phan bga'abyung gnas chos kyi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la 'byor bar shog: rgyal ba yab sras thugs bskyed g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: dzobatsun sgol ma'i phrin las g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: rje btsun dam pa'i bsgom pa'i g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: rgya gar rgyal po'i sman gyi g.yang: skal ldan khyed la phun tshogs shog: rgya nag rgyal po'i ja dar g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: rta g.yang 'dzad med sog gi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: bal po'i yul gyi lugagi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog tā zeg rgyal po'i nor gyi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: 'dan ma'i yul gyi 'bru yi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: a bsiliyul gyi go khrab g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog : rug yul byi ru dngul gyi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs shog: gong gre'u dkor nor

mdzod kyi g.yang: skal ldan khyod la phun tshogs re ga bde skyid phun sum tshogs gyur nas: don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis thegag zas sna gto la: 37: bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa bsam don phun tshogs 'grub pa'i phyir zad med zas dang nor 'byor phyir: bkra shis 'o ma zho yi skyems: 'brang rgyas zla phrum dkar gyi bshos zas sna sna tshogs khyod la gtad: bsod nams dpal 'byer phun tshogs shing bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis shog: rdzas rtags rgyal srid gto la: hūṃ ༷ rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe las byung ba'i bkra shis rtags kyi dbang bskur ro: bcom ldan dpa' bo'i gdul byar gyur byang chub sems dang ldan par shog: sngon me+e lha dbang la sogs pas: bkra shis rdzas phul byin brlabs bzhin:deng 'dir khyod la gtad byas pas yid bzhin dpal gyi bkra shis shog: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yi: bsod nams las 'khrungs nor sna bdun: yon bdag dpal phyug khyod la gtad: 'phags pa'i gdul byar 'gyur bar shog rat+na maṅga le a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de lhar sbyor dngos rjes tshang bas: g.yang gi sgrub pa zab mor brtson: tshogs bsags mchad pa rgya cher spro don gnyis

—4rdo yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur: sa maya ye rgyal b.lidabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus thams cad rin chen gteragyis bkang: khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i skor mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra sdoms rin chen brda yi ris su 'gyur med bkod: snyigs ma sum cu kha ral rgud pa'i dus: nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan dpa' bos rted: rten 'brel dbang gi rgud pa sna tshogs sel 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing la 'god par 'gyur bka' 'di gter srung skru gri gsum la gnyer thub par srungs shig nyams pa can la sdoms: thugs sras tshogs smon lasaldan dpal du shog: sa mtha rgya rgyargya: mdun bskyed g.yang gi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad gyo sbasargya zab gyo gsangargya:gu mi tsha rgyan gyi sgob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim:snyi: zhes pa'angs khyung rba gsar sku skyes waka gi mtshan can gyis thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg bcas bskul ba dang: kho boklo yangs sbas pamirnal 'byor rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin 30yis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarbamaṅgalam/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i byin 'bebs dbang gi 'od zer stong 'khyugs bzhugs so:btsar+sha na mogu rupad+ma rādza ya: can24bye/da khyed shes dad pa drag po yis snyan gsan dbab cing byin 'bebs pa: lta spyod ting 'dzin dag pa yi glugar rol mo'i sgras bskul te nyu hrī dza: bgachen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje che: 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan 'od snang mtha' yas pas: gnas 'dir byin phob byin rlabs char ltar bsnyil: dostong zung 'jug pad+ma 'od gling nas: rab 'byams rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje che: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje thod phreng rtsal: gnas 'dir byin phob dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsol:khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas: srid gsum zil gnon 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal: bde ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma rgyal po yis: gnas 'dir byin phob dga' bzhi'i sgon me sbor dhu ma tha la dāk+ko'i tshogs dbus nas: rgyal ba kun yum bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas: mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo mtsho rgyal mas: gnas 'dir byin phob dga'

bzhi'i 'od gsal sbor zla gam dbang chen e yi klong dkyil nas: rjes chags bzhad pa'i 'dzum zhal ngoms pa'i gar rta skad gtsug bton rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis gnasa'adir byin phob nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed bka' bab bde chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: smin grol sgrubs pa'i drod rtags mngon gyur ba: rje 'bangs lo paṇa dpa' bomakha' 'gro yis gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dkyil gsar mtha' skyongs rdo rje'i sgog ldan pa: ging dang lang ka dam can rgya mtsho ni: pho nya yang g.yog mu mtha' yas pa yis: gnas 'dir byin phob phrin las char du bsnyil: dkyil bshadar gzhal yas sgrub rdzas yo byad kun: thams cad dag mnyam rol par dbang byin phob: lusangag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su rgyas thob cig: e badz+ram hāgu rupad+ma rādza bīdudh+wa ras pā ri wa ra sam yapo dza de ltar byin chen dbab byas pas sgrub rdzas yo byad thams cad la: dpal dang gzi byin bskyed par 'gyur: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'byung:sa mayā:e rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying

btsa( po'i skor mi 'gyur rin chen brda yi rgyar bcug ste: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgong pra bsdoms: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab: skru gri mched la bka' yis gnyer byang gtad pad+ma'i rigs la rdo rje'i ming 'dzin pa: nga sprul thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: gdul bya'i lhag ma las 'phro can rnams skyongs: 'brel tshad rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su 'god: dam nyams 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar skal ldan gdul bya'i pad tshal bzhad gyur cig sam yu rgyargya rgya byin 'bebs dbang gi 'od zer stong 'byugs rdzogs so: gartar rgya: gtad rgya: sbasargya: zab rgya gsang rgya gugya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: bdothim:snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang a khyung rba gsar sprul sku ngag gi mtshan can gyis thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg bcas te bskul ba dang: tshogs smon las 'dzoms gosari 'on po o rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis lha reg 'tsho byedasman gyi skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lungazin swecasabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga 44ma/

ga66 bstod pa ni: nyu hrī ma chags pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal mnga' ba: mtshan dang dpe byad rgya mtshos rnam par 'khyud: rdzes chags brtse bas gdul bya bu bzhin skyong:gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la bstod: skyomod don dang 'gags bral brda yis brgyud: dkri drang tshig dang gsung dbyangs yan lag gis: gdul bya'i rgyud smin bden gnyis mngon par rtogs: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i gsung la bstod:shasda byalichos rnams ji ltar mkhyen pa dang: ji snyed gzigs pas sa dang lam la 'god: phyin bcu'i thugs bskyed gdul bya 'dren stobs can: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs la bstod: ces bstod pa rgyas par bya zhes par smon nas nus ldan pas so:(16 rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs rmad byung ba: rtog ges ma bslad mkha' 'gro gsang mdzod brda: chu bo bdun ldan rim gnyis yang rtse'i bcud: minyams kun khyab byed rmitshan ltar gyur cig: ces ḍāke mang pos de ltar bsgrags pa'i nyams mched pas modanusaldan pas so:
—10 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dal du bsreg blugs 'bul ba khams gsumadabang sdud dbang gilcags kyu bzhugs so:

r+shar+sha) na mo gu ru pad+ma rā dza ya: sgo1/sgrinyu/11 phrin las rnams bzhi lhun grub cing 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang dbang bsgyur phyir gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yi dal du bsreg blugs mchod pa 'bul:sa mashā: 'om bu re sa/sa dbang shing gis : me thab zla gam tshul du bkod: 'bar me dar dmar pang kheb dang: thod ching rlung g.yab tshang bar bsags las bum gsal gdab kha chab blang: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'dzin dang po bsreg rdzas byinarlabs ni ma ā:྅: rin chen mdzes pa'i snod mchog yangs pa rtsa las bzhi lhun grub bsreg rdzas rnam pa bzhi: ngo bo bdud rtsi rnam pa so so'i tshul: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor dgyes bskyed gyur: ces ā:hūṃ swā ྅ na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo je shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tad kho āt+pa te spra ra ṇa e me gha gha na khaṃ ma ra ya ku ru ye swā hā lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: me sbarab ni: hūṃ: me yi ngo bo snang mtha' yas: rang bzhin 'bar zhing bskyod byed pa: phrin las dbang gi sgo 'byed cing: 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang phun tshogs byed swe: pad+ma rā dza a sne ye badz+ra dz+wa la ram: rlung bskul ba ni hūṃ tshang chen 'byung ba rlung gi dal: dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha' las bskul: dbang gi phrin las lhun grub phyir: gdug pa'i me dbal zhi gyur cig

——1 yo kuru phyomo yeswā hā thab khang lha bskyed ni:shā nyi midamigs stong pa chos dbyings ngang nyid las: ye shes lnga ldan rab 'bar me yi 1nga pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhibasnol ba'i khar: rig pa hrī:las spro bsdus 'od zer gyis:bskul temadun bskyed pad+ma rgyal po ni: khams gsum dbang bsdud rā ga'i zhal mnga' ba: srid gsum zil gnon zhi'adzum chags nyams 'bar dar ber dbang gos la thod rin chen brgyan:'khore 'das phywa 'beb ḍā ru me long 'dzin: srid zhi dbang sdud rgyal po rol pa'i tshul: zla gam dbang gi'od zer kun nas 'khrigs: 'od 'chang mdzes pas g.yon nas mchod sprin stobs: dpa' po lo tshags rdo rje'i bro la gnas dpa' mo mo tshogs 'dzum pa'i glu la rol: rdo rje'irnal 'byor dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed bsgyur ging dang lang gas dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdung tshad med phyag rgyas phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub: 'ja' 'od zer 'khrigs snang ba dbang dubyed: srog gis bskul te rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad+ma rgyal po dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas:spyan drangs dam yi gnyis med ro gcig bsre: mda' dar dmar po g.yab la sbyan drangs ba ni

hūṃ trī: o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus nas: khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma rā dza la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor dang: ging dang lang ka dam can rgya mtshos bskor: 'bar ba dbang gi las la spyan 'dren gshegs: bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin cher g.yos nas: phyu dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma pad+ma rā dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza: ku sha phul la bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ hrī: ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge: rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas: gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: brtse bar dgongs nas bzhugs su gsol: ma pad+ma rā dza sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni na mo bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal: zla gam dbang gi 'od zer kun nas 'khyugs: chags bde'i zil ba gdul bya'i yul la 'debs pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa na mo na ma rdo phyi mchod ni hūṃ ༷ mjes sdug blta na sdug pa'i lha mo yis: kun bzang mchod sprin sna tshogs phyag las spro: 'gags med rgyan gyi bye brag mchod pa'i sprin: pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul: skyod ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra pur+sha skyosbre a 'o/ ke gharnye nai

r+shaXrmya we h+ye shabha pra tits+tsha ā:྅: nang mchod ni nyu hrī: dga' ba'i dpal sbyin re ba skong mdzad pa'i: phyag rgya dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i tshogs: tshul dgu'i dpal /ḍūrdo 'dod yon phyag las spro: bde ba bskul phyir pad+ma rgyal por 'bul: o ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra du pā shabhak+tarnye ras spadhe pra tits+tsha.uhūṃ: gsangamachod ni: hūṃhrī: reg na dga' bde'i dpal ster yid 'od ma: mdzes sgegs chags bde 'bar ba'i lang tsho can bcu drug 'khril 'khyud rol ba'i gar g.yo bzhin pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul: sa ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra lwa gyi mā gye girti nirti ga mu tra pratits+tsha.ādzasgru: sman rag gtor mchod ni: hūṃ hrī: zag med yi shes bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: rten 'brel gnas stong rak+ta dmar chen po: 'dod yon ro mchog ma hā bā ling ta: bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rgyal por 'bul: zhi ma hā pañtsaya mṛta rak+ta bā linganya khā hi: byon skyems ni hūṃ hrī: rtsi yi mar dang 'bru yi mar: byang chub sems kyi bcud chen po: dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rol ston 'di: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: pañtsa a mṛ tashāX nyer gcig dag gis

phul bar bya zhi ba'i rdzas til dkar nag phul la hūṃnyi mi mthun nyes pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba'i phyir: 'bru mchog til dang mar khu'i mchod pa 'bul: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug ming med par: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub tu gsol: rtsa sngags mthar sarba pa shrī dha ha na a dṛ ta khā nyi brgya rtsa phul la 'dod gsol ni: ho: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor khams gsum dbang bsdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la: bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: nad mug mtshon gsum 'jigs pa brgyad sogs rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: rgyas pa'i bsreg rdzas yam shing dang 'bras shing tog rnams phul la: hūṃ myi dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir tsan dan yam shing 'bras dang shing tog 'bul: dpal 'byor longs spyod rigs rgyud 'phel ba dang phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub char ltar phob: rtsa sngags mthar bho dhi ṣ+ṭṛ k+ta puṣ+ṭa ye ga ga na bā ma ki te swā hā: brgya rtsa phul la 'dod gsol ni ho: khams gsum dbang sdud kyi rgyal po gu ru pad+ma rā dza 'khor

shā zi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la bdwad rtsi bsreg blags kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: rnal 'byor ba'i tshe dang (dred nams dpal dang 'byer ba bkrarge darngo gzi mdangs mang/ thang stobs dbarngo thams cardo gong nas rgeng du /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: dbang gi bsreg rdzas li khri dang nas so ba rnams phul laḥ hūṃ trīḥ la/ ma/sa gsum srid gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i phyiraḥ li khri mtshal chen so ba nas rnams 'bulaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba dang ཿ byā dang g.yang gi dngos grub char ltar phobaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaX sarba mang ga le bhe gshe dza ye swā hāḥ brgyad rtsa phul la 'dod gsol niḥ ho: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje phywa g.yang gter gyi bdag po gu ru pad+ma rgyal po 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: lha 'dre mi gsum gyi sgog 'phrog pa dang 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang gi char chen po 'beb pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: drag po'i bsreg rdzas yungs dkar dang ku sha gro rnams phul la: nyu 〉〉 nyon mongs nad gdon dgra bgegs

tshar gcod phyir: 'bru mchog yungs dkar ku sha gro dkar 'bul: bstan pa'i dgra dang thar lam 'phrog pa'i bgegs: mngon spyod drag pos ming med stong par mdzod rtsa sngagasamathar sarba athosidzhai.apra tiha ta ghasma ri swā ྅ brgya rtsa phul la 'dod gsol ni ho: 'jigs byed mthu stobs kyi bdag po khams gsum dbang gi sku mchog gu ru pad+ma rgyal po 'khoradapa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la: bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang tshe sgog la rgol ba'i bgegs tshogs nad mug mtshon gsum gyi 'jigs pa mi mthun bkra mi shes pa'i phyogs ras ngan pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: spro na bstod pargyas par bya: skabs 'dir spro na bskang tshogs bya: bsnyen sgrub las gsum bzlas pa gtong: yin badz+ra te bu la ye swā shā sortsi'abul: yin badz+ra'agiye swā hā reg bya phul: gtang rag mchod bstod ni: / ༷ taing 'jin las 'khrungs phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: yid 'ong rdo rje rig ma'i gar dang bcas pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul sku drin gso phyir gtang rag bzhes su

rā rto gsol: o ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra pukhye dhu pe a lo ke ghadhe nai wi h+ye shabha dū pā shabha ghadhe ra sa spar+sha ma hā mu tra bho dhi tsit+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bā ling ta khā hi:r+shar+shar+sha skyems khrul ba ni hūṃ trī: ye shes slong yangs 'khyil ba'i ho khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtang rag mchod pa 'di: gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par dgongs te rol thun mong grub brgyad mchog gi dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcig brjod la phul bar bya: bstod pa ni: hūṃ trī: pad+ma rā ga'i zhal can mtshan dpes 'khyud: khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro king dang ling ka 'byed pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: dngos grub ni: lo ā:྅: mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa las: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma thugs rje can pad+ma rā dza brtseb chen pos dgongs: mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wāk+ka cit+ta sarbasirnyi phal ༷ gtor ma 'bul ba ni: rinachenasgod du gtor ma ni: bdud rtsir gyur cig oṃ ā:hūṃ: ju hrī: thugs rje che ldan pad+ma rgyal po la bzang drug li khri mtshal chen

a dṛ ta: chos sman sbyar ba'i baX sa bu mchod par 'bul: bzhes nas bde chen ye shes 'bar bar mdzod:rtsa sngags mthar a dṛta bāling ta khā hi nyer gcig gis phul 'dod gsol gdab bzod gsol ni hūX bde ba'i sku mchog pad+ma rgyal po dgongs: bdag rmongs 'khrul bas ting 'dzin bying rmug nongs: cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gyur pa kun: mi 'chab mi sped yeshesalha la bshags: sam ya ā: yig brgya bzlas la lhag chad bskangs lhag ma ni: bla 〈〈gaṭa bāyingata khā ༷ lhag mgron rnams tshim par gyur bsdu rim ni: bye rdi yi shes dbyings las shar ba'i lha tshogs rnams: da ni mdzad pa phrin las mthar phyin pas: rang rig 'od gsal bde ba chen por hūṃ: nam yang thugs rjes ma 'dor brtse bas skyong ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbyings su gshegs dam tshig pa rang gi thugs gar bsdu'o: bsngo smon ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge kun gcig bsdus te: 'khor gsum yongs dag ye shes chos skur bsngo: nang dbyings ye shes bla ma'i sa thob nas gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro khams dong sprugs shog: lan gsum shis brjod ni: na mo: rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang:

——14 der 'dzin thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub kyis: skye rgu bde legs dpal la sbyor ba dang: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog: de ltar shis brjod rgya cher bya: gang bsam las bzhi lhun gyis grub: khyad par mos bzhi dbang du 'du: phyu g.yang longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur sa mawā: yi ma: rgyaladabang pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying: zab gsang brda yi ris su bcug rin chen bse yi sgrom rgyar bkod mdo khams rtse shod gsham du sbas gter bdag spu gri gsum la bcol: snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: rgyalabamatshag dbyings sprul bas rnyed bstan pa'i 'gro don rgya cher spro 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing la 'god don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sam yā: rgya rgya rgya: bsreg blugs 'bul ba khams gsum dbang bsdud dbang gi lcags kyu rdzogs so gartar phyo gtadargya: sbas gye zab rgya gsang rgya: gu rgya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: 3) zhes pa'ang skuskyisanywak+ki mtshan can dang las 'phro ldan pa gos ri 'on la.o rgyan nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ngor: kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'apyor rgyal mtshag bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lungazinashe—4 mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis/ sarba maṅgalam/

btsañtsa zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pa d+ma rgyal po'i bum gnyis sgrub pa yid bzhinadapal ster bzhugs so:—8rdo: namo gurupad+ma rādzaya: tsanayo/〈(( rin chen bum pa mgo ldan nang: bla med so lnga dri bzang chus: sum cha dgang la dal dbus bkod rnam lnga nyer spyod mdzes par bkram: de nas sgrub pa 'di ltaragatong: lo swā bha wa shudha: sarba dharma swā bha wa shusa3nyaḥ mi dmigs stong pa chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rin chen bum pa gzhal med khang mdzes nang: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar rig pa hrī ཿdmar spro bsdus zhi ba las: khamasagasum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal po'i sku: 'khor los brgyur rgyal rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: snang ba dbang bsdud ḍā ru me long 'dzin zla gam dbang gi 'od zer kun nas 'khrigs: dpa'abopho tshogs g.yas nas bro 'khrab cing: dpa' mo mo tshogs g.yon nas bro gar bsgyur: ging dang lang gas dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdungasaḥ 'od 'chang bde sbyin nor sna 'dod yon stobs: lhadabangachen pos khams gsum phywa g.yang sdud ge sar dgra blas bsod nams nor gter spro: g.yang gi

lha mos ra ba sgo bzhi srungs: 'dzam bha la yis yid bzhin re ba skong: sa rgyan nor lhas khams gsum chos la 'god: chags pa'i rdul bral dbang gi 'od zer 'bar: sgog gisabaskul te rnga yab dpal ri nas: rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag ni hūṃ gyi gling dbus mtsho dkyil pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtser: rang byung sangs rgyasagu ru pad rgyal rje: gnas 'dir spyan drangs brtan bzhugs phyag mchod 'bul: 37pad+marā dza sa ma ya r+sā dza:hūṃ bo rdo na mo na ma ya ho: mchoda'abul ni:hūṃsgyi gzung 'dze+en dag pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: 'dod yon phun tshogs lha mos rol gar bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul brtse bas bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol skyo ma hāsarba pañtsa pū dza rdo bstodapa ni: je ༷ chags sogs nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang: bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyas 'debs pa'i khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal po la lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas dmigs ni:rang dre ga sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la: 'khril te bum pa'i lha rnams thugs rgyud bskul: de dag sku las

bsgo/: byang chub sems kyi rgyun: dkar dmar bab pas bum pa gang bar dmigs: bla mahā guru pad+marwa dzasarba sirnyipha la3: brgya stong la sogs ci rigs brjod: gzhu ltar mgocing bstod par bya:tsan asasno bum palilha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas bum chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur: bla uhūṃ sam yatsū: de nas las bum bskyed pa ni:tsol subha washudhaḥsarbadharma swā bha wa shud+dhi3nya gribral 'od gsal dag pa'i bum pa rtsa yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i dbus pad zla nyi ma bam ro pho mo'i khar: rig pa hrī:dmar sprobasdus zhu ba las: dbang gorgyal po rta mchog bzhad pa rtsal: khro chas rab rdzogs gyad kyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: me dpung klong 'byeng rta zhal ljang sngon 'tsher: gri khug thod 'dziname yi 'od zer 'phro: sgog gis bskul te 'og min gnas mchog nas pad+ma dbang chen lha tshogs spyan drangs bstem: yin pad+maspu tar dzas maya:dza sam yastam:na moho: yinapad+ma kro ta rā dzas pā ri wa ra puṣ+ṭidhusgre acan kegadzha rnal h+ye shabha pañtsarak+ta bā'aja ta nyi ( hrī chos dze+e'od dpag med pa dbang gi sku: rjes chags bshad pa'i rta mchog rol pa

—rtsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor spro: bde stong spros bral 'bar ba'i sku la bstod:thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rig pa hrī:dmar po la sngags kyi breng bsabaskor ba'i 'od zer gyis 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad: 'bar ba'i 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis bum pa'i nang thams cad gang bar bsam:ṭ+wāṃbad+ma )kṛtapodz+ra krota h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa la sogs skabs bstun brjod sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa'i mthar bum pani lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsir gyur:ka āhūṃbadud rtsi sgrub pa ni:t+t+waṃ: bhan+ta yangs shing rgya che bar 'od lnga zlum 'khrul gyi klong du gu ru ā tsar+ya yab yum bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed mdzad pa'i mkha' gsang nas byang chub sems kyi bcudadakar dmar rmedangs ldan chu klung ltar bab pas bhan+ta ster gyis gang bar migs la: yidamahā guru ātsadu bhodzhaitsit+ta.a dṛta asheshaya armā yi brgya rtsa la sogs brjod mthar:yab yum bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas bhan+ta'i bcud bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur: bdag nyid 'dug cing rig me dor de nas gsang sngags spyad pa spyod:sa r+sā:eska rgyal dbang pad+mani thugs

gtsaX bcud 'di mdo khams bkra shis rdzong la sbas: snyigs mar gdul zhing phun tshogs skabs: yo rgyanasprul pas rnyed par 'gyur: bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur sam yu rgyargya rgya bum gnyis sgrub pa yid bzhin dpal ster rdzogs so: gartarargya: gtad rgya: sbasargya: zab rgya gsangargya: gu gye: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: 3) ces pa'angarba gsar sprul sku wak+ki mtshan can nas rgyang ring po nas bskul ba dang tshogs smon las 'dzoms o rgyanabastan 'ardzan nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ngor: kho bo rgyal mtshag bzhad ba rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzad las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni swecasabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i rtsa dbang bde ba chen po'idapal sbyin bzhugs so:

btsar+sha na mo gu ru pad+ma ra dza ya: sabyelca )khye11 ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs: gnyer ldan las la mkhas pa yis: gsang sngags dbang gi dkyil 'khor du skal pa ldan rnams smin par bya sa ma mā:dang tho dkyil 'khor bri ba ni: hūṃ hrī: mi 'gyur bde ba mchog gi sku mnga' ba: pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal can mkha' dbyings su: 'ja' tshon thig le 'dzin mas rgyas thob la: lnga ldan ye shes dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: t+t+waṃ: maṇ+ḍal saṃ kri ta las spa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa :: rgyan bkram pa ni: : hrī: bkod pa chen po lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir: bla bre 'phur ma rgyal mtshan rus pas brgyan: dar sham mchog phur ral gri me long mda' yol ba lda ldi 'phan yab phun tshogs gyur: lo rat+na waṣ+ṭa dh+wa dza spra ra ṇa sa ma ye ྅༷ rten bkod pa ni: hūṃ hrī: bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang: bde skyongs bhan+ta shes rab phyag rgya'i gzugs: sku 'bag me long phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: gsang gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs rgo ā:: swā hā: ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta maṇ+ḍa lapas we sha yapas ā: lha dang bum pa rta gon bya: de nas slob ma rta gon ni: sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyang bar bya: tho 'tshams bgegs bsal srung gur phub: slar yang sgo zhus bya ba ni: kyi:

badz+ra: mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku mnga' ba: ye shes khro bo khro mo dgongs: tshad med rnam bzhi'i sgo byes la: lha dang bla ma bstan tu gsol: lan gsum zhu bka' bsgo ba ni:ye ma: 'jig rten chos la skyo ba med: dug lnga'i rjes 'brang gdung zhen che: mngon lkog mi mthun skyon gyis gang: de 'dra snod med phyir dnges shig: slob bus zhu ba ni: kye ) sdug bsngal mthong nas nges 'byung skye: ma rig dbang gyur snying rje skye: thar 'dod blo ni bcos ma min: gsang sngags dbang gi bka' drin stsol: bla mas lan gnang ba ni:e ma: dngos grub bla ma bsnyen las byung khyed shes dad pas byin rlabs 'jug: bka' bzhin sgrub na dbang bskur sbyin: dam tshig gzhan la ma smra zhig: slob bus yar zhus ni bka' bzhin sgrub po rjes su 'jug go: rjes su sgrub po: yol ba phye zhing bden don bshad: maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni kye rdor+sha kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can: srid dang zhi las sgrol mdzad pa'i: bla ma he ru ka dpal dgongs: rta gon dbang rnams bskur du gsol: lan gsum rjes su bka' gnang ni: e ma: 'jig rten chos la g.yeng ba che: dag pa'i gnas rnams ma mthong bar: sgyu ma'i nor la bdag

gir 'dzin: de ltar de ni dbang skal med: zhes dbye bsal ma nor bar skyabs yul tshogs zhing rgya mtsho gsal gdab pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo mtshan dpes spras pa'i bcom ldan 'das lung dang rtogs pa dam pa'i chos: grol ba'i lam ston dge 'dun la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma dang: dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam lha: bde stong dpal sbyin mkha' 'gro la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi sku: 'gags med 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs gang 'dul phrin las sprul pa'i sku: rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: spron pa sems bskyed ni ho: thabs kyi cho ga zab mo yis ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang: dbug ma dbyung rnams dbug dbyung zhing sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god: 'jug sems ni: ho: sngon gyi rgyal ba thas cad kyang: sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du byang chub sems bzung bslab la gnas: tshogs bsags ni ho: dkon mchog kun dngos bla ma la: bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: nyes byas ma

ba tshu lus bshags par bgyi: mdzad pa rgya mtshor rjes yi rang: gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rgyal rnams mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs: dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: 'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur shog: rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni: kye ho khya ma mchog gi spyan snga dza gsang ba bla med sgor zhugs nas: byang chub sems ni mi spang bar rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: khyen pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin sdom pa thams cad ldan par bya: las rab rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: thams cad dkyil 'khor gsum du sgrub: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshigs 'dzin: sor byang sngags kyisdom dam las bdag ni nam yang mi 'da' 'o: lan gsum dam tshig sbyin pa ni:rdo rjeliblo ba ma rnams kyi dpral b.ratsas: mgrin par ā: thugs gara3: bkod: de las spros pa'i 'odazer gyis 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bstim khyen badz+ras twas pāre wang badz+ras mas dza sam ya

nyiṣ+ṭha lhan: atai pūho: pra tisnroho: bla badz+ras twas pā war purmyedhuṣ+pesalo ༷gharnyenaini) shabha pañtsa.a mṛ ta rak+ta bā lingata khāhai: hūṃ:mi rtog ye shes bcom ldana'adas: dmigasamed shes rab yum dang sbyor: nyon mongs las sgrib 'khrul rgyun sbyongs: dpal ldan rdo rje sems la bstod: kun gyis bshags sbyangs yig brgya bzla de nas 'dod gsol bshags pa ni rkye: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dgongs: bdag cag ma rig rmongs dbang gis: sdom gsum bslab bya dang 'gal ba: mi 'chab 'gyod bshags phyin chad sdom: zhes khas blang la rdo rje slob dpon gyisasrung go bsgo ba ni ho: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje'i dam tshig med po che: snying la gnas pa gang yin pa: rtag tu mi nyams srung go bsgo: badz+ra samo yatsal āhūṃ rak+ṣa: metog 'thor la rab tu gnas so shing sbyin pa ni hūṃ hrī so shing 'di ni dbang gi rdzas dngos grub mtshan ma brtags pa dang: bum pa'i dbang gi snod rung phyir : pad+ma'i phyag rgyas longs la dor zlobadz+ra su lharta hūṃ: zhes pas sbyin: ma badz+rasu ༄rta sidhi hrī zhes slobabus len 37 badz+ra has ha: zhesatshom bu'i khar dor 'o so shing gi cod paṇa dbus su bab na de bzhin rigs kyi lha

ga tshu 'grub: shar du rdo rje'i rigs dang las 'grub: lho ru rin chen rigs dang las 'grub: nub tu pad+ma'i rigs dang las 'grub mtshams bzhir regs sna tshogs dang las phran tsheg re 'grub: lha dang bla mar bstan na phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob: steng du mkha' spyod dang 'og tu sa spyod kyi las 'grub po: nyams pa byung na bshags sbyangs byed: bumapa'i dbang gi sgod rung 'gyur:samayā: dung zhal byi chu sbyin pa ni shā hrī dung zhal sgod du bdudartsi chab: bag chags dri ma dag byed rjas: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin gyis: skal ldan ngag gidri ma 'khru: yin badz+raghas snro zhes sbyin yin atsho tadza)bye : zhes pas blang: yin sarbasnye /khye shwa dhan yeswā hā: zhes lan gsum btung la rgyab tu dor: des ni ngag sgrib dag pa dang gsang ba gsung gi snod rung ngo/samayā srad bu sbyin pa ni zhu hrī srad bu grin las grub pa'i rdzas: bde ba gnas su sbyin byed pa: 'dod chags dri ma dbyings su bcing: mi 'gyur rtags kyis rgyas gdab po: e badz+rarak+ṣaṇa tushes: zhes pas sbyin: ardze lis mṛta snro zhes pas len: badz+ra kāwa tsirak+ṣa: zhes pas skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su bcing bar bya'o: des ni rtsa yi sgrib pa sbyangs shes rab dbang gi snod

rung byed: sa ma mā de nas ku sha sbyin pa ni: hūṃ hrī: ku sha 'di ni gtsang ma'i rdzas: rma bya'i mgrin ltar ljang sngon 'tsher: byang chub thob gdan bkra shis rdzas: skal ldan khyod la sbyin par bya:6( badz+ra tik+ṣa hūṃ: zhes pas sbyin: skyes badz+ra tik+ta sirnyi hrī: zhes pas len bden pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni ho: bla ma dkyil 'ashesar lha tshogs dbo ngas bdag la dge dang mi dge'i ltas thams cad bstan du gadresal: des ni cha mnyam sgrib dag cing: ka dag tshig dbang snod rung byed sa ma rtsa dam tshig khas blangs shis pa brjod maṇ+ḍal phul la dge ba bsngo: des na rta gon sgrub pa'i dal mchod cing bstod pa 'di ltar bya: sa badz+ra ma hā gu ru sa pā ri wa ra asnye pra tits+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin pābye nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod: hūṃ hrī: bde ba mchog gi dpal sbyin pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba: tshangs dbyangs 'gags med dam pa chos kyi gdul bya'i re ba skong ji lta ji snyed gzigs pas 'a17 ba'i ma rig mun sang ba rgyal sras pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rta gon lha rnams 'od kyi drwa gur du btegs la ka badz+ra pu dhuspe sogs shabha pra tits+tsha ā:hūṃ: ྅ hrī: bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma'i zhal khams gsum srid gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur:

ba rte gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsnyen bde chen chags pa'i rdo rjer bstod: de nas smon lam marga ma brtags : legs nyes bla ma'i drung du zhu nyams na tshogs dang bshag sbyangs 'bad legs na dga' ston rgya cher spro de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur la khrus dang bgegs bsal srung 'khor bsgom: sgo zhus 'di ru bya ba legs bden don bshad la maṇ+ḍal phul: gsol ba gdab pa 'di lta ste: kye rdoste kun mkhyen kun gzigs 'gro ba'i mgon: ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma can: brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: lan gsum zhu bla mas: e 4 che rab sngon nas las 'phro can gsang sngags 'phrad pa skal ba bzang: dam tshig rnams ni 'dzin nus na: rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i dbang bskur sbyin: de nas rgyud sbyang ba la skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo byen rlabs char 'bebs rigs kyi bdag: bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi: dngos grub gter mdzod phan bde'i gzhi: yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi: bde stong dpal 'bar dga' bzhi'i gter: mkha' 'a144chogs la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni ho: sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgya mtsho na rtag tu mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams: sangs rgyas sa la 'god byas

phyir: bla med byang chub sems bskyed do: stogs bsags ni bla a'ispyo tshogs zhing rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprina'abul: sgo gsum nyes lhung dri ma bshags: mdzad pa rgya mtshor rdzes yi rang: gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rgyal rnams mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs dge rtsa 'khoragasum dag par bsngo kun kyang rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni:ho: bla ma mchog gi spyan snga nas rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: byang chub sems ni bdag gisa'adzin: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'dza ba'i don la brtson par bya: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig tu dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'bral mi bya: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi:dam chig rnams ni bdag gis 'dzin dam chu sbyin pani: hūṃ gyi 'di ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus bdud rtsi 'khyil: khyod kyi lce la bzhag pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam srog thob: nam yang nyams par ma byed

gtsa( cig: rin chen sgog gi gta' ru zungs: snyed badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gaṇa: me tog sbyin zhing mig dar bkab slob ma'i phung khams lha ru sbyangs dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol: slar yang me tog dor ba ni: hūṃ hrī: ma chags bde ba mchog gi gsang: zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: sor rtog ye shes da la dza rigs pa'i me tog 'bul lo bzhes: sa pur+sha pra tits+tsha ho: me torga gang bab mtshan ma brtags: 'o me tog dbus su bab na gsang ba'i mtshan dri med klong yangs: shar ru bab na chags pa'i rdo rje: lto ru bab na rin chen 'dod 'byung nub tu bab na bde ba'i go cha: byang tu bab na las rab rtsal rdzogs mtshams rnams su bab na sna tshogs bzod pa: zhes gdag go: tshom bu'i dbang ni: e ma ho:kun khyab ye shes chos kyi dbyings: sna tshogs ma 'dres 'gags pa med: bde ba mchog gi rdo rje ni: khyed kyi snying la gnas gyur cig: snyed pad+ma rā dzas we sha yas ā: mig dar bsal ba ni hūṃ hrī: bde gshegs snying po chos kyi sku: lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i zhal: ma rig dbang gis lkog gyur nongasaḥ ye shes rig pas brda sgo dbye: a dz+nyā na tsakyu pra we sha ya

phaṭa: lha ngosprod pa ni: je nyi ltos shig mdun gyi dal la ltos: mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor 'dis: don dam rang byung ye shes mtshon: brda rtags rdzogs pa don gyi sku: gnyug ma'i sems nyid 'di kho na: a a ā: thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga ni: rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis: dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rnams: rigs lnga'i rnam par sbyan drangs te: mdun gyi nam mkhar sa ma dza: ma badz+ra pubye dhusgre a lo ke ghan+dhe nai wibye shabha ā hūṃḥ hūṃ trī: phung lnga'i spros pa rnam dag cing: 'byung khams ye shes dbyings su sbyor: sku gsung thugs yon phrinalas gter: rigs lnga'i rgyal ba rnams la bstod: gdul bya'i khams ni tshad med par: gang 'dul phan pa'i sman ster ba rig kun gyi ni bdag po la: dbang bskur rgyal po gnang bar zhu: zhes gsol ba btab pas bas/gas pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad: btagags ma rnams kyis glu blang: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa badzadad: sems ma rnams kyis me tog 'thor: khro bo rnams kyis bgegs sgrad: khro mo rnams kyis bro gar bsgyur: kun kyang dbang gi bya ba la dgongs pa mdzad par mos la: mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang ni:hū

ga66 hrī: rnam shes zhe sdang gnas dag cing: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: mi rtog rdo rje sems dpa' yi: dag byed chab kyis khrus bgyi'o: o mahwa shubyeta dz+nyān badz+rashā bha wa at+pa ko3haṃ: rin ཿnga dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni: ྅: chor phung nga rgyal rnam dag cing: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'dod 'byung rin chen sems dpa' yi: rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab nyid dbang bskur sā:rat+na a snyi ṣiñtsa3: snang mtha' rdo rje'i dbang ni: hūṃ: 'du shes 'dod chags rnam dag cing: sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: chags bral pad+ma sems dpa' yi gsang sngags 'chad dbang sbyin par bgyi: ā+olad+ma a snyi ṣiñtsa trī: don grub dril bu'i dbang ni: hūṃ: 'du byed phrag dog rnam dag cing: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phun tshogs las kyi sems dpa' yi: rab 'khyams phrin las nyan dbang sbyin: ha:karmas bhiṣiñtsa ā: rnam snang ming dbang ni: hūṃ gzugs phung gti mug rnam dag cing: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid mi bskyod ye shes sems dpa' yi: mngon par byang chub ming dbang bskur: shes brnya.abhe ṣiñtsatsan: smon lam ni: des phung po lnga dang dug lnga gnas su dag: sku lnga ye shes lnga la mnga' dbang

bskur: sems can gyi don thog pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig: dngos bzhi'i dbang yon mkho phul: gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya rkye ho mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid can: 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma dgongs: bdag cag las ldan bu slob la: dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur gnang bar zhu: bla ma'i bka' gnang ni: e yo sngon bsags tshogs smon las 'phro can: sngags kyi dngos grub sbyin dgos na: rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i thabs mkhas pas: dbang bskur rgyal po thob par byos: zhes brda' sbyar la: sku bum dbang ni hūṃ hrī: bum pa zlum po chos sku'i klong kha rgyan mgul chings longs spyod rdzogs: zag med bdud rtsi sprul pa'i sku: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid rkyi sgrib pa sbyangs: mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bag chags bkru: rdo rje'i sku ru smin pa dang: snang stong zung 'jug lta ba rtogs: sprul skus 'khor ba dong sprugs shog: rtsa sngags mthar rno brnya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa i ñdzi badz+ra kā ya a dzhai ṣiñtsa /:swā rat+na kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa swā: swe pad+ma kā ya a bhi ༷༷ ngas: hā:karma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: zhes spyi bo sogs gnas rnams su g.yo:bye hrī: 'bru lnga'i dbang bskur zhe sdang rnam par dag: rdo rje

ba:tshu sems dpa'i tshe la mnga' brnyes shog: snying po'i dbang bskung nga rgyal rnam par dag: rin chen 'byung ldan dpal la mnga' brnyes shog: sman lnga'i dbang bskur 'dod chags rnam par dag: snang ba mtha' yas bkrag mdangs mnga' brnyes shog: dri lnga'i dbang bskur phrag dog rnam par dag: don yod grub pa'i phrin las mnga' brnyes shog:dar lnga'i dbang bskur gti mug rnam par dag: rnam par snang mdzad sku la mnga' brtes de ga: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa 69 pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gtad la: nyu hrī: ma chags bde sbyin pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal: khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum zil gnon pa'i: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: 'khor 'das dpal yon dbang bsgyur dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsas dpa' bo'i sku gtad la: shā hrī : tshosanyid zhi zhing chags pa ngang gis bral: bde ba chen pos rgyas 'debs 'gro ba 'dren: phrin las thog med ye shes 'jug pa can pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: dpa' mo'i sku gtad la: nyu hrī: skyimid nam mkha' dag pa'i klong dkyil nas: brtse ba'i

zur mig skal ldan dpal du g.yo: dga' bzhi'i rgyas 'debs 'od gsal dgongs sang sbyor pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar:kwa ya.a bhiṇiñtsatsho mkha'a'agra'i sku gtad la: hūṃhrī: byams pa'i 'od zer stong gi zer g.yo zhing: gang la reg tshad mkha' 'gro'i gling dkyil 'god bde stong dpal sbyin pad+ma mkha' 'gro yi skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sgo: mkha' 'gro ma'i sku gawa la:hūṃ hrī: dga' chen thugs rje 'char ga'i dkyil lta bus: 'gro ba'i chags sogs nyon mongs mun khams sangs : 'dzum pa'i zhal can pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tsho rnal 'phyor gyi sku galo la: bye trī: bde ba'i sku canapad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal he ru ka dpal bkod pa sku la rdzogs: sa lam mthar phyin gdul bya'i re ba skong: pad+ma'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: rnal 'byor ma'i sku gtad la: bye ༷ mkha' la gnas shing brtul zhugs spyod pa can: legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshigs las rjes gcod: dga' bzhi'i me tog skal ldan

ba:tshu dpal mtshor spro pad+ma 'i rnal 'byor ma yi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā yas bhiṣiñtsa 6 ging gi sku gtad la: nyu sdi yeshes dbyings la gnas shing las rjes nyul: phrin las mi nub dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdung : rdo rje'i bka' nyan pad+ma rigs 'chang ba: las mdzad ging ka ra yi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar:kā ya.a bhiṣiñtsa mtsho pad+ma ging lo sku gto la:hūṃ nyi phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten chen po rtsa phan dang bde ba'i dpal la mnga' brnyes shing: mdzad pa'i yon tan yid bzhin nor lta bu pad+ma rigs kyi ging mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kwa yas bhiṣiñtsa sa: o rgyan nor lha'i sku gtad la: ྅ smi bsod nams chen po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam dngos grub char ba mi mjed zhing la 'bebs bde nas bde ba'i sa dang lam la 'god gu ru o rgyan nor lha'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar:kwa yas bhiṣiñtsa oṃ skyes bu don grub kyi sku gtad la shā snyi gu ru pad+maligrin las mdzod 'dzin pa phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'dul 'dzam gling nor ster bdag: bgrang yas rgud pa skyobs pa'i thugs rje can: ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags

kā ya a bhi ྅: oṃ dbang phyug chen po'i sku gtad la hū rdi lha dbang lha yi bla ma lha yi lha srid zhi zil gnon 'phags par dbang bsgyur ba: khams gsum mnga' mdzad gyi mdzod: dbang phyug ma hā de wa'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngagasamathar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sgo 'dzam bha la'i sku gto la hūṃ ༷ zla ba'i 'od 'chang 'phags pa 'dzam danaldan gser mdog dmar gsal 'char ga'i 'dzum: gsos khyim bum ldir gzugs thung gzi mdangs 'bar: 'phags pa 'dzam lha rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur ro:kwa ya a snyi ṇiñtsa oṃ dpal ོ mo'i sku gto la hū hrī be+eḍār sku can rin chen brgyan gyis spras: 'bru yi char 'bebs gter gyi bum pa 'dzin: pad+ma bum steng 'dod /gyed: g.yang gi lha mo nor ster dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sgo 'o gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang mchog dam snang tshad lha'i phyag rgyar sad de thams cad dag mnyam chen por rtogs pa'i dbang dam pa zob par gyur cig gnyis pa gsang dbang ni hū hrī: bha n+ta zlum po bde chen

ga rte dbyings: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bcud kyis gtams: a li ka li nyi zla'i zer 'phro ba: bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor las byung skyems sgod ldan slob ma'i lce yi pad+ma mor bzhag: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: gsang ba bla med sngags kyi dbang thob ste: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin bsgom bzlas mthar phyin nas: 'gags sred longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa.ā: sngags spyor gto la: hūṃ hrī banatshan chos kyi dbyings ni mkha' ltar dag rang byung 'od gsal nyi zla'i zer ltar 'byugs: zung 'jug rtsal mdangs rigs pa rgyu'i yi ge: bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa.ā: bgrangs phreng gawa la shā hrībadogashags zhokhro dam pa rigs brgya'i dal: gsang sngags rig sngags gzung sngags kun gyi rten: rin chen la sogs las su rung ba yi: bgrang phreng brgya rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a dzhai ṣiñtsa.ā: bzlas lung 'bog 'o skal ldan regs kyi bu rnams la gsang ba gsung gi dbang bskur bas: sgra grags thams cad sngags su sad de

gsung chos kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig gsum pa sher dbang ni hūṃ nyi pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal can dbang gi sku rdo rje'i rigs ma dung can dkar mdzes 'dzum: yon tan rigs 'chang glang po can zhes grags las kyi dpal 'dzin ri dwags ri mo can: 'dzum pa'i zhal can bde ba'i mdangs kyis 'byud bdud rtsi 'byed mkhas kun nas pad+ma'i dbyibs: zhi bsil dri bsung rlung gi ngad pa g.yo dga' bzhis rgyas 'debs sa lam mdzub mos ston: mkha' 'dza'i ri gas 'chang phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ro: thabs 'di ma spangs khamasagasum rol par spyod: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa kun dag nas bde stong zung 'jug lta ba mngon gyur te: chos kyi sku ru smin zhing grol bar shog rtsa sngagasamathar cit+ta pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a snyi ṣiñtsa snyi 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas: rlung sems bde ba chen po'i rol par sad de thugs shes rab ye shes kyi 'od gsal la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig bzhi pa tshog dbang ni: hūṃ nyi yul sems mi dmigs bde ba chen por zhog gang shar

badz+ra rang grol sems kyi ngo bor ltos bsal bzhag bral ba'i ye shes rjen pa 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa dpomed bsam jod bral lo de kho na 'dzin med blo 'das yin no skal ba can: byar med gud yangs yin no sems kyi bu: stong gsal spros bral yin no las 'phro can: 'didon rtogs na srid pa tha mar 'gyur:cha mnyam sgrib pa phra rags kun dag nas: ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru smin grol re ga: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa ā: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la mtshan ma tshig bral ka dag don gyi dbang bskur bas: gang shar rang grol kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa chos dbyings gter la mnga' brnyes pa'i gdeng dam pa thob par gyur cig lnga pa rtsal dbang ni: nyu sti kun khyab mkha' ltar dag pa'i dgongs pa skyongs: kun gzigs rgyang zhags gnad gzir rang bab zhog: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje lam snang shar phyi nang gsang ba dbyings thig lu gu rgyud: 'og min gnas dang sku thugs zung 'jug shar: 'di la khyed shes dad pas rang ngo skyongs: snang bzhi mthar phyin yul sems phung po bcas dngas ma 'od gsal chen por

smin grol byed: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog la brten nas: gdod ma'i rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar:gu ṇa bhiXstephachu 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams larig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog bskur bas: snang sems rlung gi zag pa zad de dngas ma 'od gsal chen por smin zhing grol nas 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob paragyur cig: mtha' rten gtor dbang ni:oṃg:gyi skye med chos kyi dbyings kyi gtor gzhong du: 'gags med 'od gsal rang byung gtor chen bshams: rtsol bral gang shar rang grol lhamos brgyan: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bar dor thos bsam bsgom mthar phyin rmi lam bar dor sprul bsgyur thog brdzis 'byung: bsam gtan b.rado rig pa rang grol rtogs: 'chi kha bar do 'pho ba rang grol rtogs: chos nyid bar do 'od gsal rang ngo shes: srid pa bar do rjes dran mthu yis brgal: khams gsum 'khor ba'igayul ngo las rgyal te: sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan dpal thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bha long ta a bhi ṣiñtsa o.āmakhye ༷ mtha' rten gtad cing dam khas blangs yon 'bul sgo gsum bran khas

—414 blangs dbang don ye shes brtan pa'i phyir: shis brjod rgya cher me tog spro: des ni dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob bskyed rdzogs bsgom la dbang ba dang: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srungs tshe 'di nyid la rib 'dzin thob don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za: sam yā rgya rgya rgya: a ma rgyaladabang pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: thugs kyi yang bcud man ngag mdzod: zab gsang rdo dze+esnying po'i skor: rin chen brda yi rgyar bcug nas mdo khams rtse shod gsham du sbas: gter bdag spu gri gsum la bcol: snyigs ma'i dus la bab pa'i tshe ngasprulang dang mi gzhan pa dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas gdul bya bye ma'i grangs: rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su 'god 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar tshogs smon las 'dzoms dpal du spel sa mashā rgya rgya rgya: rtsa dbang bde ba chen po'i dpal sbyin rdzogs so: gartar tsu gtad rgya sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu khya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oX brda thim 3) zhes pa'ang sku skyosaldak+ki'i mtshan can dang las 'phro ldan pa gos ri pon bo.argyan nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ngor kho bosbas pa'i rnal 'apyor rgyal mtshag bshad pa rtsal rgya mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa nisha/ngazen michas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga 'as/

ga rte zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i zab sgrub gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs:ba tshu na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: zanaskatham 'di la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: dran pas bde chen ye shes mchog stsol ba'i gu ru pad+ma rgyal por skyabs su mchi: tha snyad sems kyi snang cha stong gzugs tsam: ye grol chos skur sad phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gnyis pa lha bskyed ni: a: rang snang dag pa 'od gsal bde chen zhing: brda don rtags rdzogs gzhal med khang mdzes nang: 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang sprin phung ltar 'khrigs klong: ma chags ge sar zla nyi kha sbyor steng: rgyal kun yi shes rdo rje pad+ma rgyal: dbang gi zhal bzang 'dzum sgeg brdzid nyams chags: dar gyi la thod rat+na'i sgog zhwa dang: pad+ma'i thod gdeng rin chen snyan cha mdzes: zal bu rgyab 'phyangasanor bu'i mgul phrengs bkra dar ber 'dung ma gsang gos mdzes par klubs: swag lhum dang bcas phyed 'gying rol stabs bzhugs: 'ja' 'od 1nga du snang stong ma 'dres shar phyag

g.yas snangab dbang sdud ṭa ru 'khrol: dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams phywa 'bod 'gugs sdud byed: g.yon pa bde stong snyom brdal me long bsnams ṭā ki ma tshogs dpal 'byor spro la gnas: ging dang ling ga pho nya bu yug 'tshub: phrin las rnam bzhi chags thogs bral bar stsol: thugs sgog 'od kyis 'od min gnas mchog dang: rnga yab gling nas o rgyan yab yum bcas: 'dir byon dam tshig dag palirten la bzhugs: rang rig rang ngo shes pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid ma 'gags kun bzang rgyan mchod 'bul: sngags tshig glu gar bro yi dgongs pas bstod: thugs sgog hrī:la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khor 'das snang ba dbang sdung cing: 'phrin las rnams bzhi'i phywa g.yang char 'beb bzhin: gdul bya'i mos 'dod bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gter thob dmigs: ma badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ:ā: de ltar bsnyen sgrub bsgom bzlas na: tshe ring nad medadapal 'byor ldan phyi nang bar chad bdud las rgyal:don gnyis lhun 'khrub the mi tshom gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni: hūṃ hrī: ma chags pad+ma ra ga'i zhal bzang ngom bde
sa kyi rgyal por byed: o rgyan thubabar mnyams samayā:rgya rgya rgya gu skyo 'i:

bsgotshu gser yig snying po 'bru bdun las: bde mchog dkar po'i phyag rgya mi shig ye shes kyisasnyeng po bzhugs:da rte na mo:tsakra se bha ra ya: khru/yis1dzas/// rgyal kun ye shes thugs kyi dngos 'bor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal chos kun mnyam pa nyid kyis dbyings: phyag rgyas ye shes snying por bsgrub sa mayā mnyam nyid phyag rgya gcig pa ni: hūṃ: sems kyis rang bzhin gdod nas spros dang bral: ma 'gags rang gsal bde chen byang chub sems: chos rnams ye sangs rgyas pa phun tshogs lnga'i:zhing gi bkod pa ma 'dres lhun rdzogs dbus: sna bdun rat+na'i gzhal yas khang mdzes par pad zla nyi ma rtog med ro yis khar: chos 'byung dmar po'i ze'u 'brur hūm̐ yig la:'khor 'das dpal yon dwangs ma gcig tu dril: gnyug ma'i ngo bo dpal ldan bde mchog dkar: bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar mtshan dpe langs tsho'i 'byud: phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin: sridazhiganyis med mnyam pa nyid du ston: dar chas rus rgyan zhing g.yang sku la klubs: zhi ma khro 'dzum rjes chags dga' bde 'bar bzhengs pa'i

stabs kyis srid zhi'i sgo 'phar gnon: 'ja' 'od zer 'khrigs ma rig mun khams sangs: 'dod yon lha mo 'bum gyis bde stong stobs: nyon mongs chags pas myos pa'i 'gro rnams 'dul: stong gsal ha:ri:ni:sa'i rang sgra sgrogs gang snang gang shar gsung gi rol mor snyan: gzung 'dzin rdul bral ye shes thugs kyis ngang: ma rig mun sel longs spyod rdzogs skur bsgrub: thugs gar dbyings gsal snying po ྅:yig la: 'khor 'das gsang sgog dgongs pa gcig tu dril: dag chen lta bas rdzong ni 'gyur med gdab: dran rig ye shes so ma 'od gsal mdzod: ma 'dres mnyam nyid spyod pa'i la dor nas: 'bras bu thig le nyag gcig ngang la blta hrī71 ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sā hā gaspyod med chos sku khyab brdal ngang: so ma lhug pa phyal ba che: ye rdzogs rigs pa ka dag 1nga: gsang srog bde ba chen por bsgrub: rgyal thabs spyi sprugs dbang thobs nas don gyi sangs rgyas tshe 'dir 'gyur:sayoyā: sngags kyis mchod cing bstod pa ni:hū rdo bde ba mchog sbyin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: chags pa'i rdul bral rin chen dung 'od 'khyil: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid brda don thugs rtags 'chang: bde mchog 'khor lo sdom

bsgotshu par phyag 'tshal bstod: gang snang gang shar lha sngags thugs su khyer spyod lam rnams bzhi bde ba chen po'i ngang: bsal bzhag bral ba rin chen gser gling ltar 'dod dgu 'byung ba mkha' spyod dngos grub bsnyen: a ā: shin tu zab pa man ngag bcud rin chen sgog gi bsgrub pa 'di: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs khrag ste: gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang: nam mkha'i snying po grub pa rtsal: mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal la gurupad+mas gces nor rtsal brag dmar khyung lding lte bar sbas: rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying po'i 'byed bstan 'gro'i phan bde gsal bar 'gyur bka' 'di mdung dmar can gyis srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cig: sa ma mā: rgya rgya rgya: bka' gyo gnyan rgya: rtsarta gyo gu rgya: brda thiyo 3) zhes pa'ang dus bab kyisagater ston rig 'ardzan gartar bzhed snying po'i 'phrul gsang brda' yis ra ba las bton te snang ba dngos med kyis yig ris bas bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag pad+mas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam:
